title: Personal Brand & Social Media Manager – AI & Business
description:
I am a technology executive and entrepreneur with extensive experience in **AI, enterprise technology, ERP/CRM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, automation, and digital transformation**.



I run **Ridgepoint Inc.**, focused on AI Automation and AI Agents for businesses, and **DAX Software Solutions**, a Microsoft-focused ERP/CRM consulting and licensing company.



I am looking for a talented **Personal Brand & Social Media Manager** to help build my personal brand around **AI, technology, and practical AI applications for businesses**.



### Goal



Grow my personal brand to **10,000+ engaged followers within 3–6 months**, primarily on **Instagram and TikTok**, while also repurposing content for LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.



### Responsibilities



* Research trending AI, technology, and business topics

* Develop 10–15 strong content ideas/hooks each week

* Help create talking points/scripts for videos

* Edit 7–10 short-form videos per week

* Add captions, B-roll, graphics, screenshots, and engaging visual elements

* Manage posting on Instagram and TikTok

* Repurpose content for YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn

* Monitor comments, trends, competitors, and content opportunities

* Track views, retention, engagement, and follower growth

* Analyze what is working and recommend what we should create next



### Content Topics



Our content will focus on:



* Practical AI for businesses

* AI Agents & Automation

* AI use cases and demonstrations

* Microsoft AI/Copilot

* ERP/CRM + AI

* AI news and its impact on businesses

* Technology leadership and digital transformation

* Entrepreneurship and business



### Who I'm Looking For



You should have:



* Strong Instagram Reels/TikTok experience

* Excellent short-form video editing skills

* Understanding of hooks, storytelling, and viewer retention

* Strong English communication

* Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar

* Canva experience

* Interest in AI, technology, and business

* Ability to work independently and bring new ideas



I am **not looking for someone who simply schedules posts**. I want someone proactive who studies trends, understands what makes content perform, and helps me build a recognizable personal brand.



This is a **long-term, full-time opportunity** with the potential to grow into a larger Content/Personal Brand Lead role.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction

2. 3–5 examples of short-form videos you have edited

3. Social media accounts you have helped grow and the results

4. Your experience with AI/business content

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP



Start your application with **"RIDGEPOINT AI"** so I know you read the complete posting.



Also send me **3 Reel/TikTok ideas you would create for an experienced technology executive building a personal brand around practical AI for businesses.**

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience, don't just answer tickets. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring someone to run point on resolution quality and the AI workflow behind it.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket, catch what the process and the AI miss, and treat the customer experience like it's yours. This is an individual contributor role, not a task-only one. Do it well and a bigger one opens up.



What You'll Own



* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 2+ years in e-commerce customer support, with a specific example of something you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Heavy, hands-on AI use in your actual workflow, and you can name the tools and what you use them for.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (Next day) Manila time (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break). Rest days Sunday to Monday.



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

title: Civil/General Construction Estimator
description:
CIVIL / GENERAL CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR – U.S. PROJECTS



Remote | Philippines



Granite State Business Holdings (GSBH) is looking for experienced CIVIL / GENERAL CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATORS to support our growing Estimating & Preconstruction team.



We support multiple U.S.-based construction companies and are looking for estimators who can confidently review plans and specifications, perform detailed quantity takeoffs, develop cost estimates, and help prepare accurate and competitive bids.



Our priority is finding candidates with strong CIVIL ESTIMATING experience. However, candidates who also have broader GENERAL CONSTRUCTION estimating experience are highly preferred, as our projects may involve different trades and scopes.



*** EXPERIENCE ESTIMATING U.S.-BASED CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS IS HIGHLY PREFERRED. ***



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Review construction drawings, specifications, addenda, and bid documents

Perform detailed and accurate quantity takeoffs

Prepare construction cost estimates and bid worksheets

Estimate civil scopes such as sitework, earthwork, excavation, utilities, drainage, paving, concrete, and related work

Estimate additional general construction trades based on your experience

Determine material, labor, equipment, and subcontractor requirements

Review plans for missing scope, discrepancies, constructability concerns, and potential estimating risks

Review addenda and incorporate revisions into estimates

Identify missing or unclear information that may require an RFI

Gather and compare vendor, supplier, and subcontractor pricing

Review quotations for pricing and scope completeness

Look for opportunities to obtain better and more competitive pricing

Clearly document estimate assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, and clarifications

Maintain organized takeoffs, quotes, estimates, and project files

Support additional estimating and preconstruction tasks as needed



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who can do MORE THAN JUST QUANTITY TAKEOFFS.



A strong candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of an estimating assignment and working independently with minimal supervision.



You should be able to:



Review plans and specifications and understand the overall project scope

Determine what needs to be included in the estimate

Perform accurate and organized quantity takeoffs

Understand how the work will be constructed in the field

Determine appropriate materials, labor, equipment, and subcontractor needs

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and unclear requirements

Ask the right questions when additional information is needed

Research pricing when necessary

Produce a clear and organized estimate that is ready for review

Manage deadlines and communicate progress or concerns proactively



You DO NOT need to be an expert in every construction trade.



Our priority is strong CIVIL ESTIMATING experience, but candidates with broader GENERAL CONSTRUCTION estimating experience will have an advantage.

title: Community Support Specialist
description:
** READ THROUGH THE POST CAREFULLY --> Submit your application through the form linked at the end of this post. Applications sent through other channels will not be reviewed. **



Remote, Philippines. 11:00am to 8:30pm US Eastern. 1,200 to 1,500 USD per month.



ABOUT THE JOB

We are an online education company. Members pay for a course and for our team to help them finish it. You are one of three people they talk to when they need help. You work in our community platform, our support ticket system and our
 inbox.



WHAT YOU DO

- Answer member questions in the community, by
 and in the ticket system within two hours.

- Communicate with the developer team about customer problems. Write the ticket so a developer can act on it without asking questions. Chase it until it is done. You tell the member it is fixed.

- Communicate with the customer support and onboarding teams about customer problems. Hand over the members who need a phone call, a billing change or a refund decision, and follow up so nothing gets dropped between teams.

- Keep a list of every open request and work it down to zero. A request stays on your list until the member confirms it is sorted.

- Calm down members who are threatening to cancel or asking for a refund. Hear them out and bring in a manager while there is still a chance to fix it.

- Write and post community announcements. Product changes, delays and new resources.

- Welcome every new member and reply to their introduction post. Show them where to start so their first week is not silent.

- Moderate the community. Remove spam, keep discussions on topic, step in when members argue.

- Write an end of shift report. How many messages came in, how many you closed, what is still open, and what you need from another team.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written English. You will be writing to American customers all day. They should feel calmer after reading your message.

- Two years of customer support experience, ideally for a software product or an online service, and ideally already on US hours.

- Comfortable learning software. You do not need to write code. You do need to read an error message, look through a help document, and work out what to tell the member. You see every technical problem first.

- You do not let things sit. When you cannot solve something, say so and hand it to someone who can.

- The application key is Alden



YOUR SCHEDULE

- Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday, 11:00am to 8:30pm US Eastern, with Wednesday and Thursday off. The same hours every day you work. Each shift is 9.5 hours including two paid 30 minute breaks. In Manila that is 11:00pm to 8:30am, so this is night work.



You are never on your own. Two teammates cover the community on their own shifts, and your hours sit alongside theirs through the busiest part of the day.



HOW WE MEASURE YOUR WORK AND HOW WE PAY

Three numbers, and you see all three every morning. How quickly you reply. How many members you answered. A quality score on the replies you wrote.

title: Creative Production Editor (social media)
description:
Title: Creative Production Editor (Full-Time, Long-Term)

Salary: $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month ($10–13/hour, based on experience)

Type: Full-time contract, 40 hrs/week, timesheet-based

Schedule: 4 hours overlap with US Central



About the role



Harmony Marketing is hiring a Creative Production Editor to join our Creative Production department. This is not a "cut clips as assigned" job. You'll own video projects end to end — from raw footage landing in the drive, through organizing it against the content brief, to a finished edit that goes out the door.



You'll work directly with the head of Creative Production. As you prove yourself, this role grows into a senior position where you also review and revise work from other editors on the team, with pay increasing as your scope does.

What you'll be editing — watch these before you apply



Here are real examples of the work we produce: 



We make social media ads and Reels. Vertical, short-form, fast. Almost none of our work is horizontal, and none of it is long-form corporate or wedding-style video.



The core of what we do is building a story out of b-roll — showcasing a product or service through tightly cut footage that holds attention from the first frame. 



That means:



- 9:16 vertical, built for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and paid social placements

- Heavy stylized and kinetic text — animated captions, callouts, and on-screen copy that carries the message

- Punchy pacing, sound design, and cuts timed to music or VO

- Strong b-roll selection and sequencing. Finding the two seconds that sell the product out of ten minutes of footage is the skill we're hiring for

- Hook-first structure — the first 2 seconds d
 whether the ad works



If your reel is mostly 16:9 talking heads, event recaps, or documentary-style pieces with clean minimal text, this isn't the right fit and we'd rather you not apply. If the videos in that folder look like the work you already do — and want to do better — keep reading.



What you'll do



- Ingest, organize, and label raw footage against content briefs so every project has a clean, searchable starting point

- Edit finished vertical ads and Reels — hook, pacing, story, sound, color, kinetic text

- Build and apply motion graphics templates (MOGRTs) to keep our output consistent and fast

- Use AI-assisted editing tools (including Claude) to speed up our workflow — transcript-based rough cuts, automated organization, scripting repetitive tasks

- Help us build and document editing systems, not just complete individual edits

- As you grow: review and revise videos from other editors, give clear feedback, and hold quality standards across the department



What you must have



- 3+ years editing professionally, with a portfolio that shows vertical short-form social ads or Reels — not just repurposed horizontal work

- Strong command of at least one of: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut — plus real After Effects ability

- Demonstrated skill with stylized/kinetic text and animated captions, not just default caption tracks

- Your own library of MOGRTs / motion graphics templates you can bring and build on

- A proven eye for b-roll — selecting, sequencing, and cutting product/service footage so it actually sells

- Comfort with AI editing tools, and genuine curiosity about making the process faster rather than defensiveness about it

- Ruthless organization. File naming, folder structure, and version control that another editor could pick up cold

- Reliable high-speed internet and a machine that can actually handle 4K timelines

- Strong written English — you'll be reading briefs and eventually writing revision notes



Nice to have



- Sound design and audio cleanup skills

- Color grading beyond basic correction

- Experience editing paid social ads specifically (and understanding what a hook and a CTA need to do)

- Experience giving feedback to or managing other editors



What we offer



- Full-time, long-term, stable work — not project-to-project

- $1,800–$2,200/month to start, with a clear path to more as you take on senior editing and revision responsibilities

- Real ownership of the systems we build, not just the tasks handed to you

- A team that invests in tools that make your work faster instead of asking you to grind



How to apply



Send us:

1. Your portfolio or reel — link to 3–5 pieces you personally edited. Must be vertical, highly engaging, short-form ads or Reels with stylized text.

2. A short note on the AI tools you currently use in your editing workflow and what they've actually saved you

3. A screenshot of how you organize a project folder on a real past project



Start your application with the word "MOGRT" so we know you read the whole posting. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

title: Tax Operations Associate
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Full-Time (40+ hours per week, depending on business needs)

Working Hours: U.S. Central Time (CST)



Job Description



Role Overview

If you enjoy creating efficient systems, keeping projects moving, and ensuring every tax engagement is delivered accurately and on time, our Tax Operations Associate role is for you.



DiLucci CPA Firm has been serving business owners and real estate investors since 2005. For nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for doing tax differently—by going deeper than compliance, telling clients the truth, and using the tax code strategically to protect and grow their wealth. Our mission is simple: help clients keep more of what they earn while giving them clarity, confidence, and a long-term plan. We value enjoying what we do (what we call Fun Tax Energy), moving with speed, and operating independently with a focus on the outcome.



As our Tax Operations Associate, you will support the day-to-day operations of the tax team by staying client focused on follow up regarding tax and accounting open items. You'll play a key role in creating operational excellence while allowing our tax professionals to focus on delivering exceptional client service.



This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented role for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities



Open Items Follow Up

Review open-item requests prepared by the tax or accounting team.

Confirm that requested documents or information are actually missing before contacting the client.

Contact clients regarding outstanding documents, unanswered questions, signatures, approvals, and other required action items.

Follow up consistently until each item is resolved.

Track every request, response, follow-up date, and current status in the firm’s systems.

Escalate unresponsive clients or time-sensitive issues before they affect deadlines.

Avoid requesting documents or information that the client has already provided.



Client Communication

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding outstanding items.

Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and when it is due.

Send concise, professional, and easy-to-understand follow-up messages.

Respond promptly to client questions related to document requests and next steps.

Maintain a helpful but persistent approach when multiple follow-ups are required.

Ensure clients always understand their remaining responsibilities.



Document Review and Organization

Review submitted documents to confirm that the requested item was received.

Identify incomplete, unreadable, incorrect, or missing documents.

Upload, categorize, and organize files in the appropriate client folder or system.

Update open-item lists immediately when documents or responses are received.

Confirm that resolved items are properly closed before work is returned to the tax or accounting team.



Internal Coordination

Communicate with tax preparers, reviewers, bookkeepers, and other team members regarding unresolved items.

Ask internal team members for clarification when a request is unclear or appears duplicative.

Provide clear status updates on clients with outstanding items.

Notify the appropriate team member when all requested information has been received.

Escalate technical tax or accounting questions rather than attempting to answer them independently.



Deadline Management

Monitor due dates associated with open requests.

Prioritize follow-ups based on filing deadlines, internal deadlines, and engagement urgency.

Follow up before outstanding items become urgent.

Maintain accurate tracking so the team has visibility into delayed or unresponsive clients.

Ensure no engagement is delayed without documented follow-up and escalation.



Role Expectations

Open-item requests are accurate and do not duplicate information already provided.

Clients receive timely, clear, and professional follow-up.

Outstanding items are followed through to completion rather than simply requested once.

Client responses and documents are accurately tracked and organized.

Unresponsive clients are escalated early.

The tax and accounting teams can quickly see what is missing and what has been received.

No engagement falls behind because an open item was forgotten or not followed up on.



Requirements

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Tax, Bookkeeping, Finance, or a related field

Required: Previous experience supporting U.S. tax preparation or tax operations in a CPA firm or tax practice

Strong understanding of the U.S. tax return preparation process for both individual and business tax engagements

Familiarity with the following U.S. tax forms is strongly preferred:



Individual Tax Forms

Form 1040 – U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

Schedule A – Itemized Deductions

Schedule B – Interest and Ordinary Dividends

Schedule C – Profit or Loss from Business

Schedule D – Capital Gains and Losses

Schedule E – Supplemental Income and Loss

Form 4562 – Depreciation and Amortization

Form 4797 – Sales of Business Property

Form 8582 – Passive Activity Loss Limitations

Form 8829 – Business Use of Home

Form 8949 – Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets

Form 8995 / Form 8995-A – Qualified Business Income (QBI) Deduction



Business Tax Forms

Form 1120 – U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

Form 1120-S – U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation

Form 1065 – U.S. Return of Partnership Income

Form 1041 – U.S. Income Tax Return for Estates and Trusts

Form 941 – Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return

Form 940 – Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment (FUTA) Tax Return

Forms W-2 and W-3

Forms 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, and 1099-INT

Form 1096 – Annual Summary and Transmittal of U.S. Information Returns



Ability to identify missing tax documents and proactively follow up on open items with clients and internal team members until resolved

Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and clearly with clients

Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills

High attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and quality

Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Comfortable using cloud-based tax software, document management systems, and project management tools

Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team

Available to work full-time during U.S. business hours (9:00 AM CST – 6:00 PM CST)



Our Core Values

1. Bring Fun Tax Energy

We're genuinely obsessed with tax — the rules, the strategy, the wins for clients — and that obsession is contagious. We show up with real energy, take pride in the work, and make the experience good for each other and for the client. A great attitude isn't soft; it makes the work better and the people around us better.



2. Speed Drives Results

We love to win, and winning means getting it done. Immediately. We learn fast, adapt fast, and move — because knowing the answer isn't the job, acting on it is. Momentum compounds: the faster we turn knowledge into action, the better the outcome for the client and the firm.



3. Own the Outcome

The result is yours, full stop. We don't love excuses, even if they are real — we love getting results. We don't hand off problems, we solve them. We follow through on what we said we'd do, and when something's in the way, we do what it takes to get it done. No "not my job."



All applications require a 1–2 minute video introduction, along with your resume attached. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

If so, AAA Forklifts is looking for a full-time **Talent Acquisition Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)** to help us recruit top-tier technicians, mechanics, and support personnel as we continue to expand.



WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM



At AAA Forklifts, we're proud to be one of the fastest-growing equipment service companies in the Southeast. We believe our success starts with hiring the right people, and we're looking for someone who shares that mindset.



As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you'll play a critical role in helping us attract, evaluate, and hire skilled professionals who will contribute to our continued growth and success.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you'll serve as the primary point of contact throughout the recruiting process. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:



* Posting and managing job advertisements across multiple platforms

* Sourcing candidates through job boards, social media, online communities, and professional networks

* Reviewing resumes and applications for open positions

* Conducting initial screening interviews via phone or video call

* Scheduling interviews between candidates and hiring managers

* Sending interview confirmations, reminders, and follow-up communications

* Maintaining candidate records and updating recruiting trackers

* Coordinating reference checks and pre-employment requirements

* Following up with candidates throughout the hiring process

* Building and maintaining talent pipelines for future openings

* Supporting onboarding and new-hire coordination activities

* Providing recruiting updates and hiring reports to management



THE TYPES OF POSITIONS YOU'LL HELP FILL



You'll primarily support recruiting efforts for:



* Forklift Technicians

* Mobile Mechanics

* Heavy Equipment Technicians

* Shop Leaders

* Parts and Inventory Personnel

* Other operational and administrative roles as needed



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required Qualifications:

title: AI Assisted Ghostwriter - Social posts (LinkedIn) / Email
description:
We're a marketing studio.



We ghostwrite LinkedIn posts,
 newsletters, and ads (plus other things) for founders in the aviation, career consulting, finance, and home-preparedness markets.



We've already built a workflow: custom AI tools (Claude plus our tailored ghostwriting skills) and a library of hundreds of client call transcripts to pull stories, ideas, and angles from...



But the machine has problems, and that's why we need you.



Our AI system produces technically accurate copy. It'll get you the ideas.



It gets the facts right and the structure close enough...



But what it cannot do is make someone FEEL something.



The emotional storytelling, the visual detail that puts a reader inside a moment, the human ache that makes a post stop the scroll: that has to come from a person.



That person is who we're hiring.



So you're not starting from a blank page.



We have the AI to hand you find ideas, and we'll work together to build the content calendars.



What we need from you is the writing skill to leverage the AI and produce the one thing machines can't: emotion, story, and visual texture.



What you'll actually do:



- Mine our client's call transcripts for the moments mentioned above: the turning point, the fear, the win, the detail nobody else would notice

- Work with me (and ideally, over time, on your own) to draft the content calendar and the week's ideas

- Help run, revise, and refine our Claude ghostwriting skills. The skill keeps evolving, so your input on improving the system is welcome and encouraged



Then do the part that only you can do:



- With your edits and writing experience, layer in the emotional storytelling and visual, sensory detail that makes it resonate

- Fact-check every claim against the source. We write about people, companies, and industry data, so accuracy is non-negotiable

- Deliver on the content calendar a week ahead of publish date.



Volume: Minimum is 10 social posts (LinkedIn) and ~10
s per week (most of these are short)



Once you're ramped and the system's dialed in, there's plenty more: sales pages, ads, additional
 work, and eventually copy for our own home-preparedness brand. This position grows for the right person who is passionate about writing and using AI as a partner - not to do the work for them (as we all know what "AI output" reads like and why it doens't work).



The bar: the founder reads it and goes "that's exactly how I'd say it, this gave me goosebumps."



Then I do one light proof pass and it ships.



If I'm rewriting your drafts, it's not working out...



You're a fit if you:



- Write genuinely emotional, story-driven copy in native-level English.



- This is the #1, non-negotiable requirement. Show me writing that made someone feel something.



- Have real instinct for story: you can hear a 5-minute anecdote and instantly know the emotional hook



- Use AI writing tools like Claude as a drafting partner, not a replacement for your own voice and skill



- Are obsessive about factual accuracy, attention to detail, and deadlines.



This means being reliable and consistent week over week.



- I value steady, dependable output over occasional brilliance that fades over time.



- Be honest with me: I've hired talented writers who started strong and faded after a few weeks or months.



- I'm looking for someone consistently good who'll be with us long-term.



- Take direct feedback without getting upset, knowing we both want the same thing: content that keeps clients around long-term and grows both our incomes



Bonus if you've:



- Ghostwritten for personal brands, LinkedIn, or newsletters before

- Have any exposure to aviation, career coaching, or finance

- Experience turning interview or transcript material into content



Logistics



Remote, long-term, ongoing relationship. 



Ideally, we can meet once a week in US Mountain Time (MST) for a quick content huddle at the start of the relationship.



But besides that, feel free to work whatever hours you want as long as we're hitting deadlines and getting reliable output! 



$800/month to start, raises available and can go up for the right person.



I'd rather find someone great and pay them more over time than start cheap and burn through people.



Begins with a paid trial (below)



How to apply:



Start your reply with the word CHILLS, so I know you read the whole thing.



Paste ONE piece of your writing that made a reader feel something, and in one sentence, tell me what emotion you were going for and why it worked.



Here's a flat, boring fact. Rewrite it as 2-3 sentences with emotion and visual detail, the way you'd open a post:



"A pilot we coached got a job offer from a regional airline after being unemployed for 8 months."



Paid trial: Strong applicants get a strong, paid two-week trial.



I'll send you call transcripts, our voice guide, and our Claude skill, and you'll produce the content needed for two weeks.



I'll of course pay you for the full two weeks. It's how I see how you actually work, and how you find out if you enjoy the system.



Thanks for reading this far, and I look forward to hearing from you!

Smartland manages 1,400+ rental homes and apartments. The CEO moves fast and d

You need detailed instructions to start.

description:

DMPH Marketing

$800 to $1,200 USD per month, based on experience



Who we are

DMPH Marketing is an AI-first marketing agency built around content. We make video and creative that helps our clients get noticed in industries where most brands look and sound the same.

Two things define how we work. First, detail: we care about the frame, the cut, and the mix, not just whether the file exports. Second, fit: every project gets built around that client's vision instead of being run through the same template.

Send us two things:

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

We're filling this role as soon as we find the right person. Apply today.

$9 USD/hour to start | 10 hours per week | Long-term | Internal Legacy Growth team role





JOB OVERVIEW



This is not a client placement. You would be joining the Legacy Growth team directly and working alongside our founders on paid media across our client accounts.



We are looking for a seasoned media buyer who wants a focused part time role with a team that will actually respect your expertise. You will not be handed a checklist. You will own the paid side, tell us what you are seeing, and tell us when we are wrong.



Google Ads is the requirement. Meta is a plus.

When a conversion stops firing, when tags break after a site change, when the numbers in the ad account do not match the numbers in the CRM, you should know where to look and be able to fix it yourself.



You should have advanced, repeated, hands on experience with Google Ads campaign builds and Google Tag Manager setups. Not once. Several times, for real clients, from scratch.



The technical side matters as much as the buying side. That includes Google Tag Manager container builds, GA4, conversion tracking and enhanced conversions, event setup, tracking that connects the ad account to a CRM, and diagnosing tracking that has silently broken. If your answer to a broken tag is to ask someone else to look at it, this is not the right role.



Reliability is the other half of this job. Ten hours a week does not mean ten hours in one sitting. We need you present and responsive five days a week, because ad accounts do not wait. Spend does not pause while someone is offline. We need someone who checks in consistently, flags problems the same day, and never goes quiet.



We are looking for someone to start as early as September 1.





WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



Building, launching, and managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts.



Google Tag Manager container setup, conversion tracking, and GA4 configuration.



Troubleshooting tracking, tags, conversions, and integrations when they break.



Monitoring spend and performance, and adjusting before problems compound rather than after.



Reporting clearly on what is working, what is not, and what you recommend changing.



Working directly with our founders on strategy and account decisions.



Meta ads work as a secondary responsibility if that is in your skill set.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



At least 5 years of hands on paid advertising experience.



Deep Google Ads expertise. This is not negotiable for this role.



Advanced Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking experience, done repeatedly for real clients.



Strong troubleshooting instincts across the full tracking stack, not just the ad platform.



Meta ads experience. This is a plus, not a requirement.



Reliable presence and responsiveness five days a week.



Strong written and spoken English and genuine comfort communicating with U.S. clients and founders.



Availability to start as early as September 1.





ABOUT LEGACY GROWTH



Legacy Growth Consulting is a U.S. based marketing and technology agency with a distributed team across the U.S. and Philippines. We build marketing ecosystems, content engines, and systems for coaches, consultants, and service based businesses.



This role sits on our internal team, not with a single client. You would be working across our accounts alongside our founders and our existing team of strategists, builders, and creatives.



We care about skill, but we also care deeply about communication, honesty, initiative, ownership, and finding people we genuinely want to work with long-term. We want someone who grows with us.

 with the subject "Google Ads Media Buyer."

 response, and security posture monitoring across client tenants. Not alert triage as a ticket-taker -  SecOps as the responsible technician.

title: Senior Google Apps Script Engineer
description:
✅ THE ROLE — $2,000–$3,000 / month (₱104,000–₱171,000)



Read the whole thing. The people who don't finish it are the people I'm filtering out.



Who I am & how we work



I run a live marketing operation that runs entirely on a multi-workbook Google Sheets operating system — several connected workbooks tracking daily tasks, content builds, launches, worker shifts, payroll, and testing — with a standalone Apps Script project ("the engine") driving automation across all of it.



It's not a demo. Every day, remote workers input data into these sheets, the engine rolls it up on triggers, and I make real money decisions off the dashboards. Multiple people edit the same sheets live while the engine writes to them. The architecture is built and it works — but it's grown fast, and it's showing the strain of scale.



I don't need it rebuilt. I need it hardened, made key-stable, and made to run itself — surgically, without breaking what already works.



If you stop at VLOOKUP, this isn't your seat. If you've built scripted automation and clean multi-sheet systems that survive real production load — keep reading.



The real challenges — the actual work, and I already know the answers



I'm telling you the hard parts up front because I want someone who's beaten them before. And read this carefully: I already have an audit-grade diagnosis of what's wrong with my system. I know the root causes. Your application tells me whether you can see them too — so don't guess, and don't bullshit. I'll know in one read.



1) Automated writes collide with live human edits. The engine writes across sheets on time-based and onEdit triggers while humans edit those same sheets live. Writes collide and things silently un-fix. If you know exactly why this happens and the lock discipline that prevents it, you're already ahead of most applicants.



2) Position-bound logic that breaks the moment rows move. Every day a new dated block of rows gets inserted into these sheets — and any logic anchored to fixed ranges or positions breaks the instant that happens. Scheduled jobs that are supposed to generate records on those new rows silently stop firing. Right now a human has to hand-patch this every single day to keep it alive. I want it anchored to stable keys so it never needs a human again.



3) Roughly 1 in 10 automated runs fails — silently. No error, no alert, no log. Discovered days later by a confused worker. Early work is hunting that rate to zero.



4) Failures need to get LOUD. Reconciliation and validation so a dropped row or a missed write surfaces the moment it happens — not days later.



If reading those four made you nod and reach for specific fixes, we should talk. If they made you nervous, this seat isn't for you.



The work — two sides, both matter



1) Apps Script automation (.gs)



Write and maintain a standalone Apps Script engine across a multi-workbook system

Build and manage triggers — onEdit, time-based, onChange — with safe handling of concurrent writes vs. live human edits (LockService / lock discipline)

Diagnose and permanently fix broken and silently-failing logic — root-cause fixes, never band-aids that break again next week

Replace position-bound logic with key-anchored logic that survives rows, tabs, and values being added daily

Add validation, flagging, alerting, reconciliation checks, scheduled summary
s

Connect Sheets to external APIs with auth + error handling



2) Advanced formulas + sheet-to-dashboard systems



Multi-sheet data connections — worker input sheets rolling up into master dashboards

Fluent with QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, INDEX/MATCH, ARRAYFORMULA, FILTER, pivots at a systems level

Input sheets → consolidated master view, live and accurate

Dashboards that summarize operational data (performance, labor, output) in real time



Always: build on a copy, test, then deploy. Document everything. Non-negotiable.



Non-negotiables

Real Apps Script experience — actual .gs code, not just formulas

Concurrency discipline — you understand how automated writes and live human edits collide, and how to prevent it. Not "I've heard of LockService" — you've used it under load

Key-based, not position-based — logic that doesn't break when rows/tabs/values are added

Root-cause over patch — you fix why something breaks, not just today's symptom

Advanced formula fluency — QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, INDEX/MATCH at a systems level

Surgical, not destructive — read an existing system and extend it without breaking it

Clean, documented, maintainable work; sharp written English; reliable availability

You stand out if —

clasp + a real editor (VS Code) for local development

Apps Script + external API integration (REST, OAuth)

You've handled race conditions / LockService in a live multi-user system

You've built reconciliation that surfaces silent failures on its own

You've automated real operational systems — payroll, tracking, reporting — not toy demos

How hiring works — honest ladder, you get paid at every step

Paid approach + audit. On a masked copy of the system, you tell me the root causes and how you'd harden them, in writing. Fixed fee.

Paid fix tasks. You fix your own top findings on a copy, I review, I deploy.

Ongoing seat. Prove it across both rounds and we scope the full role at the salary above.



I move fast for people who deliver. I move on fast from people who don't.



How this stays clean



Everything runs under my accounts — scripts, triggers, and credentials stay owned by me, and you work on copies I share until your changes are reviewed and I deploy them. That's how this stays maintainable and secure long-term. If that's already how you work, we'll get along.



How to apply — follow exactly. Skip a step and you're deleted.



The instructions are the first test. I read every application that follows them. I ignore every one that doesn't.



Put SCRIPT at the very top.

Share 2–3 projects you personally built — must show both real .gs work and a multi-sheet / dashboard system. Link code (GitHub / Gist), a Loom walkthrough, or a working sheet copy.

In 2–3 sentences: one thing you automated with Apps Script that a formula couldn't — name the trigger and the logic.

In 2–3 sentences: an automated script writes across tabs on a trigger while people edit those same tabs live — how do you stop a collision or a silent overwrite?

In 3–4 sentences — this is the one that matters most: every day a new block of rows gets inserted into a sheet, and a scheduled job that's supposed to generate a record on those new rows silently stops firing. What's your first hypothesis for why, and how do you rebuild it so it never breaks on inserted rows again?

In one line each: how do you catch a script that fails silently with no error, and how do you tell a real fix from a patch that'll break again next week?



Nail this → paid task on a copy of my real system. Nail that → we scope the seat.



I'm hiring ONE person. Show me you can both script and build clean systems that don't break under live load.

title: Junior Native Creative Strategist — Long-Form Meta Ads for Health/Supplement Brand ($1,000/mo)
description:
WHAT A NATIVE AD IS



A native ad is a single-image
 ad with long-form direct response copy in the primary text. The copy is typically 1,500 to 4,000 words. It reads like a real person writing a story or personal experience — not a sales pitch, not a brand ad, not a product description. The image looks organic and editorial — like content, not advertising. Think x-ray images, doctor/lab visuals, handwritten sticky notes, screenshots, or low-fi photos. The ad clicks through to a long-form advertorial landing page.

If you have never written a
 ad longer than 
 words, this role is not for you. If you do not know what an advertorial funnel is, this role is not for you. If you think "native ad" means a short caption with a pretty product photo, this role is not for you.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



This is a junior role — we are not expecting a finished expert. We are looking for someone hungry: sharp, fast-learning, obsessed with direct response, and willing to put in the reps to get great. If you are early in your copywriting career but eat, sleep, and breathe this stuff, we want to hear from you.

We pay bonuses on winning ads. If a concept you produce becomes a top performer, you get paid extra for it — on top of your monthly rate. The hungrier and better you get, the more you earn.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



Scan Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, and other spy tools across health and supplement niches — not just magnesium and turmeric. You will study what is spending money in vision, joint pain, tinnitus, hair loss, weight loss, skincare, gut health, sleep, stress, and any other health vertical where long-form native ads are running.

Identify winning native ads and understand WHY they work — the story structure, the hook, the mechanism, how the product is introduced, the emotional arc, the proof elements.

Rebuild those winning structures for Meloni, our products (magnesium, turmeric), our mechanisms, and our audience. Same story skeleton. Different angle, different product, different landing page.

Produce the full ad — both the long-form copy AND the image. You will use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to assist with copy production and Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools for image creation.

Ship a growing volume of unique ad concepts per day as you ramp up (after your first 1-2 weeks of onboarding and training).

Come up with new angles and concepts on your own — from customer reviews, Reddit threads, competitor research, and our internal research documents. You are not just cloning. You are also generating original concepts.

Identify what is working from our existing ads and iterate on it — new hooks, new story frames, new angles on the same mechanisms.



WHAT YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE



Real interest in direct response copywriting — you understand or are quickly learning hooks, mechanisms, belief installation, objection handling, proof stacking, and emotional arcs.

Fluent, near-native English. Non-negotiable. Your copy must read as if it was written by or for an American woman between 40 and 70 years old. Not polished corporate English. Natural, conversational, emotional American English. If your writing sounds like a textbook or a press release, you will not pass the screening.

Comfort using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of your production workflow. You use AI to move faster — not to think for you. You can read AI output and start to identify when the hook is weak, the voice is off, the mechanism is unclear, or the story lost the reader.

Willingness to spend real time in Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, AdSpy, or similar platforms studying what is running in health markets.

Ability to put together an ad image using Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools. The image must look organic and editorial — not like a branded product ad.



STRONG PREFERENCES (not required but will put you ahead)



Any prior experience — freelance, internship, or otherwise — writing copy in the health, supplement, or wellness niche.

You can already name a few health or supplement brands running long-form native ads on
 right now and explain what they're doing well.

You understand advertorial funnels — you know the difference between an ad that sends traffic to a product page versus an ad that sends traffic to an editorial-style landing page, and why the second one converts better on cold traffic.

You've produced a native ad before yourself — chosen the image, matched the copy to the image, and shipped a complete ad, even if just as a personal project or test.



COMPENSATION



Base: $1,000 USD/month

Bonus: Extra pay per ad concept that becomes a winner (scales with performance) — we want our best people earning meaningfully more than base as they prove themselves.

title: Salesforce CRM Administrator
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a detail-oriented and solutions-minded Salesforce Administrator to join our remote team and play an important role in keeping our Salesforce environment organized, reliable, and continuously improving.



This is a hands-on offshore role where you’ll work closely with U.S.-based teams across operations, intake, recruiting, billing, and leadership. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of real Salesforce projects, solve day-to-day challenges, and help build systems that make the business run more efficiently.



If you enjoy figuring out how things work, turning business needs into practical Salesforce solutions, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll fit right in.



What You’ll Do

- Manage the day-to-day Salesforce environment, including users, profiles, permission sets, roles, queues, fields, page layouts, record types, reports, dashboards, flows, and validation rules.

- Build and maintain reports and dashboards that help teams and leadership make better decisions.

- Perform data imports, exports, updates, cleanup, deduplication, and quality checks to keep our data accurate and reliable.

- Troubleshoot Salesforce issues, investigate root causes, and implement practical solutions.

- Work directly with internal stakeholders to understand their needs and translate business requirements into clean Salesforce configurations.

- Test new configurations and changes thoroughly before they go live.

- Clearly document configuration changes, processes, and troubleshooting steps.

- Support integrations and connected tools when needed.

- Identify opportunities to improve existing Salesforce processes and make them more efficient, scalable, and user-friendly.

- Help maintain a Salesforce environment that is clean, organized, and easy for teams to use.



What We’re Looking For

- 1+ year of hands-on Salesforce Administrator experience.

- Strong understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, permissions, sharing, reports, dashboards, and automation.

- Experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting Salesforce Flows.

- Comfortable working with data imports, exports, updates, deduplication, and cleanup.

- Ability to understand business requirements and turn them into effective Salesforce solutions.

- Strong attention to detail and a habit of double-checking your work.

- Good written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote/offshore environment.

- Reliable availability with some overlap with U.S. business hours.



Nice to Have

- Salesforce Administrator Certification.

- Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Health Cloud.

- Basic understanding of Apex, SOQL, or how to work with developers when a request goes beyond Salesforce configuration.

- Experience supporting healthcare, ABA, recruiting, intake, billing, or operations teams.

- Previous experience working with U.S.-based companies or international teams.

- Experience in a fast-moving startup or growth-stage company.



What Makes This Role Different

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply work through tickets all day. We’re looking for someone who can think through problems, understand the “why” behind a request, ask thoughtful questions, and build solutions that actually make people’s work easier.



You’ll have meaningful ownership over the Salesforce environment and the opportunity to improve systems that are used across different areas of the business. As you become familiar with our processes, we want you to bring ideas to the table, not just follow instructions.



You’ll work with a U.S.-based team while having the flexibility and independence of a remote role. It’s a great opportunity for someone in the Philippines who wants to grow their Salesforce expertise, gain international work experience, and have a real impact on a growing company.



If you’re someone who is...

- Naturally curious and enjoys solving problems

- Good at connecting business needs with technical solutions

- Organized and careful with details

- Comfortable taking ownership and working independently

- Confident communicating with an international team

- Excited to keep learning and improving



We’d love to hear from you.

title: Appointment Setter Intern - Beginner Friendly
description:
# Appointment Setter Internship – Beginner Friendly | $250 First Month



SHOOT ME A TEXT TO APPLY ON 
 (317)
We are looking for a motivated **Appointment Setter Intern** who wants to gain real-world experience in online sales, lead generation, and social media appointment setting.



**No previous appointment-setting experience is required.**



This opportunity is specifically designed for someone who is hungry to learn, coachable, dependable, and looking to develop a valuable skill that can lead to a long-term opportunity.



## Work Schedule



**Tuesday – Saturday**

**6:00 PM – 10:00 PM Eastern Time (ET)**

**4 hours per day / 20 hours per week**



You must be available and actively working for the entire scheduled shift.



During every shift, you will be expected to:



* Message me when you **clock in**

* Message me when you **clock out**

* Stay actively working and managing prospect conversations

* Remain in communication throughout your shift

* Respond to me within **20 minutes during working hours**

* Communicate immediately if there is ever an issue, emergency, or reason you cannot complete your responsibilities

* Complete your assigned prospecting and follow-ups before clocking out



Reliability and communication are extremely important for this position.



## Compensation



The first month of the internship pays **$250 USD**.



The goal of this internship is to give a beginner the opportunity to receive hands-on training, develop real appointment-setting skills, and potentially earn a long-term position on our team.



## 7-Day Performance Trial



Your first **7 working days will serve as a performance-based trial period within the internship.**



You are NOT expected to be an expert during your first week.



We understand that you are learning.



What we are looking for is your ability to:



* Show up consistently

* Follow instructions

* Communicate

* Take feedback

* Implement what you're taught

* Put in effort

* Improve each day



After the 7-day trial, we will evaluate your performance and determine whether you will continue through the remainder of the internship.



If you meet the standards expected during the trial, you will move forward with the full internship.



## Daily Standards During Your Trial



Every day, you are expected to:



* Show up on time for your scheduled shift

* Message me when you clock in

* Message me when you clock out

* Start and manage conversations with prospects

* Follow the scripts and training provided

* Complete your assigned follow-ups

* Stay in communication throughout your shift

* Respond to me within 20 minutes during working hours

* Communicate immediately if there is ever an issue

* Take feedback without becoming defensive

* Implement corrections and coaching

* Keep track of conversations and booked appointments

* Remain professional when communicating with prospects

* Show consistent effort throughout your entire shift



Repeated lateness, disappearing during shifts, failing to communicate, ignoring instructions, or consistently failing to complete assigned work may result in you not continuing with the internship.



## What You Will Learn



### Starting Conversations



You will learn how to naturally start conversations with potential prospects without sounding robotic, pushy, or spammy.



### Managing Conversations



You will learn how to keep conversations moving forward, ask good questions, understand someone's situation, and identify potential opportunities.



### Qualifying Leads



You will learn how to determine whether someone is a qualified potential client based on their:



* Goals

* Current struggles

* Motivation

* Urgency

* Situation

* Willingness to make a change



Your job is NOT to convince everyone.



Your job is to identify the right people and move qualified prospects toward the next step.



### Following Our Scripts



You will receive scripts, examples, and frameworks to help guide your conversations.



However, we do NOT want someone who blindly copies and pastes messages.



You will learn how to follow a framework while still communicating naturally based on what the prospect actually tells you.



### Following Up With Prospects



You will learn how to properly follow up with people who:



* Stop responding

* Show interest but don't book

* Say they need more time

* Have previously interacted with our content or business



Follow-up will be an important part of your daily responsibilities.



### Booking Qualified Appointments



The primary goal of your role is to turn qualified conversations into **booked sales calls**.



You are NOT responsible for closing the sale.



Your responsibility is to:



**Start Conversation → Understand Their Problem → Qualify → Build Interest → Book the Call**



### Communication & Professionalism



You will also learn how to work professionally as part of a remote sales team.



That includes:



* Communicating problems immediately

* Staying accountable

* Taking coaching

* Tracking your work

* Managing your time

* Following processes

* Becoming increasingly independent



## What We Will Evaluate During Your 7-Day Trial



Your trial is not based solely on how many appointments you book.



Because this is a beginner-level position, we will primarily evaluate:



* Did you show up on time every day?

* Did you properly clock in and clock out?

* Did you stay active throughout your shift?

* Did you communicate consistently?

* Did you respond within 20 minutes?

* Did you complete your assigned work?

* Did you start conversations consistently?

* Did you manage conversations properly?

* Did you complete your follow-ups?

* Did you follow the scripts and training?

* Did you implement feedback?

* Are your conversations improving?

* Are you becoming better at identifying qualified prospects?

* Are you taking initiative?

* Are you someone we can trust to eventually work independently?



**We expect beginners to make mistakes.**



Making a mistake will not automatically disqualify you.



What matters is whether you listen, learn, correct the mistake, and avoid repeatedly making the same mistakes.



## After the First Month



At the end of the 30-day internship, your overall performance will be reviewed.



Interns who demonstrate strong:



* Reliability

* Communication

* Coachability

* Work ethic

* Consistency

* Improvement

* Lead qualification

* Appointment-setting ability



may be offered the opportunity to continue in a **long-term appointment setter position with increased compensation and performance incentives.**



Our goal is to find someone we can train and develop into a valuable long-term member of the team.



## Who We're Looking For



This position is ideal for someone who:



* Wants to break into online sales

* Wants real appointment-setting experience

* Is willing to start as a beginner

* Has strong written English

* Is comfortable communicating with people online

* Is dependable

* Is coachable

* Can follow instructions

* Takes accountability

* Has good communication skills

* Wants to improve

* Is willing to work Tuesday through Saturday

* Can consistently work 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM Eastern Time

* Wants the opportunity to earn a long-term position



We would rather work with someone who has **zero experience but is hungry, coachable, and reliable** than someone with experience who has poor work ethic.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Why do you want to learn appointment setting?

2. Do you have any experience with social media, customer service, sales, or communicating with people online?

3. Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this internship?

4. Can you consistently work **Tuesday through Saturday from 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM Eastern Time?**

5. Where would you like to be professionally within the next 1–2 years?



### IMPORTANT



Start your application with the keyword:



**SETTER250**



If your application does not begin with **SETTER250**, it may not be reviewed.



This is intentional. We want people who pay attention to instructions.



We are looking for someone who may be a beginner today but has the **work ethic, hunger, communication, and coachability to become an excellent appointment setter.**

* Be comfortable using CapCut

* Understand short-form pacing and viewer retention

* Have strong English comprehension

* Be able to follow detailed instructions

* Have reliable internet

* Communicate consistently

* Be comfortable with recurring weekly deadlines

* Be interested in a long-term position

Pay

How to Apply

title: Fractional GRC & Information Security Compliance Consultant
description:
# Fractional GRC & Information Security Compliance Consultant



### GDPR, Cyber Essentials, IASME & ISO 27001 Readiness



Votari is an early-stage UK election-technology company building verifiable digital voting infrastructure.



We are looking for a hands-on **GRC / Information Security Compliance Consultant** to take ownership of our privacy, security and certification readiness.



This is not a strategy-only advisory role.



We already have substantial technical architecture documentation, a Data Protection Impact Assessment, privacy documentation, data-flow analysis and existing GDPR/security research. We need someone who can take that foundation and turn it into an operational compliance programme.



The immediate objectives are:



* Bring our GDPR compliance documentation up to date

* Complete our Record of Processing Activities

* Review our controller / processor position and data-processing relationships

* Review subprocessors, international transfers and DPAs

* Update privacy, retention, DSAR and breach-response procedures

* Maintain and update our DPIA

* Build a practical security risk register

* Formalise core information-security policies

* Prepare and guide us through Cyber Essentials

* Prepare for IASME Cyber Assurance

* Establish the foundations for ISO 27001 certification

* Organise evidence and documentation suitable for enterprise and government procurement



You would act as the operational owner of the process and coordinate specialist legal, penetration-testing or certification providers where required.



## What we are looking for



We are particularly interested in someone who has personally taken small technology companies or SaaS businesses through compliance and certification programmes.



Strong experience in several of the following is important:



* ISO 27001 implementation

* Cyber Essentials / Cyber Essentials Plus

* IASME Cyber Assurance

* GDPR operational compliance

* Record of Processing Activities

* DPIAs

* Information-security risk management

* Security policies and control frameworks

* Supplier / subprocessor reviews

* Cloud and SaaS environments

* Enterprise security questionnaires

* Government or regulated-industry procurement



Useful professional credentials include:



* ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

* ISO 27001 Lead Auditor

* CIPP/E

* CISM

* CISSP

* IASME / Cyber Essentials experience



Certifications are useful, but practical implementation experience matters more.



## Important



We are not looking for:



* a generic cybersecurity consultant

* a penetration tester

* a lawyer

* someone who only produces high-level compliance presentations

* someone whose experience is primarily managing compliance teams inside large enterprises



We need someone comfortable doing the actual work: reviewing systems, writing policies, creating registers, gathering evidence, closing gaps and driving certification activity through to completion.



## Initial engagement



We expect the initial engagement to run for approximately **8–12 weeks**, initially around **one day per week**, with flexibility around assessment or certification periods.



If the engagement works well, this may continue as a lighter fractional compliance role.



## When applying



Please answer the following:



1. Tell us about one company with fewer than approximately 20 employees that you personally helped through Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001 or a similar compliance programme.



2. What did you personally produce or implement during that engagement?



3. Have you personally prepared a company for ISO 27001 certification? If yes, what parts of the process did you own?



4. What experience do you have implementing GDPR operational requirements such as RoPA, DPIAs, processor registers, retention policies, DSAR procedures and breach-response processes?



5. Have you worked with UK Cyber Essentials or IASME Cyber Assurance?



6. If you joined Votari next week, what would you expect to complete during your first 30 days?



Please include your expected hourly or daily rate and your availability.



Generic AI-generated proposals that do not address the questions above will not be considered.

title: General Admin for tradie - exp in Quickbooks, Asana, ServiceM8
description:
A busy, relationship-driven construction/trades business owner needs a Virtual Assistant to take quoting, scheduling support, invoicing, and bookkeeping off his plate so he can stay focused on the field. This is a genuine clean-slate hire — the business's existing admin support is being retired entirely, not restructured, so the new VA will build these functions from the ground up rather than inheriting a working system.



The core challenge is that virtually everything currently lives in the owner's head — job details, client history, scheduling logic, and financial tracking. The right VA will be comfortable learning the business exactly as it runs today (informal, relationship-driven, low-tech) before introducing structure, and confident enough to make suggestions once they understand the business, without ever getting in the way of the personal relationships the owner has built with clients over 25 years.



Success in the first 30 days looks like: the inbox cleaned up and organised, unpaid invoices actively being chased, the VA fluent in how QuickBooks Online is currently used, and the first SOPs starting to take shape from live handover sessions with the owner.



What You'll Own



Quoting & Proposals



Convert quote requests that come in by text, photo, or voice message into proper written proposals

Use the existing Word-based proposal template and reference past proposals for similar jobs so wording, detail, and line-item style stays consistent

Keep proposals thorough and detailed — plenty of line items, even on smaller jobs

Draft proposals from voice messages describing a job, researching similar past jobs or clients as needed

Create reusable templates for recurring project types over time

Design and implement a clear file-naming convention and filing system for proposals and job documents from scratch



Scheduling & Job Coordination



Help build a consistent, structured weekly schedule for crews, supporting the owner in holding to it rather than jobs constantly bumping each other

Build simple crew profiles over time (core skills, strengths, jobs to avoid) once familiar with the team

Research and help set up a trades scheduling/quoting/invoicing platform as the business's system of record (not required from day one)



Invoicing & Cash Flow



Manage a mix of billing types: AIA billing, bi-weekly progress billing on longer jobs, and end-of-job invoicing on smaller ones

Set up and run a consistent invoicing rhythm, including structured follow-up on unpaid invoices

Follow up on currently outstanding invoices as an immediate priority

Help create predictable, consistent collections to close cash flow gaps



Bookkeeping & Financial Admin



Maintain QuickBooks Online and help bring it up to date in real time — currently only updated after the fact

Track what's owed and what needs to be paid, working from the owner's existing spreadsheet-based job and invoice tracking

Build a proper project ledger — assign a project name or number to every job, past and current

Formalise a daily crew location log (currently handwritten) into a system that can feed weekly payroll

Payroll is currently run outside QuickBooks; moving it in is future scope, not a day-one task



Client & Project Communication



Help set up a dedicated client communication channel per client or project so requests don't only land on the owner's personal number

Draft quotes from incoming requests for the owner's approval before they go out

Handle some direct phone communication with clients and contractors as the role matures



 & Inbox Management



Set up a proper business
 address and clean up/organise the owner's inbox — unsubscribing from marketing noise and surfacing what actually needs a response

Possibly send or draft correspondence on the owner's behalf

Review the inbox thoroughly in week one — supplier relationships, invoice history, and industry language are all sitting in there



Daily Rhythm & Reporting



Send a message at the start of each shift outlining the day's priorities

Send an end-of-day report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and anything needing review or approval

Maintain a running task list to track ad hoc requests sent throughout the day (often via voice message) so nothing is lost between check-ins



Process Documentation



Document each task as a simple SOP as it's handed over via live, screen-shared handover calls — this becomes the ongoing knowledge base for the business



Week One Priorities



Review the inbox in full — a high-value way to learn suppliers, industry language, and current business context

Get familiar with QuickBooks Online exactly as currently set up

Begin following up on currently outstanding/unpaid invoices — immediate, tangible value with minimal ramp-up needed



What We're Looking For



Experience



Prior experience working with trades or construction clients, ideally supporting multiple clients or projects in a fast-paced environment

Hands-on bookkeeping experience, including reconciliation, expense allocation, and job costing

Experience supporting a business owner who is largely off-site/on the road, with limited real-time availability



Technical Proficiency



QuickBooks Online: mandatory, confident working knowledge (Online version, not Desktop)

A trades scheduling/invoicing platform (e.g. ServiceM8 or similar): a strong advantage, not currently mandatory

Microsoft Word: comfortable building and formatting detailed, multi-line-item proposals

Microsoft 365/Outlook: comfortable managing and organising a business inbox

Comfortable with day-to-day virtual team tools (messaging apps, video calls, call recording/note-taking, task management); training provided on specific setup

Basic website/web publishing skills: a nice-to-have, not a non-negotiable



Organisational Skills



Able to design and maintain a clear, logical filing and naming system from scratch

Comfortable building a project ledger and tracking system for jobs, invoices, and crew allocation



Non-Negotiables



Genuinely proactive — comfortable flagging a better way of doing something without being asked

Comfortable working from voice messages and informal, on-the-fly instructions rather than always expecting things in writing

Able to absorb instructions the first time — retains process detail without needing repeated explanation

Familiarity with construction/subcontractor billing structures (AIA billing, progress billing, retainage-style invoicing) is a strong plus

Willing to learn the business's current, informal way of working first, before introducing new structure or systems

Comfortable being the one to research and recommend a platform rather than being handed a fully defined system

Warm, relationship-minded communicator who supports a long-standing, relationship-driven client base without making interactions feel transactional

Comfortable working with minimal daily contact when the owner is flat out on-site, and equally comfortable stepping up when more support is needed

Discreet and trustworthy — will have visibility into financial and client information

Patient through a genuinely from-scratch build — early weeks involve construction, not just handover



Why This Role



Real ownership: build the business's admin, scheduling, and financial systems from the ground up

Fast, tangible early wins — chasing outstanding invoices from week one

Clear path from part-time to full-time as the role and trust develop

Direct, close working relationship with the business owner as systems come together



How to Apply

title: Customer Success VA
description:
Alexen Academy is looking for a confident, organized, and resourceful communicator as Customer Success VA to help our customers navigate the process of finding and pursuing waste hauling opportunities for truck drivers.



This is a customer-facing role that combines Zoom presentations, member support, research, and accountability.



What You'll Do:



* Host the enrollment portion of our Free Waste Classon Zoom and answer prospective member questions.

* Conduct initial Zoom intake calls with new members and explain how the Customer Success process works.

* Learn each member's market, trucking situation, and goals.

* Research potential waste hauling contracts, companies, facilities, bids, subcontracting opportunities, and decision-makers.

* Provide members with clear research and recommended next steps.

* Help members understand who to contact, what to do next, and how to follow up.

* Track member progress and keep members moving instead of allowing opportunities to go cold.

* Direct members to the appropriate Alexen Academy training and resources when needed.

* Communicate professionally with customers through Zoom, phone, SMS, and our support systems.



We're Looking for Someone Who Is:



* Confident speaking and presenting on Zoom.

* A strong communicator who can explain processes simply.

* Excellent at online research and finding information.

* Organized and able to manage multiple members and opportunities.

* Comfortable holding people accountable while still providing strong support.

* Resourceful and willing to investigate before saying, "I don't know."

* Able to learn our Waste Management System and become highly knowledgeable about our process.

* Comfortable working independently and following established systems.



Experience Preferred (Not Required):



*Customer Success or Member Support

*Client Onboarding

*Sales Support or Enrollment

*Trucking/Logistics

*Contracts/Procurement

*Appointment Setting



Hours: 24 hours/week for 3-4 week training then 40 hours/week; Must be available Thursday and Sunday evenings ET



REPLY WITH A COVER LETTER, RESUME, MINIMUM HOURLY RATE AND ENUSRE YOUR DISC PROFILE IS COMPLETED



This is NOT simply a customer service position.



We are looking for someone who can understand where a customer is stuck, research solutions and opportunities, communicate confidently build a relationship, and help that member determine their next best action.



If you enjoy solving problems, researching opportunities, working directly with people, and helping people execute a proven process, we want to hear from you.

title: (AMBITIOUS) SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Want to edit for a small creator that's blowing up?



If you are an ambitious editor who is looking for a long-term opportunity, this is for you.



You must have experience editing short-form narrative-driven videos that performed well (at least +30 posted videos), ideally with experience editing the "Choose your Character" videos. You should have a strong understanding of retention editing



We create short, live-action choose-your-own-adventure horror videos where viewers choose between characters played by the model and see each outcome. The stories center on cosmic horror, especially one character, a dominant goth obsessed with forbidden knowledge and summoning Lovecraftian entities.



To see what our inspiration is, search for "Choose your partner for tonight" videos. Picture something like that but live-action



Our videos average 29 seconds and we post daily, we started the account 3 months ago and we already went viral (+500k views) with 20k followers. We have multiple videos above 100k views and with your help we can increase both the quality and quantity of our videos



Benefits of the role:

You'll have an opportunity to bring your own creative input, work closely with people who are passionate about making better videos, and take on greater responsibility as the team grows.
