title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: # AI VIDEO EDITOR for DTC Ecommerce Brand $2.5k/m
description:
We are a **DTC supplement brand** in the health and wellness space looking for an **AI UGC Creative Specialist** who can create highly realistic AI UGC ads using advanced AI video tools like Flow, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling, Runway, ElevenLabs, CapCut, Premiere Pro, and similar tools.



This role is mainly focused on **realistic AI UGC**.



We are not looking for basic editors, simple HeyGen talking head videos, generic AI avatar content, podcast clips, info product edits, or low-quality AI slop.



**DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE A REAL PORTFOLIO OF AI UGC ADS MADE FOR DIRECT RESPONSE ECOMMERCE OR DTC BRANDS.**



## What We Need



We need someone who can create realistic AI UGC that feels native, believable, and performance-driven.



You should be able to create:



* Realistic AI customer testimonials

* Selfie-style talking head videos

* AI doctor or expert-style videos

* Natural-looking AI avatars that feel like real people

* Direct response video ads for ecommerce brands

* Scroll-stopping hooks, strong pacing, captions, B-roll, voiceover, and final edits

* **3D animated ads in claymation and Pixar-style animation for product storytelling**



We want someone who understands how to make ads that get people to **stop scrolling, watch, click, and buy**.



While the main focus of this role is realistic AI UGC, the ability to create **high-quality 3D animated ads, claymation, Pixar-style visuals, and cinematic AI scenes for product storytelling** is also highly valued.



The main thing we care about is whether you can create **realistic AI UGC for direct response ecommerce ads**.



## Requirements



You must have experience creating AI UGC ads for ecommerce or DTC brands.



You must understand direct response advertising, hooks, pacing, retention, emotional angles, and conversion-focused editing.



You must be strong with advanced AI tools, especially Flow, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling, Runway, ElevenLabs, or similar tools.



Experience creating **3D animated, claymation, and Pixar-style product ads** is a strong plus.



You must be able to work from scripts, references, briefs, hooks, and creative direction.



You must be reliable, responsive, and able to hit deadlines without being chased.



You must be able to work Monday to Friday.



You must be able to handle around **8–12 briefs per week**.



Most briefs will be **3–4 minutes long** and may include AI footage, voiceover, captions, pacing, B-roll, and final delivery.



## Compensation



Up to **$2,500 per month** depending on experience, output, quality, and reliability.



There is also room for incentives and performance-based bonuses for the right person.



We are looking for someone long-term who wants to grow with the brand.



## How To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio

2. Examples of realistic AI UGC ads you have made

3. Examples of AI UGC ads made specifically for ecommerce, DTC, health, skincare, supplements, wellness, or similar brands

4. Examples of any **3D animated, claymation, Pixar-style, or cinematic AI product ads** you have created

5. A list of the AI tools you are strongest with

6. The brands you have worked with

7. Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday

8. Confirmation that you can handle 8–12 briefs per week

9. A short explanation of your workflow for creating realistic AI UGC using tools like Flow, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling, or Runway



**DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ONLY MAKE BASIC HEYGEN VIDEOS.**



**DO NOT APPLY IF YOUR PORTFOLIO IS ONLY PODCAST CLIPS, INFO PRODUCT CONTENT, OR BASIC EDITING WORK.**



**DO NOT APPLY IF YOU HAVE NOT WORKED WITH DIRECT RESPONSE ECOMMERCE OR DTC BRANDS.**



We are only looking for someone who can create **realistic AI UGC ads that are built for performance.**

title: Operations Manager
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER



Remote — Philippines | Full-time | Monday–Friday | 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applications sent through this platform's messaging system will not be reviewed.



Apply only here:





After submitting Tally, applicants who pass the initial requirements will be directed to a short recorded video pre-interview. Your application is not complete until both steps are submitted.



THE OPPORTUNITY



MajestIQ is hiring a high-ownership Operations Manager to become a long-term cornerstone of the company and grow toward a future Director of Operations role.



MajestIQ supports established Amazon sellers by preparing and submitting evidence concerning policy-violating and inauthentic review content. Amazon makes every final decision.



We are looking for a strong operator who can learn the business from the inside out, bring order to moving parts, build clear systems, help train future team members, and lead operations as the company expands.



The role begins hands-on. You will work closely with the founder, attend key meetings, learn how each part of the business operates, and steadily take on more ownership. The right person will help build and lead the team that grows beneath them.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Learn and organize the business



- Attend key meetings and learn how the business operates across teams, clients, systems, and daily workflows.

- Learn existing processes thoroughly before recommending or making improvements.

- Keep projects, information, follow-ups, and internal documentation organized.

- Turn verbal processes and working knowledge into clear, usable SOPs and checklists.

- Identify recurring workflow problems and opportunities to handle operations more consistently.



Improve operations and SOPs



- Help build simple, practical operating systems that people can actually use.

- Improve SOPs over time as the business learns what works.

- Maintain recurring workflows with clear ownership, high quality standards, and organized documentation.

- Support better processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.



Help build the future team



- Help onboard new team members as MajestIQ grows.

- Support training, documentation, and role clarity for future hires.

- Become a dependable resource for people who eventually work under you.

- Grow into managing team members, work quality, and operational follow-through as the company expands.



Support approved review operations



- After training, spend roughly two hours per day preparing and submitting approved review-related evidence through established SOPs.

- Follow approved processes carefully and escalate anything uncertain or outside the established rules.

- Do not invent arguments, make unsupported claims, or handle high-risk exceptions independently.



Work comfortably in a modern technology environment



- Use modern software, AI-enabled tools, automation, documentation systems, and technical platforms as part of normal operations.

- Use Slack confidently for channels, threads, search, huddles, reminders, workflow coordination, and clear written follow-through.

- You do not need to be a programmer or AI expert, but you must be comfortable learning and using new tools.

- This role is not a fit for someone who avoids new software or resists technology-driven ways of working.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should take pride in being reliable, organized, thoughtful, and capable.



- Exceptional spoken English and polished professional writing.

- Strong judgment and the ability to communicate clearly in meetings.

- Excellent organization and a habit of following through.

- The ability to learn unfamiliar workflows without constant hand-holding.

- Evidence that you have improved a process, created documentation, organized complex work, or helped a team operate better.

- Leadership potential, even if you have not formally managed a large team before.

- Interest in staying with one company, learning the business deeply, and growing into a larger role.

- Comfort using modern software, AI-enabled tools, automation, and technical platforms.

- Strong Slack fluency: you must be well versed in channels, threads, search, huddles, reminders, and turning conversations into clear follow-up.

- A stable work environment and the ability to reliably work the required overnight Philippines schedule.



Amazon Seller Central, e-commerce operations, or experience supporting an Amazon-focused business is strongly preferred. It is not mandatory for an exceptional operations candidate with the communication skills, judgment, and long-term potential this role requires.



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, Monday through Friday.

- 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time.

- This is an evening-to-overnight schedule in the Philippines.

- The U.S. Eastern Time schedule is controlling. Because the United States observes daylight saving time, the corresponding Philippine clock time shifts by one hour during the year.

- You must be present for key meetings and normal operating hours.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



- Starting rate: $11/hour.

- After 90 days: $12/hour.

- After 6 months: $13/hour.

- Paid Philippine holidays.

- Eligibility for performance bonuses tied to real operational results.



Strong performance can lead to increasing responsibility and a Director of Operations path as the team grows.



HIRING PROCESS



We expect significant interest in this role. To respect everyone's time and keep the process fair, the hiring process is structured:



1. Short Tally application with role-fit and availability questions.

2. Required recorded video pre-interview, approximately 10–12 minutes total.

3. Scorecard-based review and shortlist.

4. Short practical exercise for finalists.

5. Final conversation with the founder for only the strongest candidates.

6. References and a paid two-week trial: four hours per day, Monday through Friday.

7. Full-time offer for the right long-term fit.



The recorded pre-interview includes a simple practice check and a few time-limited questions. It is not designed to be an unreasonable test. It helps us understand communication, judgment, commitment, and role fit before scheduling live conversations.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not apply or send a generic cover letter through this platform.



Complete the MajestIQ application using the Tally link at the top of this post.



Applicants who pass the initial Tally requirements will see a button to begin the recorded HireVire pre-interview. Click that button and complete the interview; both steps are required for a complete application.



If you are highly organized, communicate exceptionally well, work comfortably with modern technology, and want to build a long-term career inside a growing company, we would like to hear from you.

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist
description:
SENIOR GOOGLE ADS SPECIALIST

321 Web Marketing | Full-Time, Remote (Metro Manila, Philippines)



Classification: Full-time

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Director of Marketing

Positions: 1

Compensation: $10 - $15 USD per hour, 40 hours per week

Location: Remote. Must be based in Metro Manila, Philippines.

Schedule: Full-time on U.S. Eastern Time (approx. 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM PHT, Mon-Fri)



=====================================



THE ROLE



We're looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist who lives and breathes paid search and writes like a native English speaker. Someone who can take full ownership of Google Ads accounts, from strategy and structure through daily optimization and reporting, and consistently turn ad spend into qualified leads. You'll also produce the content that makes those campaigns convert: ad copy, landing page copy, and supporting campaign content.



This is a behind-the-scenes execution and strategy role. You will not present to clients or sit in client meetings. Instead, you'll be the engine behind our campaigns: building, optimizing, analyzing, and packaging insights so clearly that our U.S.-based account managers can walk into client meetings with confidence. Your work speaks through the numbers and through crisp, well-written internal reporting.



You'll manage paid campaigns across a portfolio of U.S.-based B2B and B2C clients in industries like IT/cybersecurity, insurance, financial services, healthcare, and home services. Each account has different goals, budgets, and conversion economics. You'll learn those differences and manage each account like it's your own money.



=====================================



WHAT YOU'LL DO



OWN GOOGLE ADS END TO END

- Build, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing) across multiple client accounts with monthly budgets of $5,000+

- Own account structure: campaign architecture, ad groups, keyword strategy, match types, negative keyword management, and audience segmentation

- Write compelling, conversion-focused ad copy in clear, natural English

- Manage bidding strategies, budget pacing, and quality score optimization to maximize ROI

- Run structured A/B tests on copy, landing pages, and bidding approaches, and document what you learn

- Flag landing page and website issues that limit campaign performance, with specific recommendations



ANALYZE AND REPORT

- Monitor performance daily across GA4, Google Ads, and Google Search Console

- Set up and maintain accurate conversion tracking (including GTM-based tracking and offline conversion imports where needed)

- Translate raw performance data into clear written insights and recommendations that account managers can relay directly to clients

- Prepare monthly performance summaries: what happened, why it happened, and what we're doing next



CREATE SUPPORTING CONTENT

- Write landing page copy, ad copy variations, and conversion-focused website content that aligns with each client's brand voice

- Draft
 and remarketing copy for lead nurture sequences tied to your campaigns

- Adapt tone and voice across clients and industries. Content for a cybersecurity firm should not read like content for a home services company.

- Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, but deliver content that sounds like a skilled human wrote it, because one did



COMMUNICATE PROACTIVELY (INTERNALLY)

- Surface problems early: budget anomalies, tracking breaks, performance dips, policy disapprovals

- Keep your account managers informed without being prompted. If something changed in an account, they should hear it from you first.

- Write clearly. Your Slack messages, reports, and documentation should be as sharp as your campaigns. Strong written English is essential in this role.



=====================================



WHO YOU ARE



- You're a Google Ads expert. 5+ years in digital marketing with deep, hands-on Google Ads experience. You've personally managed accounts with $5,000+ monthly budgets from strategy through optimization, and you can point to the results.



- You think in ROI. You don't optimize for clicks or impressions. You optimize for cost per qualified lead and return on ad spend, and you can explain the difference in your sleep.



- You're data-fluent. GA4, Google Ads reporting, Search Console, spreadsheets. You can find the story in the data and explain it in plain English.



- Your written English is excellent, full stop. Not "good for a second language." Your writing is clear, natural, idiomatic, and free of the small tells that make copy feel off to a U.S. audience. This will be assessed rigorously at every stage of the hiring process.



- You're a strong copywriter. Your ad copy, landing pages, and
 sequences read like a skilled marketer wrote them. You understand voice, flow, and structure, and you adapt them per client.



- You're self-directed. Give you an account, a budget, and a goal, and you'll come back with a plan and results. You don't need hand-holding, and you work well independently on a U.S. schedule.



- You're detail-obsessed. Tracking pixels, UTM parameters, conversion actions, budget caps. The small things that break campaigns don't get past you.



- You're AI-open. You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to accelerate research, copy iteration, and analysis, but your judgment drives every decision.



=====================================



QUALIFICATIONS



- 5+ years in digital marketing with a proven track record managing Google Ads campaigns

- Demonstrated experience managing ad accounts with budgets of $5,000+ per month from start to finish

- Proficiency with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console

- Demonstrated copywriting ability: ad copy, landing pages, or marketing content for English-speaking (ideally U.S.) audiences, with samples

- Near-native written English. This is a hard requirement and will be assessed through a writing sample, a timed writing exercise, and interviews.

- Based in Metro Manila, Philippines, with reliable high-speed internet and a professional home office setup

- Able to work full-time on U.S. Eastern Time (approx. 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM PHT)



PREFERRED

- Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications

- Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and how paid and organic strategies interact

- Experience with
/Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, or LinkedIn Ads

- Experience working with U.S.-based agencies or clients

- Familiarity with CRM and
 platforms (HubSpot, MailChimp, Klaviyo)

- Experience with call tracking platforms (CallRail or similar)



=====================================



HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS



During your first 90 days, we'll be looking at:



- Account performance: Are CPL, conversion rates, and ROAS trending in the right direction on the accounts you own?

- Tracking integrity: Is conversion tracking accurate and complete across your accounts?

- Reporting quality: Can account managers take your written insights into client meetings without rework?

- Content quality: Does your copy sound natural, on-brand, and ready to publish with minimal editing? Target is approval in one revision round or fewer after initial ramp-up.

- Proactive communication: Do we hear about problems from you before we discover them ourselves?

- Reliability: Do you meet deadlines, keep your queue clean, and hold your schedule consistently?

- Initiative: Are you bringing optimization ideas and test proposals to the table, or waiting to be told what to do?



=====================================



REPORTING AND GROWTH



- Reports to: Director of Marketing

- Collaborates with: U.S.-based account managers, SEO team, content team

- Review cadence: Weekly 1:1 during first 60 days, biweekly thereafter

- Compensation: $10 - $15 USD per hour, 40 hours per week



=====================================



ABOUT 321 WEB MARKETING



321 Web Marketing is an inbound lead strategy agency. We help B2B companies generate qualified leads through SEO, PPC, content, and generative AI. Our clients are typically $5M-50M+ organizations that have invested in marketing but aren't getting the results they need.



We're deliberate about what we take on, and we do it well. Our core values are active listening, drive, team accountability, proactive problem solving, growth through learning, and ROI-driven decision-making.



We're a remote-first team that moves with urgency, not emergency. If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to hear from you.

**Compensation:** dependent on experience

**Hours:** 20/40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

**Review:** 90-Day Performance Review with opportunity for compensation growth



This position is ideal for someone with strong bookkeeping, billing, payroll, and administrative accounting skills who wants to become an important part of the financial operations of a growing U.S. law firm.



**RESPONSIBILITIES**



You will be responsible for supporting the firm's day-to-day financial and billing operations, including:



• Preparing and processing payroll and contractor payments

• Preparing client invoices and reviewing billing entries for accuracy

• Monitoring attorney and staff time entries and identifying missing entries

• Maintaining accounts-receivable records and tracking outstanding invoices

• Following established procedures for billing and collections

• Recording and categorizing firm income and operating expenses

• Maintaining organized transaction and supporting-documentation records

• Assisting with monthly bank reconciliations

• Maintaining vendor, subscription, and recurring-expense records

• Preparing monthly billing, A/R, expense, and financial reports

• Maintaining financial spreadsheets and internal accounting records

• Identifying duplicate, missing, inconsistent, or unusual transactions

• Coordinating with the firm's accountant/bookkeeper as directed

• Assisting with month-end and year-end financial organization

• Maintaining accurate records for audit and compliance purposes

• Supporting firm administrative and financial projects as assigned



**CLIENT TRUST ACCOUNTS**



The firm maintains attorney trust/IOLTA accounts subject to strict regulatory requirements. You may assist with authorized recordkeeping, documentation, and reconciliation functions. However, this position will not independently transfer, withdraw, disburse, or exercise control over client trust funds.



**QUALIFICATIONS**



The successful candidate should have:



• Prior bookkeeping, accounting, payroll, or billing experience

• Strong Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

• Experience with invoicing and accounts receivable

• Experience reconciling financial records

• Exceptional numerical accuracy and attention to detail

• Excellent written English

• Strong organizational and documentation skills

• Ability to identify discrepancies rather than simply enter data

Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins

title: Video Editor & AI Creative Strategist — Meta Ads (Ecommerce / Digital Products)
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor who specializes in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands? Can you look at a competitor's winning ad and immediately understand why it works — the hook, the pacing, the clip choice, the emotional beat — and replicate that thinking, not just the edit?

If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.

We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.

We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.

What you'll own:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

AI Scene Generation & Recreation: Hands-on fluency with AI video tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, and similar) to generate or recreate scenes and B-roll when what we have isn't enough — you don't wait for footage, you create it.

Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source or generate them autonomously. High-quality only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d
 pacing, cuts, and visual rhythm to maximize watch-through and conversion.

Strategic Input, Not Just Execution: We want a creative partner, not a pair of hands. You should actively propose new hooks, new formats, and new angles based on what you're seeing perform — not wait to be told what to test next.

Constant Trend Awareness: You're the kind of editor who's already testing a new AI tool or ad format before we ask about it. Staying ahead of trends in short-form ad creative is part of the job, not an extra.

Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

Reliable, On-Time Delivery: Every deadline is a real deadline. Late deliveries disrupt the whole ad pipeline, and consistency here matters as much as editing skill.

Position Requirements:

Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

Immediate or near-immediate start.

2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

Practical experience with AI video generation tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, or equivalents) — this is not optional, it's core to how we produce content now.

Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

A strategic, growth-minded approach — you think about what's next for the brand's creative, not just what's on today's task list.

Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

Genuine passion for the craft of editing, and for staying current with where it's heading.

What We Offer:

Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
The SEO Specialist is responsible for improving the company’s organic search visibility, increasing qualified website traffic, and supporting inbound lead generation through consistent SEO execution.



This role owns the day-to-day implementation and monitoring of SEO initiatives, including keyword strategy, website optimization, content recommendations, technical SEO monitoring, reporting, and coordination with the broader marketing team.



Success in this role is measured by consistent execution and measurable improvements in search visibility, organic traffic, rankings, and conversions — not simply by completing SEO tasks.



Core Responsibilities

1. SEO Strategy & Execution

- Conduct keyword research based on business priorities, target audiences, services, and search opportunities.

- Develop and maintain a keyword strategy and keyword mapping system.

- Optimize website pages, service pages, blogs, and landing pages for organic search.

- Manage on-page SEO, including:

     - Page titles and meta descriptions

     - Headers and content structure

     - Internal linking

     - Image optimization

     - URLs

     - Keyword placement and search intent alignment

- Identify opportunities to improve existing website content.

- Develop SEO recommendations and briefs for new content.

- Support off-page SEO initiatives, including backlink and partnership opportunities.

- Monitor technical SEO issues that may impact search visibility and coordinate fixes as needed.

- Monitor competitor SEO activity and identify opportunities for improvement.



2. SEO Performance & Reporting

- Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, conversions, and other agreed SEO metrics.

- Track whether SEO activities are contributing to qualified website inquiries and business growth.

- Identify declining pages, ranking losses, technical issues, and other risks early.

- Provide clear recommendations based on performance data.

- Maintain visibility into SEO initiatives currently in progress, completed, blocked, or planned.

- Prepare monthly SEO reports that explain:

     - What changed

     - What was completed

     - What improved or declined

     - Why performance changed

     - What will be done next



3. Content & Cross-Channel Alignment

- Work with the content and marketing teams to ensure content supports SEO priorities.

- Recommend topics based on keyword opportunities, search demand, competitor gaps, and business goals.

- Provide SEO briefs before new website or blog content is created.

- Ensure SEO priorities align with broader marketing campaigns.

- Collaborate with Sales and Client Success when needed to understand common customer questions, search behavior, and lead quality.



4.
 Marketing & Automation Support

Where applicable, the SEO Specialist will also support
 marketing initiatives by:

- Developing and maintaining
 campaigns aligned with marketing objectives.

- Segmenting audiences and personalizing messaging.

- Building and maintaining welcome, nurture, reactivation, and other automation workflows.

- Conducting A/B testing on subject lines, messaging, offers, and timing.

- Monitoring open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and engagement.

- Using SEO insights to support
 topics and using
 performance insights to inform content strategy.



Key Deliverables

Weekly

- SEO activity/progress update

- Current priorities and completed work

- Keyword/ranking movement

- Issues or blockers requiring escalation

- Next week's priorities



Monthly

- SEO performance report

- Organic traffic and conversion analysis

- Keyword ranking report

- Completed optimization summary

- Recommended actions for the following month



Quarterly

- Updated keyword mapping

- SEO strategy review

- Competitor/search opportunity analysis

- Content and optimization roadmap



Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The SEO Specialist will be evaluated based on both execution KPIs and outcome KPIs.



Execution KPIs

- % of planned SEO initiatives completed on time

- SEO content/optimization deliverables completed

- Reporting submitted on schedule

- Technical SEO issues identified and resolved/escalated

- Content briefs and recommendations completed

- Responsiveness and cross-functional collaboration



Outcome KPIs

- Organic traffic growth

- Growth in qualified organic inquiries/leads

- Improvement in rankings for priority keywords

- Search impressions and clicks

- Organic conversion rate

- Growth in ranking pages/keywords

- Performance of optimized pages

-
 open, click-through, and conversion rates where
 is included in scope

• Alex Jean



These are references for understanding the Christian hip hop market, culture, artist presentation, and content ecosystem.



However, we DO NOT want the content limited to Christian hip hop references.



You should also regularly study mainstream hip hop artists, creators, streamers, entertainment accounts, meme culture, TikTok trends, and other high performing social media content.



We want to take what is working across internet culture and creatively adapt it to a Christian hip hop artist without simply copying other people.



THIS IS NOT CORPORATE VIDEO EDITING



Please do not apply with a portfolio primarily consisting of:



• Real estate videos



• Restaurant content



• E commerce advertisements



• Corporate videos



• Basic podcast clips



• Talking head videos with automatic captions



• Generic business Reels



• Template based edits



Those examples do not help us evaluate whether you are right for this position.



We are specifically looking for music, artist, creator, entertainment, Gen Z, culture driven, or highly creative short form editing.



EXPERIENCE



Direct music industry experience is preferred but NOT required.



We care more about your creative ability than your resume.



If you are extremely talented at editing but have not had the opportunity to work with artists professionally yet, you are still encouraged to apply.



If your portfolio does not currently demonstrate this exact style but you believe you have the technical and creative ability to execute it, we may invite you to complete a paid test edit using our footage.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



We want someone who:



• Has excellent creative instincts



• Understands current social media culture



• Watches Reels and TikTok enough to know what is actually trending



• Is strong in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, or similar software



• Can edit quickly without sacrificing quality



• Understands hooks and retention



• Can recognize good moments inside raw footage



• Can bring their own ideas to an edit



• Does not need every transition, sound effect, caption, or cut explained to them



• Takes feedback well



• Communicates consistently



• Meets deadlines



• Wants a long term position rather than a temporary editing project



This position will initially be approximately 10 to 15 hours per week, with the opportunity for more work as the relationship and artist continue to grow.



IMPORTANT QUALITY STANDARD



We are not hiring simply because we need more editing capacity.



We are hiring because we want to improve the quality of the content.



Our artist already has professionally edited social media and music content.



The person we hire needs to be capable of eventually producing content that is at least at our current level and ideally better.



If modern music artist content, Gen Z editing, TikTok culture, and creative short form videos are not your strengths, this will probably not be the right position for you.



HOW TO APPLY



Please create ONE Google Drive folder and send us the link.



Your folder should contain:



1. Your Best 3 to 5 Relevant Videos



Only include examples that represent the type of editing we are hiring for.



We would rather see three incredible edits than twenty average ones.



Please prioritize:



• Music content



• Artist content



• Creator content



• Gen Z content



• Entertainment content



• Fast paced short form videos



• Creative social media edits



Please DO NOT fill the folder with unrelated business or corporate work.



2. Short Introduction



Include a short document answering:



Why does this specific position interest you?



What type of content do you personally enjoy editing?



Which creators or artists do you currently think have some of the best short form content?



What editing software do you use?



How many hours per week are you currently available?



3. Portfolio



You may also include your full portfolio if you have one, but make sure the 3 to 5 relevant videos are easy for us to find first.



NEXT STEP



Shortlisted applicants will receive additional information about the artist and current social media content.



At that stage, we will evaluate whether your creative style fits what we are building.



Some applicants may also be invited to complete a paid test edit.



We are looking for someone creative, hungry, current, dependable, and interested in building with us long term.

title: Shopify Admin Assistant (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
We're a performance marketing agency running paid media and CRO for about 10 DTC ecommerce brands. Our clients run their own stores day to day. We need someone to handle the Shopify changes our work requires — bulk edits, template rollouts, A/B test setup, shipping and promo changes — across those client stores.



This is project-based work, not daily store management.



What you'd do:



- Shipping: edit rates, add and configure shipping zones and regions, set up Shopify Markets

- Bulk product edits: filter products by collection, type or tag, then apply templates or update fields in the bulk editor

- Theme editor: duplicate the theme before any change, add and arrange sections and blocks, paste in code we give you, publish once approved

- Launch A/B tests in ABConvert, Intelligems or Elevate, and check both variants work on desktop and mobile before traffic goes live

- Set up and end promos on schedule: discount codes, automatic discounts, announcement bars

- General admin: collections, metafields, navigation, URL redirects, app settings

- Run test purchases to confirm tracking events are firing, screenshot the result, and tell us if they aren't

- Export data from Shopify analytics when we need it for reporting

- Keep a simple log of what you changed on each client store



What this role is not:



You won't be building or fixing tracking, troubleshooting product feeds, writing copy, or designing pages. We have people for that.



What we need from you:



- You've worked across multiple Shopify stores, not just one — agency, freelance or brand-side is all fine

- Comfortable in the theme editor on Online Store 2.0 themes, especially Dawn-based ones

- Basic HTML/CSS. You don't need to be a developer, but you should be able to paste a code block where we tell you without breaking the page

- You follow a checklist exactly, and when something isn't on the checklist you ask instead of guessing

- You never make changes to a live store without confirming first

- Clear written English, some overlap with US business hours



Details:



- Remote, ongoing

- $6-$12/hr, paid on the 1st and the 15th

- We cover the bank transfer fees

- You'll work across several client stores through our agency partner account



How to apply:



Send:

1. Which Shopify stores you've worked on and what you did on them

2. Your answer to this: a client has 200+ products and wants a new product template applied to everything in one collection. How would you do it?

3. Your hourly rate and weekly availability

title: Website Designer
description:
Web Designer & Builder (GHL + Shopify) — Full-Time Contractor

Company: The Digital Doula (Elya Consulting LLC)

Location: Remote

Commitment: Full-time contractor, 40 hrs/week

Reports to: Founder

Start date: ASAP



About us

The Digital Doula is a boutique sales-systems and AI-automation agency. We help online experts — coaches, course creators, service providers, and product founders — grow through better sales funnels, sharper brand voice, and smarter automations. Our clients range from parenting-plan experts to organic skincare brands to TMJ specialists to seven-figure creators.



We're not a "make it pretty" shop. Everything we build is measured against conversion, clarity, and the client's brand voice. Our house style is warm, editorial, and human — think cream, burgundy, Instrument Serif — but every client gets their own custom system built to fit their brand.



The role

We need a hybrid designer + builder who can take a strategy document, sales copy, and brand assets and turn them into a fully built, conversion-optimized site or funnel. You'll design in Figma when needed, but most days you're building directly inside GoHighLevel and Shopify, with occasional work in Webflow, Kajabi, ThriveCart, or WordPress.



You'll work on 3-6 active client builds at a time, alongside our strategist, copywriter, and AI/automation team. You are the person who makes the plan real on the screen.



What you'll actually do

Build client sales funnels inside GoHighLevel — sales pages, VSL pages, opt-ins, checkouts, thank-you pages, upsells, calendar pages, and forms



Build and customize Shopify storefronts — themes, product pages, collections, custom sections, checkout tweaks, app integrations



Design in Figma when a client needs mockups before build, or when we're pitching a concept



Translate finished copy and strategy docs into laid-out, on-brand pages that convert



Adapt each client's brand system (fonts, palette, imagery, tone) into every page consistently



Optimize builds for mobile, page speed, accessibility, and clean visual hierarchy



Coordinate with our automation team so pages connect properly to CRM,
, payment, and community platforms



QA every build against our internal checklist before handoff



Occasionally build in Webflow, Framer, Kajabi, ThriveCart, MemberVault, or WordPress as client needs require



You're a strong fit if you have

3+ years professional experience designing AND building websites/funnels for real clients



Deep GoHighLevel experience — you can build a full funnel in GHL without hand-holding, including forms, workflows, and calendar embeds



Strong Shopify experience — theme customization, Liquid basics, app setup, product/collection page design



Solid Figma skills for design work when it's needed before build



A portfolio that shows range: sales pages, service sites, e-comm stores, and course/membership platforms



Excellent taste in typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy — you can spot when something feels off and fix it



Fluent written and spoken English — you'll be reading strategy docs, copy briefs, and client feedback



Comfort working async across time zones with Slack, Loom, Google Drive, and project trackers



Reliable internet, a machine that can handle Figma + design tools, and a professional remote setup



Nice-to-haves

Experience with Webflow, Framer, Kajabi, ThriveCart, MemberVault, or WordPress



Basic HTML/CSS for custom tweaks inside GHL and Shopify



Familiarity with GA4, Meta Pixel, and basic tracking setup



Experience building for coaches, course creators, service providers, or DTC product brands



Comfort with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney) for asset generation and workflow acceleration



What we care about

Speed with polish. We move fast, but we don't ship sloppy.



Ownership. You take a build from brief to launch. You don't wait to be told what to fix.



Brand fidelity. Every client's aesthetic is sacred. Your job is to serve their brand, not yours.



Conversion mindset. Pretty is table stakes. Does it convert is the real question.



Communication. Overcommunicate progress, blockers, and questions. We don't do black boxes.



Compensation & structure

Full-time contractor, 40 hrs/week, paid monthly



Rate negotiated based on portfolio, experience, and trial project performance



Paid trial project (one small build, paid at your quoted rate) before offer is finalized



Long-term relationship — we're hiring a keeper, not a task-rabbit



Growth path: senior designer/builder, then design lead as we scale the team



How to apply

Apply here: 



Complete the full application form at the link above. 

Applications submitted anywhere other than the form above will not be reviewed. Applications without portfolio links or without GHL experience will not be reviewed.



The Digital Doula is operated by Elya Consulting LLC. We work with clients across the US, EU, and Australia. All contractor agreements are handled via written contract with clear scope, deliverables, and payment terms.

title: Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)
description:
Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)

Company: Accommos Ltd (brands: Accommos, Staymodu, Glowhouse Wellness Stays)

Location: Fully remote — UK business hours (9:00–17:30 GMT/BST)

Type: Full-time contractor 

Compensation: £1,000–£1,400/month base + uncapped commission on incremental revenue + occupancy bonus 

Reports to: Founder / Director



About Accommos

Accommos is a premium, tech-led short-term rental management company operating a portfolio of design-focused apartments across London. Our properties stand apart through wellness amenities — private saunas, cold plunges, hot tubs and cinema rooms — and a strict quality-first operating model. We hold Airbnb Superhost status and run on a modern stack: Guesty, PriceLabs, Enso Connect and heavily automated internal systems.

We are now building the commercial side of the business, and this role owns it end to end: pricing strategy, demand generation, B2B channels, ancillary revenue and guest lifetime value.



The Role

This is not a lead-sourcing or cold-calling position. You will be responsible for maximising total revenue per property across every lever available — rate, occupancy, length of stay, channel mix, ancillary income and repeat business. You will operate like a hotel revenue manager crossed with a commercial partnerships lead.

You will be the first dedicated commercial hire, working directly with the founder. You will have real autonomy, real data access, and compensation tied directly to the revenue you create.



What You Will Own

1. Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy

 -Run event-led pricing: map London demand drivers (concert residencies, stadium

 events, conferences, school holidays, sporting fixtures) months ahead and position rates before the market moves

-Optimise length-of-stay rules: minimum-stay laddering, gap-night and orphan-night auto-discounting, check-in day restrictions that eliminate unsellable one-night gaps

-Segment pricing by demand pattern: mid-week corporate vs. weekend leisure vs. mid- stay relocation, with different rate strategies for each

-Manage the PriceLabs configuration against a monthly RevPAR target per property, not just occupancy

-Run controlled experiments: test rate positions, LOS rules and offer structures, and keep what wins



2. Relocation & Corporate Demand

-Build and manage relationships with relocation agencies, insurance temporary-housing providers, corporate travel bookers, film/TV production companies and serviced- apartment agents

-Register the portfolio with corporate booking agencies and respond to RFPs for corporate housing programmes

-Pursue insurance housing panel placements (temporary accommodation after floods, fires and building failures) — long stays, reliable payers

-Negotiate corporate rates that protect margin while securing the occupancy floor



3. B2B Distribution Channels

-Get the portfolio listed with serviced-apartment agencies and booking platforms that feed corporate demand

-Build direct relationships with travel management companies and executive assistants at Canary Wharf employers

-Develop a location-hire channel for photo and film shoots: agency outreach, rate card, availability process



4. Guest Upsells & Ancillary Revenue

-Design and refine upsell flows for early check-in, late checkout, mid-stay cleaning, extended stays and wellness add-ons through Enso Connect

-Build packaged offers: wellness weekend packages, monthly-stay bundles, celebration set-ups — priced as products, not discounts

-Launch and manage gift vouchers and prepaid stay credits for the direct site Track attach rates per upsell and continuously improve timing, pricing and copy



5. Direct Booking Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

-Grow bookings on our direct website (
), working alongside our paid-ads freelancer

-Own the guest database: post-stay win-back campaigns, seasonal offers to past guests, and a repeat-guest recognition programme that shifts OTA guests to direct

-Build a referral mechanism for guests and corporate contacts

-Recapture lost demand: cancelled bookings, expired quotes and abandoned direct-site sessions get structured follow-up offers

-Improve on-site conversion through offers, copy and booking-journey feedback



6. Occupancy Gap-Filling

-Monitor the portfolio calendar weekly; identify soft periods 2–6 weeks out and act before they arrive

-Sell gaps proactively: outreach to corporate contacts, targeted past-guest offers, location-hire placements, strategic LOS relaxation

-Coordinate all tactics with the pricing strategy so gap-filling never erodes the rate position



KPIs

-RevPAR per property vs. target (the headline metric)

-Incremental revenue generated per month, by stream

-Portfolio occupancy vs. baseline, with rate integrity maintained

-Direct booking share vs. OTA share

-Upsell attach rate and ancillary revenue per booking

-Repeat-guest rate and guest database growth

-Number of active corporate/relocation/agency accounts producing bookings



What We Are Looking For



Must have

-3+ years in revenue management, commercial or business development within short- term rentals, serviced apartments, hotels, corporate housing or relocation services

-Demonstrable record of revenue you personally generated or grew — you will be asked for specifics and numbers

-Working command of revenue metrics: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, LOS, channel contribution, attach rate

-Excellent spoken and written English; confident and credible on calls with UK corporate clients and agents

-Consultative selling style: you listen, diagnose and propose — you do not script-read Comfortable running structured experiments and reading the results honestly Reliable remote setup: quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet

-Available during UK business hours



Strongly preferred

-Hands-on experience with dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond) and a PMS (Guesty or comparable)

-Existing knowledge of the London accommodation market and its event calendar

-Familiarity with relocation agents, insurance housing, TMCs or serviced-apartment agencies


/CRM lifecycle marketing experience



Compensation Structure

-Base: £1,000–£1,400/month depending on experience

-Commission: percentage of incremental revenue across corporate bookings, upsells, ancillary income and direct bookings (structure shared at interview; uncapped)

-Quarterly RevPAR bonus when the portfolio exceeds target

-Realistic year-one on-target earnings: £20,000–£30,000+



Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention

-Ground-floor commercial hire in a profitable, growing company — you build the function

-Direct line to the founder; decisions in days, not quarters

-A genuinely differentiated product to sell: wellness-led properties that photograph well, review well and command premium rates

-Full access to the levers: pricing, channels, partnerships, marketing — not a narrow patch

-Compensation that scales with the results you deliver



How to Apply

Begin your application with the word “sauna” so we know you read this far. Then include:

1. Your CV

2. A short note (max 200 words) describing one specific piece of revenue you personally created or grew — what it was, how you did it, and the number

3. A voice recording (1–2 minutes, Vocaroo or similar) introducing yourself as if leaving a voi
 for a relocation agent you want to work with



Applications without all three items will not be reviewed.

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered.

A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's.

Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk.

Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time.

Screening Questions (Upwork):

Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download
. Can you help?"

Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.)

What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

Genuine passion for the craft of editing.

Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy.

????

title: Social Media Ad Designer / Creative Monster
description:
Hi social media addict ????



Yes, we mean you.



The person who spends way too much time scrolling Instagram, TikTok,
 and 
.



Who notices weird ads.



Saves clever creatives.



Sees a meme and immediately thinks: “This could actually be an ad.”



And who understands why some ads make you stop scrolling… while others disappear into the feed.



We are looking for a creative / social media monster who can help us take our ads to the next level.



Not just someone who knows Canva or Photoshop.



And definitely not someone who takes a template, changes the colors and calls it a day.



We’re looking for someone who understands advertising.



Someone who can take an idea from us and turn it into something that makes people stop, look and understand the message within seconds.



One VERY important thing:



You need to understand the Dutch / European advertising style.



Dutch ads are often cleaner, more direct, more subtle and less “salesy”.



Typography matters.



Spacing matters.



Photography matters.



The words you emphasize matter.



We need someone who sees the difference between something that feels natural in the feed and something that immediately screams “advertisement”.



You don't necessarily need to have worked for a Dutch company before.



But you do need to be able to study our market, understand our references and adapt your design style to it.



What will you create?



Mostly social media ads for
 and Instagram.



And we like experimenting.



One day it might be a clean ad.



The next day:



* A fake WhatsApp conversation

* A handwritten note

* A timer inside a work van

* A meme

* A Reddit-style post

* A screenshot-style creative

* A realistic AI-generated scene

* Or something completely new



The concept comes first.



We don't want every ad to look like an advertisement.



Some of our best-performing ads don't.



How we work



Most of the time, we come up with the marketing concept.



For example:



“We want to show a mechanic sitting in his van with a timer counting down until he can finally go home.”



Your job isn't just to execute it.



We want your brain to start working too.



What should it look like?



What should someone notice first?



How do we make it believable?



Could the idea be even better?



We don't need an order taker.



We want a creative sparring partner.



You might be our person if…



* You regularly create social media ads

* You understand what makes people stop scrolling

* You follow memes, trends, formats and advertising concepts

* You understand typography, hierarchy, spacing and composition

* You know how to use text without turning an ad into a flyer

* You understand that the prettiest ad isn't always the best-performing ad

* You have a strong eye for photography and realistic imagery

* You know when AI looks good and when it looks painfully fake

* You use Canva, Photoshop, Figma or similar tools

* You are comfortable using AI in your workflow

* You can work independently

* You aren't afraid to challenge an idea



Experience with Meta Ads or performance marketing is a big plus.



Things that make us cry



Please don't send us:



* Generic Canva templates

* Stock photo + giant headline + icons + logo

* Designs with six different fonts

* Creatives with 37 things fighting for attention

* Fake-looking AI people

* Perfect designs that communicate absolutely nothing

* Copies of other ads without understanding why they work



We love AI.



We use it ourselves every day.



But AI should make your creative work better.



It should never replace good taste.



About us



We create social media advertising campaigns for companies in the Netherlands.



Our job is to make people stop scrolling, understand a message quickly and take action.



You'll mainly work together with our Marketing Manager, who has been running Meta advertising campaigns for more than 10 years and loves testing new creative concepts.



We're informal, ambitious and constantly experimenting.



If something works, we improve it.



If something doesn't, we kill it and try something else.



No ego.



Just better ads.



Before you apply…



Please do NOT send us a portfolio full of logos, business cards, menus and PowerPoint presentations.



We're hiring you to make ads.



So we want to see ADS.



Send us 3–5 social media advertisements you personally designed.



Preferably work aimed at Dutch or European audiences.



For your strongest ad, briefly tell us:



Why do you think this one works?



We just want to understand how your brain works.



And one final thing:



Start your application with the word “Scrollstopper”.



That way we know you actually made it this far. ????



If you live and breathe social media, love making ads and think you can surprise us creatively…



We want to see your work.

title: Vistage Executive Assistant
description:
VISTAGE CHAIR EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

New Mexico Region



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to support the leadership and operations of Vistage Chair group(s) in New Mexico. This is a key operational role that directly impacts the success of peer advisory groups, member satisfaction, and practice growth. The EA will serve as the organizational backbone, managing calendars, coordinating meetings, supporting member engagement, and driving prospecting efforts.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Calendar & Meeting Management

Confirm all group meeting dates, times, and locations each month

Schedule and maintain one-to-one coaching sessions (minimum 2 hours per member)

Block Chair focus time for agenda preparation and member follow-up

Manage Vistage HQ and regional meeting calendars



Member Engagement & One-to-Ones

Coordinate one-to-one sessions between Chair and members

Prepare pre-read materials (notes, commitments, KPIs) for each session

Capture, organize, and file session notes

Maintain member issues pipeline for group meeting agendas



Group Meeting Operations

Confirm and coordinate venues, room layouts, AV, meals, and access logistics

Manage speaker coordination, topic finalization, and materials preparation

Build time-boxed agendas and prepare digital/printed meeting packets

Send confirmations and logistical details to members 7-10 days prior



Member Communications & Administrative Support

Send monthly touch communications to each member

Track attendance and engagement; identify and flag at-risk members

Maintain accurate and current member records and company information

Update CRM/tracking systems with member commitments and outcomes



Prospecting & Pipeline Development (20% of time)

Maintain and stage prospect pipeline with clear tracking

Schedule Chair-prospect meetings and group sit-in invitations

Prepare background research and context for Chair prospect meetings

Track prospecting conversions, declines, and follow-up dates



Financial & Practice Health Oversight

Reconcile meeting expenses and prepare reimbursement documentation

Monitor member billing and payment status

Maintain monthly scorecard: member count, attendance %, one-to-ones completed, prospecting metrics



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



3+ years of executive or administrative assistant experience

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple calendars and stakeholder schedules

Proficiency with calendar management, CRM, and productivity tools

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Excellent written and verbal communication

Ability to manage confidential information with discretion

Proactive problem-solving and self-directed work style

Comfort with CRM systems and data entry



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience supporting C-suite or board-level executives

Familiarity with peer advisory groups, CEO peer networks, or membership organizations

Knowledge of Vistage or similar executive coaching/peer advisory models

Experience with meeting coordination, event management, or prospecting workflows

Demonstrated ability to support business development and pipeline management

Proficiency in Excel, Google Workspace, or similar productivity suites



CORE COMPETENCIES



Organization & Time Management: Ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines

Communication: Clear, professional, and responsive in all interactions

Relationship Building: Natural ability to build rapport and maintain relationships

Discretion & Confidentiality: Trusted steward of sensitive business information

Initiative: Anticipates needs and takes action without being asked

Adaptability: Flexible and calm under changing circumstances



WHAT WE OFFER



Competitive compensation and benefits package

Structured 30-day onboarding program with clear expectations

Opportunity to directly impact the success of peer advisory groups and member outcomes

Professional development and training aligned with role growth

Supportive, collaborative work environment

Clear advancement and career development pathways

description:

Royal Rewards will allow our customers to create an account, receive their own referral code/link, refer new customers, earn points, earn cash referral bonuses, redeem rewards, and track everything from their personal dashboard.



For example:



**Refer a customer → Earn Points → Customer completes an eligible tax return → Earn $50 Cash**



We will also offer milestone bonuses, rewards, promotions, giveaways, and special influencer/ambassador referral codes.



### Main Features



The developer will help build:



* Customer signup/login

* User profiles

* Unique referral codes and links

* Referral tracking

* Referral status system

* $50 cash referral rewards

* Points transaction history

* Cash transaction history

* Points cash-out requests

* Rewards marketplace

* Reward redemption

* Giveaways/promotions

* Influencer/Ambassador promo codes

* Push notifications

* Admin dashboard

* Analytics/reporting



The **Admin Dashboard** must allow us to manage customers, referrals, points, cash rewards, cash-out requests, referral statuses, rewards, promo codes, influencers, and promotions.



### Preferred Skills

**FlutterFlow**

**Supabase Authentication**

**PostgreSQL/databases**

**Row Level Security (RLS)**

**Mobile app development**

**Admin dashboards**

**iOS/Android deployment**



Experience building **referral, loyalty, rewards, affiliate, wallet, or points-based apps** is highly preferred.



### Security



Security and database structure are very important.



Users must only be able to access their own information. Customers should NOT be able to manually change their points, cash balance, referral status, or account role.



The developer should understand proper database permissions and **Supabase Row Level Security (RLS).**



### Future Opportunity



For now, Royal Rewards will only be used and tested with **Royal Financial Consulting**.



However, if the application is successful, we may expand it significantly in the future. We are looking for a developer who may be interested in staying with us long-term for updates, maintenance, new features, and future development.

title: Influencer & Affiliate Manager
description:
To be considered apply at the bottom of the job description.



Remote, full-time. Anywhere.



We make football gear — shin pads, grip socks and performance kit — and we sell it worldwide. Over 200,000 people follow us across Instagram and TikTok.



We are building an army of affiliates and creators: hundreds of young footballers filming, posting, and earning from what they sell. Everything for it is already built and nobody has used any of it yet. This is the person who starts it.



The role



You are the main point of contact for every creator and affiliate we work with.



That means outbound — finding young footballers on Instagram and TikTok and reaching out, every day. It means inbound, handling everyone who comes to us. It means getting people signed up, with their product, their link and their code sorted. And it means running our 
 and keeping it somewhere people actually want to be.



The hardest part, and the part the job is really judged on, is keeping people producing. Anyone can sign someone up. A roster that posts for six weeks and goes quiet is a failed programme. So you are watching what comes in, replying to every single clip within 72 hours by name, and knowing who has gone quiet before they have properly gone.



You will also spot the people whose content is working and put them forward to move up. Affiliates earn commission on what they sell. The ones whose footage performs get put on a contract and earn from the ad spend behind it. That ladder is the whole pitch, and you are the one who walks people up it.



What this role is not



It is not a marketing strategy job. The system is designed and built — 
, tracking, sign-up pages, the payout side. You are not being hired to redesign it, you are being hired to run it and grow it. If your instinct on day one is to rebuild the programme rather than fill it, this is the wrong role for you.



Who I am looking for



Someone who genuinely loves football. You will watch several hundred clips a month from teenagers on pitches, and you have to be able to tell a good one from a nice one. That judgement cannot be taught quickly and it is the thing most candidates will not have.



Someone who is ruthless with an inbox. Hundreds of messages, nobody ignored, nothing templated. If you write like a brand rather than a person, creators stop replying and the whole thing dies quietly.



Someone who has run a community before — a 
, a group chat, a roster, anything where people showed up because of you specifically. I care far more about that than about where you have worked.



And someone careful. This role touches what people get paid. A sloppy tag or a wrong name in a spreadsheet means somebody's money is wrong, and that is how you lose trust with a roster you spent months building.



Strong written English matters more here than anywhere else in the company, because almost the entire job is short written messages to strangers.

The platform is designed to make the ad creation process simple and efficient, and we will provide complete training on the software, workflow, and quality standards.

* Creating newspaper and print advertisements using our client's proprietary design platform

* Arranging text, images, colors, fonts, and other design elements

* Making sure advertisements are visually clean, balanced, and professional

* Making revisions when necessary based on feedback

We're looking for someone who:



* Has previous graphic design or other relevant design experience

* Has a strong eye for layout and visual presentation

* Understands basic design principles such as typography, spacing, alignment, hierarchy, color, and composition

* Has experience with Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar design software

* Has strong attention to detail

* Has good written and verbal English communication skills

* Is comfortable learning new software and systems

* Can follow instructions and established processes

* Is reliable, organized, and able to work effectively as part of a remote team

* Has a reliable computer and internet connection



You do **not** need to be an advanced graphic designer. We are looking for someone with a good design foundation and visual judgment who can learn our system and consistently produce quality work.



## Full Training Provided



We provide complete training for this position.



We have our own training system and dedicated trainers who will teach you how to use the design platform, understand the workflow, and create advertisements that meet our quality standards.



Previous experience with this specific platform is **not required**.

**Starting salary: PHP 25,000 per month**

There will be opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibilities for team members who perform well and grow with the company.

We're looking for reliable people with a strong eye for design who are eager to learn, communicate well, and work as part of a growing team.
