title: Forensic Accounting Assistant / Financial Transaction Analyst – Real Estate & Business Records
description:
I am seeking an experienced forensic accounting assistant or financial analyst to assist with organizing and analyzing financial records involving multiple business entities and real-estate transactions.



This project involves reviewing bank statements, accounting records, property transactions, construction expenses, loans, investor funds, and closing documents to create clear financial schedules and identify transactions requiring additional documentation or professional review.



Responsibilities include:



* Review and organize business and personal financial records.

* Enter and categorize transactions from bank statements into a master transaction ledger.

* Trace transfers between related businesses, individuals, and bank accounts.

* Identify large or unusual transfers and transactions requiring further documentation.

* Reconcile bank activity against accounting records, tax documents, loan records, invoices, and other supporting documentation.

* Create source-and-use-of-funds schedules.

* Reconstruct individual real-estate projects from property acquisition through construction and eventual sale.

* Track investor contributions, construction draws, contractor payments, developer fees, loan proceeds, closing proceeds, distributions, and profits.

* Create property-by-property profit/loss and cash-flow schedules.

* Identify transfers between related business entities.

* Identify personal expenditures that may have been paid from business accounts.

* Create schedules of transactions for which invoices, receipts, contracts, or other supporting documents are missing.

* Maintain an organized electronic document system linking transactions to their supporting records.

* Prepare Excel workbooks and summaries that can be reviewed by a U.S. attorney, CPA, or forensic accounting expert.



This position does NOT require the contractor to provide legal opinions, determine whether fraud or criminal activity occurred, contact opposing parties, or serve as an expert witness. The purpose is financial analysis, transaction tracing, reconciliation, and preparation of organized working papers for professional review.



Qualifications



Ideal candidate will have:



* Accounting, finance, audit, or bookkeeping background

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Experience reconciling bank statements

* Experience tracing transactions between multiple accounts

* Ability to analyze large amounts of financial data

* Strong attention to detail

* Experience with QuickBooks

* Experience with real-estate development/construction accounting strongly preferred

* Experience with forensic accounting, fraud examination, litigation support, or investigative accounting strongly preferred

* CPA/accounting degree or CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner) background is a plus

* Excellent written English

* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality

title: Customer Support VA - Shopify E-Commerce, AI-Assisted
description:
US MARKET
 SUPPORT VA - SHOPIFY E-COMMERCE, AI-ASSISTED

Remote | Part-time, about 2-3 hours per day (growing) | Start: ASAP | $2.50 - $4 per hour





READ THIS FIRST



This job post is long. That is on purpose.



I am hiring ONE person. I would rather get 5 serious applications than 200 lazy ones. If you send the same message to 40 job posts a day, close this now - you will not get through.



But please do not be scared off either. You will not be thrown into deep water alone. We have written SOPs for every situation, training videos of real past cases, I will train you, and we have a 1-on-1 call every single week. You do not need to invent anything. You need to be reliable, careful, and willing to learn our system.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





ABOUT US



We run five direct-response e-commerce brands on Shopify. We sell physical products to customers in the United States, and we advertise on
 and Instagram at a four-figure daily budget.



Growth means more orders, and more orders mean more customer
s. That inbox is what we are hiring for.





THE BIG IDEA - WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS MORE THAN A NORMAL SUPPORT JOB



Acquiring a customer through paid ads is expensive. We pay for every single one before we ever make a cent.



Now think about what happens when one of them writes to us and gets no answer for four days. They do not politely ask again. They open a PayPal dispute or they call their bank and do a chargeback. And that does not just cost us the order - it costs us the dispute fee, it costs us the product that is already on a plane, and if enough of them pile up it costs us the payment processor itself. A store that loses its payment provider is a store that is dead, no matter how good the ads are.



That is the real math of this job. Every
 you answer fast and properly is a dispute that never happens. You are not "answering tickets" - you are protecting the money at the exact point where it leaks out.



A business is also like a house. Most people only build the front: the ads, the product page, the pretty pictures. Then the first storm comes and it falls over, because there is no foundation. The foundation is the backend. That is what you are.





THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



You own the customer inbox across all five brands and you keep it at zero.



This is not a typing job. You do not write every reply from scratch. We use AI to draft, and your job is to judge the draft, fix what reads robotic, check the facts in Shopify, and send. Editor and decision-maker, not typist.



The number we hold you to: every customer
 gets an answer within 24 hours. That is the whole scoreboard. Within 90 days we want you handling 80 percent of the inbox without asking us anything.



This is a doer role. Nobody reports to you and you do not build a team.





HOW THE DAY WORKS



One focused block per day. You come in, you clear the inbox across all brands, you handle what you can handle, you flag what needs us, you send a short end-of-day note. Then you are done.



Our customers are in the United States, so the inbox fills up overnight your time. You work your block in the morning, Philippine time, and everything that came in during the US evening is handled before it gets old.



We are looking for one person long-term. Someone who gets faster and more independent every month, not someone who needs the same question answered twice.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. CUSTOMER
S (your main job)



We currently handle around [MAIL-VOLUMEN] customer
s per week across all five brands.



- Sweep the support inboxes across all five brands and clear them, every working day

- Answer tracking questions ("where is my order") using our tracking tools and the order data in Shopify

- Answer product and usage questions from our templates

- Process returns, cancellations and address changes along our decision tree

- Keep the inbox at zero. No
 older than 24 hours.



2. CASES AND DISPUTES



- Spot disputes early - PayPal cases, Klarna claims, chargebacks - and log every single one in our tracker with its deadline

- Respond to the case: upload the tracking, assemble the evidence, write the response

- Never let a deadline pass. A dispute we lose by default is money we simply hand over.



3. ADDRESS PROBLEMS



- When an address is wrong, incomplete or undeliverable, you take it from there: you
 the customer, you get the correct address, you update it in Shopify, and you confirm it back to our supplier.

- We should not have to sit in the middle of that. You are the link.



4. PUSHING PROBLEMS BACK TO THE SOURCE (this one matters to us)



You do not just fix problems for the customer. You push them back up the chain so they stop happening.



If ten customers this week asked the same question, that is not ten tickets. That is one broken product page, and we want to know about it. If three packages arrived damaged, we do not want you to quietly send three replacements and move on - we want the order numbers, the photos, and the question of why it keeps happening.



So you document it: what went wrong, how often, which orders. Then you bring it to the weekly call and we fix the cause instead of the symptom.



Tell us when one of our templates, our processes or our product pages is bad. We built them and we will change them. Nobody here is attached to being right.



To be clear about what this job is NOT: you do not order stock, you do not manage inventory, you do not do purchasing, you do not write marketing copy, and you never talk to a customer on the phone. Everything is written and asynchronous.





STOP. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY.



Start your message with the word TAMARIND, exactly like this:



TAMARIND - Your Full Name



Apply right here through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not
 us - we read everything in this system and nowhere else. If TAMARIND is not the first thing in your message we will never see it, no matter how good your experience is. This is not a joke and there is no exception. Most applicants will fail this, and that is fine.





ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



This is the part we care about most, so we are going to be very clear.



We are not looking for someone who never has a problem. Everybody gets sick. Power goes out. Family emergencies happen. Typhoons happen. We have zero problem with any of that.



What we have a problem with is silence.



If you are ill, if your internet dies, if something happens in your family, if you simply cannot work today - send us one message. Before, not after. That is all we ask, and if you do it, we will always find a solution together.



Disappearing without a word is the one thing that ends this immediately. Not because we are strict about hours, but because we cannot run a business on someone we have to chase.



Beyond that, we expect three things:



- You work independently. You do not need to be reminded or micromanaged.

- You own the outcome. An escalation comes to us with your recommendation attached, not as a forwarded
 that says "what should I do".

- You are honest when you do not know. A wrong answer sent confidently to a customer costs us a dispute. "I need to check this" costs us nothing.





THE TOP THREE SKILLS WE ARE HIRING FOR



1. Shopify Admin, hands-on - orders, customers, fulfillments, refunds, every day

2. Native-level written English - our customers are American, and a reply that sounds translated costs us the sale

3. Judgment on AI drafts - you know when a draft is confidently wrong, and you check before you send





WHAT YOU MUST BRING (hard requirements)



1. Hands-on Shopify Admin experience: orders, customers, fulfillments, refunds. Not "I have seen Shopify" - you have worked in it daily and you can tell us exactly what you did in there.



2. Written English that reads like a native-level support agent wrote it. Our customers are American and they notice.



3. A paid ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro subscription, and you already use it daily. Not the free tier. This role runs on AI drafting and the free versions are too slow and too limited for a daily inbox block. If you do not have one yet but you are otherwise a fit, say so - we will cover it from day one. What we cannot work with is someone who has never used these tools seriously.



4. You know where AI gets things wrong. You can tell when a draft is confidently wrong and you check the facts in Shopify before you send.



5. Parcel tracking tools (17track or similar) and the patience to read what a scan history actually means.



6. Google Sheets for the dispute tracker.



7. Reliable daily availability, a stable internet connection, a working computer, and you are reachable on
 during your working block.



8. At least 1 year in customer support, e-commerce preferred.



9. Willing to sign a freelance contract and a short NDA before you get access to our systems.





BONUS (not required, but it moves you to the top of the list)



- You have handled PayPal or Klarna disputes before and can describe a real case

- Previous direct-response or dropshipping support

- Experience with high-volume US customers specifically

- Helpdesk tools - tell us which ones you have actually used: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Re:amaze, Commslayer, anything. It means you start faster.

- Any tool that makes you faster: text expanders, AI tools, order lookup tools. Tell us your setup.

- Any experience with Meta Ads Manager





THE TOOLS WE USE



Shopify Admin, Gmail, 17track, Google Sheets, PayPal and Klarna resolution centers,
 for internal communication, and an AI assistant for drafting. Every account you need is paid by us.





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Full written playbooks: response templates per brand, refund decision tree, dispute workflow, carrier patterns, escalation rules

- Training videos walking you through real past cases, start to finish

- Delegated inbox access - you never handle our passwords

- Every tool account and software licence you need, paid by us

- Direct feedback, and a standing invitation to tell us when something we built is bad





WORKING HOURS AND WHERE THIS ROLE IS GOING



- 100% remote, from anywhere in the Philippines

- Right now: about 2 hours per day, sometimes up to 3 when volume is high. Roughly 10 to 15 hours per week.

- The hours depend on how much comes in. Quiet days you are done in an hour. After a big ad push it takes longer. You are paid per hour, so this works both ways - we are not going to pretend it is a fixed 40-hour job today.

- You choose when you work. The only rule: every customer
 answered within 24 hours, and your block lands in your morning so the overnight US inbox is cleared before it gets old.

- Day-to-day communication is asynchronous on
. No 
, no "quick calls", no being on call.

- One fixed 30-minute call per week, camera on. We agree on the day and time together once you start, and then it stays there. We go through the numbers, the problems that keep coming back, what you need from us, and what we think you should do differently. You get direct feedback and we expect you to use it. We also expect you to tell us when you think we are wrong - that call goes both ways. This is a team, not a hierarchy.

- We use time tracking. We say this openly because we would rather lose an applicant now than have a surprise later.

- Where this is going: we are scaling, and we are moving our ad launches onto software. Once you are solid on support, this role can grow into launching ad campaigns from creatives and briefs we prepare - execution inside a tool, not strategy, not creative decisions. More hours, more responsibility, more pay. If that sounds like something you want, say so in your application.





HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



Five numbers, nothing else:



1. First response time - under 24 hours, always

2. Inbox at zero at the end of every block

3. Disputes logged with their deadline, none missed, none lost by default

4. Escalation quality - is your recommendation usable as it is

5. Independence over time - fewer questions to us every month



We do not measure how many words you wrote.





COMPENSATION (all amounts in USD)



You are paid per hour, for the hours you actually work. We start low and we move you up fast. We are honest about that instead of promising you a number we do not know you are worth yet.



STEP 1 - PAID TRIAL: $2.50 per hour. Real tickets, real customers, from day one. You are paid for every hour of it whether or not we hire you. Short, and we d
 quickly.



STEP 2 - APPROVED: $3.00 per hour. The position is yours.



STEP 3 - PROVEN AND LONG-TERM: $3.50 per hour.



STEP 4 - FULLY OPERATING, running the whole inbox on your own: $4.00 per hour.



At roughly 10 to 15 hours per week that is about $110 to $260 per month today - and both the hours and the rate grow as we scale. We move people up this ladder fast when they earn it. We have never lost a great person over money and we do not plan to start.



Also included:



- Paid monthly, on time, every month, no exceptions, via Wise or PayPal

- A 13th month bonus after one full year

- Bonuses when the business does well - when we grow, you grow

- All tools and software licences paid by us, including your AI subscription if you do not have one

- Paid Philippine public holidays

- Freelance contract and NDA

- Long-term position - we want someone who grows with the brands



The steps above are not promises we forget about. They are tied to the five numbers under HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED, and we review on schedule.



One honest note: at today's hours this is a part-time income. If you currently work with another client, that is completely fine with us, as long as our
s are always answered within 24 hours. As we scale, this role is meant to become your main one.



Why we start at $2.50: we have hired for this role before and it did not work out, and it cost us months. The trial is where both of us find out. If you are good you are past it quickly - we have no interest in underpaying someone we want to keep.





ENGLISH



Our customers are American. A reply that reads translated costs us the sale, and a support agent we cannot have a normal conversation with costs us far more than that.



So there are two steps, and we are open about both. First, the short recording you send with your application - that is how we hear you before anyone spends time on a call. Then a video call in English, camera on, before we hire anyone. You need to be able to hold a normal working conversation: understand what we are asking, ask a question back, tell us when something is unclear.



Written English alone is not enough. We have been burned by exactly this before and we are not doing it again.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with TAMARIND - Your Full Name.



Keep it short. We are not asking you to do unpaid work to apply - nothing below takes more than ten minutes, and nothing below is work you have to invent for us. Be specific: vague answers are the fastest way to get rejected.



1. WHERE YOU DID SUPPORT BEFORE. Which companies or stores, for how long, and in which tool (Gorgias, Zendesk, Gmail, whatever it was). Numbers, not adjectives.



2. HOW MANY
S PER DAY you handled there, and what your average first response time was.



3. YOUR SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE. What did you actually do in the admin? "Refunds, address edits, fulfillments, daily" tells us more than "I know Shopify".



4. YOUR AI SETUP. Which subscription do you have (ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, other) and what do you use it for day to day?



5. YOUR TIME ZONE and the daily block you would work in.



6. ONE PIECE OF PROOF from your past support work. Your pick, and any of these is fine: a screenshot of your ticket stats, an SOP you followed or wrote, a few of the templates you worked with, or a reference we may contact. Black out or remove anything confidential - customer names, order data, anything your agreement with a past employer covers. We do not want you to break that agreement to apply here, and a redacted screenshot tells us everything we need. If you genuinely cannot share anything, write us a short SOP instead: "A customer writes that the package never arrived. Step by step, what do you do?" A few lines is enough.



7. A 60-SECOND RECORDING OF YOURSELF SPEAKING ENGLISH. Loom, a voice message, an unlisted YouTube link, whatever is easiest. Introduce yourself, tell us what you did in your last support role, and say why this one interests you. No production, no script, no editing - phone camera or just audio is completely fine. We are not judging your setup or your confidence on camera. We want to hear how you speak English, because that d
 whether this works.



That is it. No cover letter, no essay, no test task.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We read your answers and listen to your recording

2. Short video call in English, camera on

3. After the call: a small PAID trial on real cases from our inbox

4. Hire, starting rate, then the first review



The trial comes after we have spoken, not before. You get paid for it whether or not we hire you. We keep the number of trials small on purpose, so if you get there you are already a serious candidate.



Applications that do not start correctly, or that skip any of the 7 points, will not be reviewed. We are strict about this on purpose: following instructions exactly is the single most important part of this job.



We reply to every application that follows the instructions, and we reply fast.



If this sounds like you, apply today. We are hiring one person and we are hiring quickly.



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph - start your message with: TAMARIND - Your Full Name

title: Video Editor E-commerce (Meta Ads Specialist)

Can you look at a competitor’s winning ad and immediately understand how to replicate it technically, or transform a script into a winning creative using the most advanced AI tools? If you answered an enthusiastic “YES” to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and education space and we’re looking for a Video Editor (Meta Ads Specialist) to join our creative team.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Crafting clean, high-conversion ads (1 to 5 minutes) including Mini-VSLs, AI-UGC, and "Product in Hand" content.

Asset Management & Sourcing: You will be provided with a folder of our selected B-rolls. However, if additional clips are needed, you must source them autonomously and innovatively. The use of traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

From Script to Finished Product: We provide the scripts; your job is to interpret them visually, choosing the right clips and editing them to create a dynamic, persuasive, and technically flawless product.

AI Tool Research & Implementation: This is your passion. You must stay constantly updated on new AI releases (editing, UGC avatars, video generation). In our weekly calls, we expect you to pitch new software that can revolutionize our workflow.

AI Asset Generation: Hands-on use of the AI Stack (Higgsfield, Sora 2, Veo 3, Arcads, MakeUGC) to create or enhance content.

Visual Optimization: Implementing textual hooks, kinetic typography, and scroll-stopping subtitles.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific experience: A solid background in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands. You must have worked as an editor for brands generating at least $10k/month in revenue. While respecting privacy, you will be asked to provide examples of these collaborations in the following stages.

Deep Passion for Innovation: This isn't just a job; you must love technology. We want an AI "killer" who stays ahead of the market.

Excellent Problem-Solving Skills: If instructions aren't crystal clear or assets are missing, you don't stop. You find a solution and complete the task with excellence.

Availability & Commitment: Starting with a part-time collaboration (20h/week) with a clear intention of moving to Full-Time shortly. We work 5 days a week, but availability on Saturdays and Sundays is required for emergencies. Please note: we are looking for a dedicated partner, not an "Upwork or Fiverr style" freelancer juggling 5-6 different companies. If you cannot guarantee us top priority and absolute mental focus, do not apply.

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: Subtitles, cuts, and details must be perfect. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

Fluent in English: The team communicates in English. Deep proficiency is mandatory to manage multilingual content (IT, FR, ES, DE, NL).

What We Offer:

Performance Bonuses: Potential for bonuses up to $1000+ per month based on the results of the videos produced.

Career Growth: A real opportunity to become Head of Video Editing.

Active Involvement: You will actively participate in the growth of an international company, testing the most powerful AI tools on the market.

title: VA - Guest Communication & Operations @ Restay Homes
description:
Hi!



My name is Nikita, I'm the founder of Restay Vacation Homes Rental - a short-term rental management company based in Dubai.



We manage 35+ furnished apartments in Dubai under sublease and property management, from studios to 3-bedrooms. We've held Airbnb Superhost status for the past year with a 4.8-4.9 rating across the whole portfolio, and we're adding units every month.



We're looking for one more VA to join our operations team.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS



Communication is most of it. You'll be in our CRM, in Slack and on WhatsApp all day - talking to guests, cleaners, maintenance, contractors, suppliers and owners, and keeping our internal team informed. The rest is paperwork: passport and registration documents, DTCM, records, reports. Getting it right, and getting it finished.



Guest relations:



- Manage guest communication, inbound and outbound

- Coordinate check-in and check-out

- Handle issues during a stay and follow them through to a result, not just a reply

- Coordinate cleaners and suppliers via WhatsApp and Slack



Maintenance coordination:



- Log every reported issue and keep it visible until it's actually fixed

- Dispatch technicians, including after hours, and confirm the job was done

- Chase contractors and suppliers who go quiet

- Spot problems that keep coming back and say so



New unit launches:



- Coordinate a new apartment from handover to first booking - furniture delivery, installation, deep clean, photos, keys and access

- Handle the paperwork: DTCM registration, documents, listing setup across platforms

- Keep the owner and the internal team updated on where each unit stands



Operations and admin:



- Collect and process guest documents for registration - on time, every time

- Keep our CRM accurate: bookings, unit status, guest records

- Prepare and check reports and documents

- Escalate the right things to the senior team, and only the right things



Systems, as you grow into it:



- Write and maintain SOPs

- Improve how the team works, not just do the tasks

- Build simple automations between our tools



TWO THINGS MATTER MORE TO US THAN ANYTHING ELSE



You chase things until they're done.



Most of this job is waiting on other people - a guest who hasn't sent a document, a contractor who read your message and didn't answer, an owner sitting on an approval. Asking once is not doing the task. We need someone who tracks every open thread, notices who has gone quiet, and pushes again - politely, on a schedule, switching channel and escalating when it isn't working. Silence from the other side is not a finished task.



You check before you answer.



When a source contradicts what we've written, or something doesn't add up, stop and find out which is true rather than passing on the first answer you found. Being right matters more here than being fast, and one good question beats a confident wrong answer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You follow up. You have a real system for tracking what you're waiting on

- You verify. You notice when two sources disagree and you resolve it

- Fluent English, written and spoken - natural and clear, not translated-sounding

- You own tasks. You d
 what you can d
 and escalate what you can't

- Structured. You follow SOPs, and you write them when they're missing

- Accurate with detail - numbers, dates, documents

- Comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets, Slack, WhatsApp



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- 6+ months in Airbnb operations or another short-term rental company

- 6+ months in a small team or startup

- Experience helping a company scale from 10 to 50+ units is a big plus

- Familiarity with guest communication, pricing tools, turnover coordination

- Experience writing SOPs or building team processes



WHAT WE OFFER



- $4-6/hour depending on experience

- Flexible workload, 40-60 hrs/week, 5-6 days - you tell us what suits you

- Direct work with the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Opportunity to grow into Team Lead as we scale



HOW TO APPLY



We don't accept direct messages. Applications without a completed form are ignored.



The application has two parts:



Part 1 - a short form about you and your experience (about 10 minutes)

Part 2 - five real situations from our operations. You'll get the link right after you submit Part 1. You have 60 minutes from that moment, and we record how long it takes.



Part 2 has no trick questions and no perfect answers. We want to see how you think and how fast you get to a result.



Form: 



Looking forward to hearing from you!



Nikita

title: Podcast video editor
description:
Role Overview

You will own end-to-end video post-production for a weekly interview podcast. You will take raw multi-track

recordings and deliver a polished long-form episode, a podcast-ready audio file, and a set of vertical short-form

clips.

This is a role for an editor who works fluently with AI-assisted tools but brings real editorial judgment about pacing,

cuts, and what makes a moment land. The client is early in the show's life and actively developing their visual style,

so the first several episodes involve close collaboration and iteration. Your taste will shape the direction of the

show.



Responsibilities

Long-Form Editing

• Edit raw multi-track recordings into a polished episode, typically 30 minutes in length

• Build a clean side-by-side or multi-angle layout from separate host and guest video and audio tracks

• Remove filler, dead air, false starts, and tangents while preserving natural conversational flow

• Apply color correction and visual smoothing for a consistent look across episodes



Audio Production

• Perform audio cleanup, levelling, and noise reduction across separate speaker tracks

• Handle variable guest audio quality, since guests record remotely on their own equipment

• Deliver a podcast-ready audio file suitable for distribution



Short-Form Editing

• Cut 3 to 5 vertical clips per episode for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok

• Select moments with genuine standalone hook value rather than arbitrary segments

• Add clean, accurate captions and simple text treatments consistent with brand style



Collaboration and Workflow

• Work from a shared Riverside and Google Drive folder structure with clear stage gates

• Receive batched revision notes through 
 and turn them around cleanly in a single pass

• Stay reachable on the client's team channel for quick questions

• Help build and maintain a style and preferences document as feedback patterns emerge across the first month



Tools

• Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve for primary editing

• AI-assisted clipping and transcription tools, used with editorial oversight

• Riverside for source recordings and transcripts

• 
 for review and feedback

• Google Drive and Google Workspace



Required Skills

• Two or more years editing long-form interview or talking-head video content

• Demonstrated short-form vertical editing with a clear sense of what holds attention

• Strong audio editing skills, particularly recovering usable audio from imperfect remote recordings

• Fluency with AI-assisted editing tools, paired with the judgment to recognize and override weak automated

output

• Reliable, organized file management and consistent turnaround against a batch workflow

• Strong written and spoken English for direct collaboration with the client team

• Comfortable receiving detailed creative feedback during an iterative early phase



Nice to Have

• Motion graphics and animated caption or transition work

• Thumbnail and still graphic design

• YouTube publishing, metadata, and SEO familiarity

• Multi-camera in-person production experience

• Background in e-commerce, creator economy, or B2B software content

title: Ecommerce Operations Assistant (Shopify / TikTok Shop)
description:

What you need

title: Crypto BD Team Lead | DeFi Partnerships & Qualified Appointment Setting  Crypto BD Lead
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: AI Video Editor — Meta Ads
description:
AI Video Editor — Meta Ads



Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $500 – $1000 USD/month depending on experience, plus a bonus every time one of your videos becomes a winner we scale.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your reel — we will not review an application without work to watch.



What the job is



We run supplement brands and we advertise on
 every single day. Our best-performing ads are AI-generated video: VSLs built from a script, carried by B-roll we generate ourselves.



We have the scripts. We have the system. We need the person who turns a script into a finished Meta ad, every day, using Higgsfield and Google Flow.



Your work



1. Turn the script into a finished VSL.

You get a written script — hook, problem, mechanism, offer. You produce the video that delivers it: generated scenes, voiceover, cuts, captions, sound. Finished ad, ready to upload.



2. Generate the B-roll that carries each beat.

The script says "most people take three supplements a day" — you produce the shot that shows it. You write the prompts in Higgsfield and Google Flow, you generate, and you keep the look consistent from scene to scene: same lighting, same product, same world.



3. Regenerate until it matches.

The first output is never the one. You see what is off — the hands, the label, the timing, the lighting — you fix the prompt and go again. This is most of the craft.



4. Cut it for Meta.

The first three seconds d
 everything. You feel it when a cut lands one beat too slow. Correct dimensions, correct length, caption style, naming convention — every time, no interpretation.



5. Deliver a batch every day, and apply the notes.

You send the day's videos for review, you get revision notes back, you apply them the same day and resend. This loop is the job.



6. Log everything.

Every video archived with a unique name and the prompts that made it. We must be able to re-cut or rebuild any winner months later without starting from scratch.



What we need from you

You have made AI video before, with Higgsfield or Google Flow. Kling, Veo or Runway also count. You already know the first generation is rarely usable.

You can edit properly. CapCut, Premiere or After Effects — pacing, captions, sound design, clean exports.

You understand what makes an ad hold attention. A VSL is not a montage. It builds.

You follow the format exactly. Dimensions, length, captions, naming. Not open to interpretation.

Written English good enough to work from our scripts and answer our revision notes.

Extremely organised. Files, versions, prompts, archives.

You deliver every single day. This is volume with a rhythm, not one masterpiece a month.

Nice to have



ElevenLabs or any voice cloning. UGC-style ads. Direct response video — VSLs, advertorials.

Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.

A stable, long-term, full-time position.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager.

Paid trial first: one script, one finished VSL — generated B-roll, voiceover, captions, sound, Meta-ready. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.

title: Amazon Catalog Specialist
description:
Amazon Catalog & PPC Specialist

Listings, FBA Logistics, PPC

Employment Type: Remote, Full-Time    |    Reports To: Ecommerce Operations Manager



About the Role

We're a growing multi-marketplace ecommerce business (Amazon, Etsy, Walmart, eBay) selling novelty apparel, drinkware, custom gift sets, and seasonal/occasion-driven products. We're looking for a hands-on Amazon specialist who can independently manage listing optimization, FBA inventory planning, and PPC campaigns — someone who understands the mechanics behind the numbers, not just how to follow a checklist.



This is not an entry-level data-entry role. You'll be trusted with live pricing, inventory decisions with real financial consequences, and campaign budgets. Accuracy and accountability matter more than speed.



Core Responsibilities



Listing Creation & SEO Optimization

• Create new Amazon listings from scratch and optimize existing ones (titles, bullets, backend search terms) following A9 algorithm best practices

• Conduct keyword research using tools like Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet) and prioritize by conversion signal, not just raw search volume

• Maintain listing compliance with Amazon content policies, character limits, and trademark restrictions

• Optimize existing listings based on performance data and seasonal relevance

• Add and manage listing videos and enhanced content to improve conversion

• Communicate clearly and proactively — flag issues, scope changes, and confirm before acting on anything with broad or irreversible impact



FBA Inventory & Shipment Management

• Project FBA order quantities based on sales velocity, sell-through rate, and upcoming seasonal demand

• Build and upload FBA shipment plans, including flat file creation and upload

• Monitor inventory health metrics (IPI score, days of supply, excess/aged inventory) and take corrective action before problems compound

• Understand and correctly manage the distinction between FBA and FBM (merchant-fulfilled) listings — including the operational and financial implications of converting between the two

• Flag stockout or overstock risk ahead of key seasonal windows



Flat File & Catalog Management

• Confidently build, edit, and upload Amazon flat files (Price & Quantity, Inventory, Listings templates) without introducing catalog-wide errors

• Understand the difference between List Price and Sale Price fields, including Sale Start/End Date behavior, before making bulk pricing changes

• Double-check bulk changes against a defined SKU list before uploading — no catalog-wide edits without explicit scope confirmation

• Troubleshoot and resolve flat file upload errors



PPC Campaign Management

• Create and optimize Sponsored Products campaigns (auto/manual, exact/phrase/broad match structures)

• Analyze PPC reports to identify underperforming keywords, budget drains, and scaling opportunities

• Manage bids with attention to ACOS, CTR, and conversion efficiency — not spend alone

• Tie PPC strategy to seasonal demand windows and product launch timing



Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central (not just Vendor Central or general "Amazon experience")

• Proven experience with Amazon flat file editing and bulk uploads

• Working knowledge of FBA logistics: shipment creation, inventory planning, IPI score factors

• Clear understanding of FBA vs. FBM operational differences and when/how to convert between them

• Experience running and optimizing Amazon PPC campaigns with real budget accountability

• Familiarity with keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar)

• High attention to detail — this role directly affects live pricing and inventory with real financial impact

• Comfortable asking clarifying questions before making bulk or irreversible changes, rather than guessing

• Strong written communicator — able to clearly explain issues, scope, and status without back-and-forth



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience across multiple marketplaces (Etsy, Walmart, eBay)

• Experience with novelty, gift, or seasonal/occasion-driven product categories

• Familiarity with Amazon compliance issues (trademark, IP, safety violations) and how to resolve them



Put ORANGE on the "SUBJECT TITLE" for keywords



What Success Looks Like in This Role

• Bulk pricing or catalog changes are scoped, confirmed, and verified before and after upload — no unintended catalog-wide impact

• FBA shipments are timed and sized correctly against seasonal demand, with no avoidable stockouts or excess inventory

• PPC spend is monitored proactively, with issues (like bid-floor errors or underperformers) caught early, not after significant spend

• Listings are optimized based on real keyword and conversion data, not guesswork

title: Senior Graphic Designer — Amazon Creatives & Video (Long-Term)
description:
We are Goodcommerce, a German consumer-products company. We run five

brands on Amazon across Europe: fine stainless-steel jewellery, men's

accessory sets, preserved botanicals, and two design-led kids' toy

brands.



We are looking for one senior designer to own our visual output

long-term. Not per project, not for a few months. We would rather

find the right person once and keep them for years.



Two things before you read on, because they save us both time:



- There is NO unpaid test task. If your portfolio and your answers

  convince us, we go straight to a video call. We think asking

  designers to work for free is a bad way to start a relationship.

- We do read every application properly. But we only read the ones

  that follow the format at the bottom.



WHAT YOU WOULD OWN



- Amazon gallery images: infographics, feature callouts, size and

  scale visuals

- A+ Content modules: brand story, comparison charts, lifestyle

  modules

- Ad creatives for Sponsored Brands

- Short product videos for listings — editing and light motion

  graphics. We supply raw footage and product shots

- Keeping five brands visually consistent as our catalogue grows



You would be the only designer on our brands. Your work goes live and

directly moves our sales. Nobody will hand you a template to fill in.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are being specific on purpose. We would rather get twenty good

applications than two hundred generic ones.



You design for the customer, not for other designers. Our images are

judged at thumbnail size on a phone, in a search result, next to

fifteen competitors. Beautiful but unreadable is a fail for us. If

you have ever argued with someone about where the eye goes first in

an image, we will get along.



You can follow a brand guideline exactly. We have a written guideline

per brand — exact hex codes, exact fonts, defined image world. Exact

means exact. We recently had a designer recolour one of our logos

because he thought it looked better that way. That is the single

fastest way to not get this job.



You work independently. We give you the guideline, logo vectors,

product photos and a brief. We do not want to explain the basics

every week.



You tell us early. If something will be late, we want to know two

days before, not on the deadline. That alone puts you ahead of most

people.



REQUIRED

- 3+ years professional graphic design, with real e-commerce or

  marketplace work — Amazon strongly preferred

- Advanced Photoshop and Illustrator

- Video editing at listing-video level: Premiere or After Effects

- Written English good enough for detailed briefs and feedback

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and a quiet place to work



NICE TO HAVE — tell us if you have it, but it is not required

- Print-ready packaging: dielines, CMYK, bleed, prepress

- Amazon Seller Central experience

- Jewellery or kids' product categories



WHAT WE OFFER

- $1,000 - $1,300 per month, depending on what you can show us.

  Paid monthly via Wise, on the same date every month, on time

- Full-time and long-term. We are building a team, not filling a gap

- 13th month pay

- 15 days paid leave per year plus Philippine holidays

- No night shifts. We only need you online between 2 PM and 6 PM

  Manila time. The rest of your day is yours to organise

- A salary review after 6 months, and again after 12

- Real ownership of the work, and honest feedback instead of silence



HOW TO APPLY



Copy the template below into your message and fill it in. Applications

that do not use it will not be read — not because we are strict for

the sake of it, but because it is the only way we can compare people

fairly and answer everyone quickly.



Please write your answers yourself. We are not against AI, we use it

daily — but we can tell, and a generic answer tells us nothing about

you.



------- COPY FROM HERE -------



MONTOI



1. PORTFOLIO LINK:

   (required — Behance, Dribbble, Google Drive, personal site,

   anything we can open without a login)



2. THREE AMAZON IMAGES YOU DESIGNED YOURSELF:

   (links or attachments. Gallery images, infographics or A+ modules.

   If you worked in a team on any of them, say exactly what your part

   was.)



3. ONE OF THOSE THREE, RESIZED TO 300 PIXELS WIDE:

   (attach it. Yes, really — this is how our customers see it first.)



4. ONE PRODUCT VIDEO YOU EDITED:

   (link. 15-60 seconds is perfect.)



5. TAKE THE IMAGE FROM POINT 3. In your own words:

   What does the customer need to understand in the first two seconds,

   and what exactly in your design makes that happen?

   (3-5 sentences.)



6. YOUR SITUATION:

   - Expected monthly salary (USD):

   - Available from:

   - Do you currently have another full-time job or long-term client?

     (An honest yes is fine. A discovered no is not.)



7. ONE SENTENCE: what kind of design work do you actually enjoy?



------- COPY TO HERE -------



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We review applications as they come in and reply to everyone, yes or

no. If it looks like a fit, we invite you to a 20-minute video call

within a few days. If that goes well, we start with a paid trial

month at full salary, and then a long-term contract.



We are looking forward to seeing your work.



Sven Söllner

Goodcommerce GmbH

title: Podcast Video Editor | Riverside + Reels/Shorts
description:
Please read the full post before applying.



ABOUT THE PODCAST



Courageous Ones is a long-form personal development podcast hosted by Tenzin Lhoden. The show features honest conversations about courage, mindset, identity, entrepreneurship, and personal transformation.



I publish one 60–90+ minute episode each week.



THE ROLE



I am looking for one dependable podcast video editor for a long-term working relationship.



Episodes are recorded remotely through Riverside. Your job is to turn each recording into a clean full-length episode, a strong opening hook, and engaging short-form clips.



The editing style should feel professional, natural, and emotionally engaging. I do not want unnecessary effects or distracting transitions.



WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit one full podcast episode from Riverside

- Create a 30–75 second opening hook using the strongest highlights

- Add clean text to emphasize important lines

- Remove mistakes, repeated sections, technical problems, excessive pauses, and unnecessary filler

- Improve the pacing while preserving the natural conversation

- Clean, balance, and enhance the audio

- Apply basic color correction where needed

- Add the supplied intro, outro, logo, and guest information

- Find seven strong moments for short-form content

- Edit seven vertical clips under 60 seconds

- Add accurate, readable captions

- Format clips for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Keep project files and exports clearly organized

- Complete reasonable revisions after feedback



THE OPENING HOOK



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



The hook should use the most emotional, surprising, vulnerable, or thought-provoking moments from the episode. It should create curiosity without using misleading context or excessive effects.



I will provide examples showing the direction I want.



AI TOOLS ARE ENCOURAGED



I use AI in my own workflow and encourage you to use it too.



Riverside Magic Clips, Adobe Podcast, Opus Clip, Descript, Captions, ChatGPT, and similar tools are welcome.



AI should support your work. You remain responsible for checking context, caption accuracy, pacing, and final quality.



REQUIREMENTS



- Experience editing video podcasts, interviews, or talking-head content

- A portfolio showing long-form and short-form work

- Strong English comprehension

- Experience with Riverside recordings

- Experience with Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Desktop, or similar software

- Strong judgment around hooks, storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention

- Reliable internet and a computer suitable for editing large video files

- Clear communication and dependable weekly delivery

- Openness to feedback



Future episodes will also include in-person, multicamera recordings. Experience with this format is a bonus.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will receive a small paid editing test.



You will edit a short opening hook and one vertical clip from real podcast footage. This will help me evaluate your storytelling, pacing, captions, sound, and attention to detail.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



COURAGEOUS EDITOR



Please include:



1. A short introduction about your editing experience.

2. Links to two long-form podcast or interview edits.

3. Links to three Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts.

4. The editing and AI tools you use.

5. Your hourly rate.

6. Your weekly availability.

7. Your normal turnaround time.

8. A short answer to this question:



What makes a podcast opening hook strong without making it feel misleading or over-edited?



Individual editors only. No agencies.



Applications without relevant examples or the words “COURAGEOUS EDITOR” will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions Tech VA
description:
Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions

Tech VA

Compensation: Starting at $15/hour, with an eventual target of $2,000–$3,000 USD/month, depending on

experience, availability, and proven client-facing deployment capabilities

Schedule: CST Time Zone

Employment Type: Contract

Seniority: Senior-Level



About the Role



We are looking for a Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions Tech VA who can bridge the gap

between client business needs and technical implementation.

This is not a purely execution-focused automation role. You will join discovery and sales calls, understand

the client's operational challenges, determine technical feasibility, recommend practical solutions, scope

implementations, and then take ownership of building, testing, deploying, and stabilizing those solutions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI automation specialist with strong client-facing and business

communication skills who can work independently with minimal supervision. You should be comfortable

turning ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions while maintaining realistic expectations

around scope, timelines, complexity, and fulfillment requirements.

Key Responsibilities



Client Discovery & Technical Consulting



Join prospect and client discovery calls as the company's technical solutions expert.

Lead the technical portion of discovery conversations and uncover:

Current workflows and processes

Operational bottlenecks

Existing systems and tools

Business requirements

Automation opportunities

Desired outcomes and success metrics

Ask strong technical and operational questions to fully understand the client's needs.

Identify the most practical initial solution based on business value, technical feasibility, complexity,

cost, and deployment risk.

Clearly communicate technical limitations and avoid overpromising.



Solution Design & Scoping



Translate discovery findings into clear technical scopes and implementation plans.

Develop workflow maps, technical requirements, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and

estimated fulfillment requirements.

Assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risks, integrations, and potential blockers

before proposals are finalized.

Support Client in developing accurate proposals and setting realistic client expectations.

Support solution demonstrations and technical presentations when required.



AI Automation & Implementation



Build, configure, test, and deploy approved AI automation solutions.

Develop CRM automations, AI agents, lead qualification systems, appointment-booking workflows,

follow-up sequences, and system integrations.

Integrate third-party platforms through APIs, webhooks, and automation tools.

Work with platforms such as GoHighLevel and leading no-code/low-code automation platforms.

Build and deploy solutions involving AI voice, SMS,
, lead reactivation, candidate engagement,

and appointment setting where applicable.

Ensure implementations are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the approved scope.



Testing, QA & Troubleshooting



Test every workflow end-to-end before client launch.

Validate integrations, triggers, actions, data flow, notifications, and edge cases.

Troubleshoot technical issues independently and resolve problems with minimal supervision.

Identify and address potential failure points before deployment.

Minimize technical errors, rework, and preventable scope changes.



Client Implementation & Post-Launch Support



Own client onboarding and implementation from approved scope through successful deployment.

Provide clear and proactive updates on progress, blockers, decisions, and next steps.

Create technical documentation and implementation records for every deployment.

Support post-launch stabilization and troubleshoot issues that arise after implementation.

Ensure reliable handoff and maintain stable, functioning automations after launch.

Identify potential expansion opportunities only after the initial implementation has produced a

measurable result.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Coordinate effectively with closers, account managers, developers, internal teams, and third-party

vendors.

Communicate technical requirements and implementation needs clearly to non-technical and

technical stakeholders.

Proactively manage dependencies and escalate critical blockers when necessary.

Manage multiple client opportunities and implementations while maintaining quality and

responsiveness.





Required Qualifications



Senior-level experience designing, building, testing, and deploying AI automation solutions for

external clients.

Proven experience participating in client discovery, technical consulting, or solution-selling

conversations.

Ability to ask strong technical and operational questions and independently identify appropriate

solutions.

Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into:

Technical requirements

Workflow designs

Implementation scopes

Timelines

Milestones

Deployment plans

Strong hands-on experience with:

CRM automation

APIs

Webhooks

AI agents

Lead qualification

Appointment booking

Follow-up automation

System integrations

Strong proficiency with GoHighLevel and leading no-code/low-code automation platforms.

Ability to assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risks, dependencies, and fulfillment

requirements before a proposal is finalized.

Excellent client-facing communication skills and strong business judgment.

Ability to avoid overpromising and set realistic expectations with clients.

Capable of working independently with minimal direction or hand-holding.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to document solutions and test workflows end-to-end.

Demonstrated ability to provide reliable post-launch support.

Must have verifiable examples of successful client deployments.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting staffing, recruiting, professional services, or agency clients.

Experience building:

AI voice systems

SMS automation

 automation

Lead-reactivation campaigns

Candidate-engagement systems

Appointment-setting workflows

Familiarity with white-label AI automation agency delivery.

Experience supporting proposal development, solution demonstrations, and sales calls.



Knowledge of data privacy, permission management, and secure credential handling.

Experience managing multiple client implementations simultaneously.

Experience coordinating with closers, account managers, developers, and third-party vendors.

Strong understanding of client delivery processes and post-launch support.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means being able to take ownership of an opportunity from discovery → solution

design → scoping → proposal support → implementation → testing → launch → stabilization without

requiring continuous oversight.

You should be able to confidently answer:

“What does the client need, what is the best technical solution, how should we scope it,

how do we build it, and how do we make sure it works?”

You are expected to balance technical capability, business value, client experience, and

implementation risk in every solution you recommend.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Discovery calls attended and converted into technically viable solution plans.

Speed and accuracy of technical scoping following discovery calls.

Percentage of deployments delivered on time and within approved scope.

Successful end-to-end testing before client launch.

Low rate of rework, technical errors, and preventable scope changes.

Client satisfaction and responsiveness throughout implementation.

Clear documentation and reliable handoff for every deployment.



Ability to manage opportunities and implementations without continuous oversight.

Stability and reliability of automations after launch.

Quality of technical recommendations and accuracy of implementation estimates.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior AI automation practitioner who can also operate confidently in front of

clients.



You are not simply someone who knows how to build workflows—you understand why the workflow

should be built, what business problem it solves, what is realistically achievable, and how to

successfully deliver it to a client.

You take ownership, communicate proactively, think commercially, troubleshoot independently, and are

accountable for the outcome of every implementation you take on.



Contract & Working Requirements



Contract position

Must be available to work within CST hours

Starting compensation of $15/hour

Potential to reach $2,000–$3,000 USD/month based on experience, availability, and demonstrated

client-facing deployment capability

Candidates must be prepared to provide verifiable examples, case studies, portfolios, or

demonstrations of successful AI automation deployments

title: SEO content and topical authority assistant
description:
We are looking for a reliable SEO content specialist to support a growing portfolio of UK businesses across several different industries.



This is not a role for someone who simply generates articles using ChatGPT and sends them over.



We already use AI extensively.



What we need is someone who can think.



You should understand why a page exists, what somebody is searching for, how that page fits into the wider website, what supporting content should surround it, and how to make the finished content sound like the actual business rather than generic AI-generated copy.



This will initially be a part-time position with the potential to grow significantly for the right person.



## What you will be doing



Your work will include:



* Researching topics and search intent before writing

* Reviewing Google search results and competitor content

* Creating SEO content briefs

* Identifying content clusters and supporting article opportunities

* Writing service pages, location pages, landing pages and articles

* Creating internal linking recommendations

* Identifying relevant entities, subtopics and FAQs

* Following an existing keyword strategy where provided

* Helping expand broad keywords into useful topical clusters

* Matching the tone of voice of completely different client brands

* Updating and improving existing content

* Structuring articles properly using headings and logical information hierarchy

* Using AI to accelerate your work without allowing AI to replace your judgement

* Fact checking anything generated with AI before submitting it



You will not initially be responsible for uploading content into WordPress.



Your responsibility is creating high-quality content and recommendations that are ready for our team to review and publish.



## What good work looks like



If we give you a plumbing company, SaaS company and professional services business, the content should not sound like it came from the same writer or prompt.



Before writing an article, you should naturally be asking questions such as:



What is the actual search intent?



What pages already exist on the website?



What should this page link to?



What pages should link back to this page?



Is this a standalone topic or part of a larger cluster?



What information is competitors consistently covering?



What are competitors missing?



Does this article genuinely deserve to rank?



Could somebody tell that AI helped produce this?



If your process is simply keyword + prompt + 1,500-word article, this role will not be a good fit.



## Skills we are looking for



You should have experience with several of the following:



* SEO content writing

* Search intent analysis

* Keyword research

* Topic clustering

* Topical authority

* Content briefs

* Content optimisation

* Internal linking

* Competitor research

* SERP analysis

* Google Search Console

* Ahrefs, Semrush or similar SEO tools

* WordPress

* ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools



You do not need to know everything.



Strong thinking, attention to detail and reliability matter more to us than having every SEO certification available.



## Using AI



We actively encourage the use of AI.



However, there is a major difference between using AI as a tool and submitting AI-generated content without thinking.



AI can help you research, organise, expand, draft and edit.



You are still responsible for:



* Accuracy

* Originality

* Search intent

* Structure

* Brand voice

* Relevance

* Quality



We will reject generic AI content.



## Working arrangement



This is initially a part-time remote position.



Starting budget:



$200 to $300 USD per month depending on experience, availability and output.



We care more about consistent high-quality output than tracking every minute you work.



If you become someone we can trust across client accounts, there is substantial scope for the role, responsibilities and compensation to increase.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming part of the way we operate rather than somebody looking to churn through another freelance writing gig.



## How to apply



Please do not send a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



**Purple Penguin**



Applications without those words will be ignored.



Then answer the following five questions.



### 1. Show us your work



Send links to two pieces of SEO content you personally created.



For each one, briefly explain:



* What keyword or topic you targeted

* What the search intent was

* What you personally did

* Why you structured the content the way you did



### 2. Show us how you think about clusters



Imagine you are working with a UK plumber who wants to rank for:



**boiler installation**



Give us:



* The primary page you would create

* Five supporting content ideas

* Two related commercial pages

* How you would internally link these pages together



Keep this concise.



### 3. Tell us how you use AI



Explain exactly how you currently use ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool when creating SEO content.



We are not looking for somebody who claims they never use AI.



We want to understand your process.



### 4. Spot the problem



Tell us why the following approach is weak:



"Find a keyword with good volume, ask ChatGPT to write a 2,000-word SEO article about it, add the keyword to the title and headings, then publish it."



Your answer should be no more than 150 words.



### 5. Tell us about you



Include:



* Your current availability

* Your expected monthly salary

* Your timezone

* How many clients or employers you currently work with

* The SEO tools you have previously used



Finally, at the bottom of your application, tell us your favourite food.



This is simply to confirm you have read the entire job description.



## Important



Please do not apply if:



* You submit completely AI-generated applications

* You cannot demonstrate previous writing

* You frequently miss deadlines

* You need detailed instructions for every small task

* You consider SEO writing to mean putting keywords into an article repeatedly

* You are applying for dozens of unrelated VA jobs at the same time



We are happy to teach our processes.



We cannot teach care, curiosity or reliability.



If you are someone who enjoys understanding why content performs rather than simply producing more words, we would like to hear from you.

title: Admin & Operations Assistant
description:

Location: 100% remote (based in Philippines)

_________________________________________________

Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.

We’re looking for a proactive, curious Admin & Operations Assistant to join our team!

If you're naturally curious, detail-oriented, and love bringing order to day-to-day workflows, we’d love to hear from you!

Role Overview:

- Maintain internal FAQs, and maintain SOP documentation to keep team resources up to date.

- Identify any inefficiencies or potential issues, and provide insights on how we can improve our operational processes and systems.



- Support B2B operations, including database cleanup, software administration and the fulfilment of wholesale orders.

_________________________________________________

You’re a Fit If You Have:

- You have a natural curiosity to dig into unfamiliar topics and find clear answers online independently.



- Natural organizer who ensures processes are followed and deliverables hit their target dates.



- You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, forecasting stock needs, auditing fulfillment issues, and keeping tabs on 3PL packaging accuracy and wholesale orders.



- Able to work independently without hand-holding, with a keen eye for detail that spots mistakes, typos, or stock count errors before they cause issues.



- Adaptable team player who thrives switching between admin tasks and operations support.

_________________________________________________

Why Join JazzUpCo?

- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our product performance and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



-Learning & Career Path – Learn directly from the founder and consultants and growing into a senior Admin & Ops executive.  



- Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and your voice is actually heard.

_________________________________________________

Our Culture: E-F-G



E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.

_________________________________________________



Next Steps:

1) Apply → Via the application form - 
 (OJPH)

2) First Interview → Get to know each other

3) Trial Task → Show us how you think and execute

4) Join the Team → Onboarding + probation → full-time hire



We can’t wait to meet you ????

description:
