You must have at least 4 years of experience designing plumbing and fire-fighting systems and be able to perform the engineering calculations yourself. This is not a CAD or Revit drafting role. You will be responsible for the design, calculations, coordination, and final deliverables.



About This Role

We are looking for an experienced MEP Design Engineer – Plumbing (PHE) to design plumbing and fire-fighting systems for residential and commercial projects.



You will work on systems including water supply, hot water, drainage, stormwater, rainwater harvesting, sewer and venting, sewage ejectors, sprinklers, hydrants, and fire pumps.



You will perform the required hydraulic and sizing calculations, create designs and 3D models, prepare BOQs and material take-offs, and participate in BIM coordination and clash resolution.



What You’ll Do

4+ years of experience in plumbing/PHE and fire-fighting design

SketchUp

STAAD.Pro

title: AI Video Producer & Editor - UGC, VSL & Animation Ads
description:
AI VIDEO PRODUCER & EDITOR - UGC, VSL & ANIMATION ADS

Remote | Project based, paid per batch | Start: ASAP | $40 - $110 per batch





READ THIS FIRST



This job post is long. That is on purpose.



I am hiring ONE person. I would rather get 5 serious applications than 200 lazy ones. If you send the same message to 40 job posts a day, close this now - you will not get through.



But please do not be scared off either. You will not be inventing anything. You get the script, the reference ad, the format specs and every tool paid for. What you need is to already be good at this, and to deliver on time.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





ABOUT US



We run five direct-response e-commerce brands on Shopify. We sell physical products to customers in the United States, and we advertise on
 and Instagram at a four-figure daily budget.



Every single ad we run is produced with AI. No film crew, no studio, no actors. That is the whole model.





THE BIG IDEA - WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS MORE THAN A NORMAL EDITING JOB



Right now our creative output is the bottleneck. Not the budget, not the products, not the audience - the number of finished ads we can put in front of people.



That is a strange and very specific problem to have: we can fund more ad spend than we can produce ads for. Every week we do not ship enough new creatives is a week we leave money on the table, because in paid advertising creatives burn out. An ad that prints money today is tired in three weeks, and if there is nothing new to replace it, the whole account cools down.



So the number of ads you deliver is not a production statistic. It is the ceiling on how big this business can get. That is the job.



Concretely: we want to go from a handful of finished ads per week to 15-20 finished ads per week within your first 60 days, without the quality dropping.



This is a doer role, not a manager role. You produce. Nobody reports to you and you do not build a team. If that changes later, it changes because you made it obvious that it should.





WHAT YOU WILL PRODUCE



You must be able to produce all of these yourself:



- AI UGC ads - a generated person on camera showing and talking about a product

- VSL edits - longer sales videos cut to a script we give you

- AI voiceover - written, generated and timed to the cut

- Cartoon and claymation ads - stylized animation, not photoreal

- 1:1 ad iterations - this one matters most, see below

- The cut itself - captions burned in, clean sans-serif, inside the safe zone, hook in the first two seconds, no dead air, exported to spec



Strongly preferred on top of that: Suno-style music ads where a song carries the ad, talking-head avatar ads, and Disney-style animation.



About the 1:1 iterations, because this is the majority of the work and it is where people drop out: we hand you an ad that already works and you rebuild it exactly, changing one variable. Same structure, same pacing, same feel, different hook or different actor. If the reference has a cut on beat four, your version has a cut on beat four. "Close enough" is not a delivery. If you need creative freedom to stay motivated, you will not enjoy this role - and we would both rather find that out now.





WHAT A BATCH IS



We work in batches, not in hours.



BATCH A - Cut only. Ten finished ads from clips and product footage we send you. 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.



BATCH B - Full production. Three to five finished ads, generated and cut by you from a script. Usually one concept with hook variations.



Right now we run 3-4 batches per week. That number grows as we scale, and we want the person who grows with it.



Turnaround: a batch is delivered within 48 hours of receiving the brief and the assets.





STOP. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY.



Start your message with the word ORANGE, exactly like this:



ORANGE - Your Full Name



Apply right here through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not
 us - we read everything in this system and nowhere else. If ORANGE is not the first thing in your message we will never see it, no matter how good your portfolio is. This is not a joke and there is no exception. Most applicants will fail this, and that is fine.





ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



This is the part we care about most, so we are going to be very clear.



We are not looking for someone who never has a problem. Everybody gets sick. Power goes out. Family emergencies happen. Typhoons happen. We have zero problem with any of that.



What we have a problem with is silence.



If you are ill, if your internet dies, if a render fails and the batch will be late - send us one message. Before the deadline, not after it. That is all we ask, and if you do it, we will always find a solution together.



Going quiet on a batch is the one thing that ends this immediately. Not because we are strict, but because we plan ad launches around your delivery date and we cannot plan around someone we have to chase.



Beyond that, we expect three things:



- You can already do this. We give you the tools, the budget, the script and the specs. We do not teach you the craft. If you are hoping to learn AI video generation on this job, this is the wrong job and we will both waste our time.

- You ask before you produce. When a brief is unclear you ask first, instead of delivering five wrong ads and then explaining them.

- You flag what will not work. If a script cannot be built visually, tell us before you start, not after the render.





THE TOP THREE SKILLS WE ARE HIRING FOR



1. AI video generation - you already produce photoreal or stylized AI footage today, in production, not as an experiment

2. Short-form direct-response editing - you understand pacing, hooks, and why an ad dies in second three

3. Speed with consistency - you deliver on schedule, and batch number twelve looks like batch number one





WHAT YOU MUST BRING (hard requirements)



1. 2+ years producing or editing short-form video, at least the last year with AI-generated footage.



2. You have shipped AI video in production - for clients, for a brand, or for your own offers. Not tutorials, not test renders. We want to see the actual ads.



3. CapCut or Premiere Pro for the cut, your pick, as long as the output is consistent.



4. Hands-on with at least one serious AI generation stack, and the judgment to know when a generation is unusable and needs to be redone instead of shipped.



5. You work in OUR generation stack, and that stack is built on Polaris. Read the tools section below before you apply - this is the one thing about our setup that is not up for discussion, and we would rather you know it now than on day one.



6. Conversational English, spoken and written.



7. Reliable internet, a machine that can handle the work, and the ability to hit a 48-hour turnaround.



8. Willing to sign a freelance contract and a short NDA before you get access to our assets.





BONUS (not required, but it moves you to the top of the list)



- You have already worked in Polaris, or in a comparable AI ad studio, and can tell us what it is good at and where it falls apart

- You have produced paid ads before, not just organic content

- After Effects

- ElevenLabs or comparable voice tools

- You have built your own generation workflow and can explain why it is faster than the obvious one

- Music-driven ads, avatar ads, Disney-style animation





THE TOOLS WE USE



We pay for everything, including every single generation. You never pay for a credit or a subscription.



POLARIS IS THE CORE OF OUR STACK, AND WORKING IN IT IS PART OF THE JOB.



Polaris (
) is an AI ad studio built specifically for e-commerce: you give it a product URL or a product image and it produces UGC-style video and image ads. It generates the footage, it generates the AI actors, it writes the captions, and its ad cloner rebuilds an existing winning ad with one variable changed. That last part is exactly the 1:1 iteration work described above, which is the majority of what you will do here - which is why we picked it.



We have tested the alternatives. Polaris is faster and cheaper per finished ad than anything else we ran, and that difference is the whole reason this role exists at the volume it does. So this is not a preference we will negotiate away: if you come on board, you produce in Polaris.



You do NOT need previous Polaris experience. We do not expect anyone to have used it for years - it is new. We pay for the account, and if you already know your way around any modern AI generation tool, you will be productive in it within a day or two. What we do need is that you are genuinely willing to move into our stack instead of insisting on the workflow you already have. If that is a dealbreaker for you, this is the wrong role and we would both rather find out before the call.



Around Polaris we also work with Magnific and Higgsfield for generation, ElevenLabs for voice, and CapCut for the cut. Those we are flexible on: if you have a faster way to get to the same output, bring it and we will look at it together on the call. Polaris is the fixed point, the rest is open.



Communication runs on
 and
. Files live in a shared asset library with a fixed folder structure and naming convention.





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Every tool account and every generation, fully paid - Polaris included. You never spend your own money on this job.

- The script for every ad - you never write copy

- Format specs and reference ads, so "done" is never a guess

- A proper shared asset library. You will not be hunting for files.

- One revision round per batch, with specific feedback, not vague feedback

- Direct access to the person making the decisions. No account manager, no layers.





WORKING STYLE AND WHERE THIS ROLE IS GOING



- Fully remote. We do not care where you sit.

- The work itself is asynchronous. No shift, no fixed working hours, no being on call. You get a brief, you deliver a batch within 48 hours, and how you organize your day is your business.

- No overlap with our time zone required for the work. We are in Europe and Asia; you will not be asked to work nights.

- One fixed 30-minute call per week, camera on. We agree on the day and time together once you start, and then it stays there. That is where we go through what landed and what did not, where the revisions keep coming from, what you need from us, and what we want produced next. You get direct feedback and we expect you to use it. We also expect you to tell us when a brief is bad or a spec makes no sense - that call goes both ways.

- This is high tempo. We are a small operation scaling paid ads aggressively, priorities move, and a batch that was due Friday is due Friday. If you need a slow, predictable environment, this is not it.

- Where this is going: volume grows as we scale. More batches per week, higher rates, and first pick of the work. Long-term is the point - we are not looking for a one-off gig, we want one person who gets faster every month.





HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



Five numbers, nothing else:



1. Batches delivered per week

2. Turnaround time per batch - target: under 48 hours

3. Revision rounds per batch - target: one or fewer

4. Spec compliance - correct format, safe zone, naming, folder

5. Iteration accuracy - does your 1:1 rebuild actually match the reference



We do not measure hours. We do not measure how hard something was.





COMPENSATION (all amounts in USD)



You are paid per delivered batch. Not per hour, not per month. We start low and we go up fast, and we are honest about that instead of promising you a number we do not know you are worth yet.



STARTING RATE - your first batches:

Batch A (10 finished cuts): $40

Batch B (3-5 full productions): $70



AFTER 4 ACCEPTED BATCHES, delivered on time and to spec:

Batch A: $60

Batch B: $110



We review again after that. If you are fast and consistent, the rate keeps moving up. This is not a carrot we dangle - it is how we pay everyone who works with us long-term.



At 3-4 batches per week that is roughly $1,400 to $1,800 per month once you are past the starting rate, and the volume is growing.



Also included:



- Paid on delivery of each accepted batch, every time, no delays. Wise or PayPal, your choice.

- Every tool, every subscription and every generation credit paid by us

- Bonuses when the business does well - when we grow, you grow

- No equity and no revenue share. This is paid work with a clear rate.



Why we start low: we have been burned by portfolios that did not match the actual output. Four batches is enough for both of us to know whether this works. If you are as good as your portfolio says, you are at the higher rate within two weeks.





ENGLISH



Your portfolio tells us nothing about your English - the voice on those ads was generated. So we ask separately.



Two steps, and we are open about both. First, the short recording you send with your application: that is how we hear you before anyone spends time on a call. Then a video call in English, camera on, before we hire anyone. You need to be able to hold a normal working conversation - understand a brief, ask a question back, say when something will not work.



Written English alone is not enough. We have been burned by exactly this before and we are not doing it again.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with ORANGE - Your Full Name.



Keep it short. We are not asking you to do unpaid work to apply - nothing below takes more than ten minutes, and nothing below is work you have to invent for us. Be specific: vague answers are the fastest way to get rejected.



1. YOUR WORK. Links to 2-3 AI videos or ads YOU made. Own work only - no agency reels, no team projects, no "I was part of the team that". For each one, tell us which tools you used and what your part was.



2. YOUR SETUP AND YOUR SPEED. Which tools do you work in, and roughly how many finished 15-second ads can you produce in a working day? A real number, not "many".



3. POLARIS. One or two sentences, nothing more. Have you used Polaris (
) before - yes or no? Either answer is fine, we are not filtering on it. What we want to know is whether you are willing to produce in it as your main tool, because that is how this role works. If you have used it, tell us what you built with it.



4. WHAT YOU WANT TO EARN per batch, for Batch A and for Batch B.



5. A 60-SECOND RECORDING OF YOURSELF SPEAKING ENGLISH. Loom, a voice message, an unlisted YouTube link, whatever is easiest. Introduce yourself and walk us through one of the videos you linked above: what you made, which tools, what was hard about it. No production, no script, no editing - phone camera or just audio is completely fine, and we mean that. This is the one thing you send us that is not supposed to look produced. We are not judging your setup or your confidence on camera. We want to hear how you speak English, because that d
 whether this works. Send it as a separate link from your portfolio links so we do not mix them up.



That is it. No cover letter, no essay, no test task. If your work looks right and we can understand each other, we talk.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We look at your work and listen to your recording

2. Short video call in English, camera on

3. After the call: a small PAID test batch on a real brief, produced in Polaris. We set up your account and walk you through it first - the test measures whether you can hit a spec, not whether you can guess your way around a new interface.

4. Hire, starting rate, then the rate review after 4 accepted batches



The test comes after we have spoken, not before. You get paid for it whether or not we hire you. We keep the number of tests small on purpose, so if you get there you are already a serious candidate.



Applications that do not start correctly, or that skip any of the 5 points, will not be reviewed. We are strict about this on purpose: following a brief exactly is the single most important part of this job.



We reply to every application that follows the instructions, and we reply fast.



If this sounds like you, apply today. We are hiring one person and we are hiring quickly.



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph - start your message with: ORANGE - Your Full Name

title: VSL Ads Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
Let me be upfront with you, because that's how we operate.



We're a D2C e-commerce brand in the women's health space. We sell a product that genuinely helps people, and every piece of content we produce reflects that. No misleading claims. No bait-and-switch.



We're into a 5-year vision. We're scaling aggressively in the English-speaking market, and we need editors who grow with us, not editors who disappear when a bigger project comes along, and not a company that goes quiet after 3 months because the brand didn't work out.



We're in this for the long game. We want you to be too.



- THE ROLE:



Position: Direct Response VSL Video Editor (Health/Pain Relief Specialist)

Commitment: Full-time, long-term (this is not a freelance gig)

Compensation: $1,500 monthly + performance bonuses

Location: 100% remote

Hours: 40h/week

Market: English-speaking



- WHAT LONG-TERM ACTUALLY MEANS HERE:



- Year-over-year salary increases of 10–20% for strong performers

- Performance bonuses tied directly to VSL and ad conversion rates

- Creative ownership, you won't be executing someone else's vision blindly. You'll understand the strategy, the avatar, the psychology behind every piece of content

- A real team, you'll work closely with the founder and marketing lead, not get lost in a ticket queue



- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Non-negotiable:



- 2+ years editing Direct Response VSLs ads (health/women's wellness a strong plus)

- Proven retention, you understand why a cut happens at second 4, not just how to make it

- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects

- Experience with AI video tools (HeyGen, Veo, etc.)



Strong preference:



- You've edited ads that actually ran and converted

- You understand
/Instagram ad formats and platform behavior

- You've worked with health or wellness brands and know the compliance landscape



- WHO THRIVES HERE:



You care about the work beyond the deliverable. You watch your edited videos after they go live and wonder how to make the next one better. You understand that a 3-second hook isn't decoration, it's the difference between a winning creative and a dead one.



You want to be part of something being built, not just service it.



- WHO THIS IS NOT FOR:



If you're looking to freelance across 6 clients simultaneously, this isn't the right fit. We want someone who is genuinely invested in one brand's growth, because that's where the real upside is.



- THE PROCESS:



We review every application carefully. Portfolio quality matters far more than volume. If your work is strong and your approach is right, you'll hear from us within a week.



We move fast, but we don't rush the decision on people.

title: UK Lettings & Tenancy Management (Maintenance)
description:

Over the last 12 months, our Virtual Assistants have played a huge part in our success. We believe in investing in our people, providing genuine career progression opportunities and creating an environment where team members are trusted, valued and developed for the future.

This is more than just an administration role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, solve problems, build relationships and become a key member of our growing business.



About the Role?



You will work as part of our Tenancy Management Team, supporting landlords, tenants, contractors and fellow team members to deliver exceptional customer service.



Your responsibilities will include:

Managing maintenance issues from initial report through to completion

Liaising with landlords, tenants and contractors

Providing clear and professional updates to all parties

Handling inbound and outbound telephone calls

Managing
 enquiries and service tickets

Updating records within our CRM system (Street)

Assisting with tenancy administration and property management tasks

Supporting colleagues across other departments when required

Delivering the highest standards of customer service

✅ Minimum 2 years' experience within UK lettings or property management

✅ Excellent spoken and written English

✅ Strong attention to detail

✅ Excellent communication skills

✅ Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

✅ Comfortable speaking with landlords, tenants and contractors

✅ Reliable internet connection

✅ Own laptop or desktop computer

✅ Professional headset and webcam

✅ Dedicated and quiet workspace (no internet cafés or public working environments)

✅ Positive attitude and willingness to learn



Knowledge & Experience

Tenancy management

Property maintenance

Deposit protection

Compliance requirements

Gas Safety Certificates

EICRs

Property licensing

Street CRM

✅ Communicate proactively

✅ Work well under pressure

✅ Have excellent organisational skills

✅ Be confident dealing with difficult situations

✅ Support and encourage other team members

✅ Show leadership qualities and initiative

✅ Want a long term career, not just a job



What Success Looks Like?



You will be measured against:

Inbox and tickets responded to within 24 hours

Maintenance jobs kept within company targets

Landlord retention

Customer communication standards

5-Star Google Reviews

Teamwork and contribution to company culture



Bonus Structure



Performance Bonus: $100 per month



Awarded when maintenance jobs remain within company targets:

Urgent jobs managed within required timescales

High Priority jobs under 7 days

Medium Priority jobs under 14 days

Low Priority jobs under 28 days



Google Review Bonus: $5 

For every verified 5-Star Google Review received



Top Review Generator Award: $50 bonus

Awarded to the team member generating the most 5-Star Google Reviews each month.



Monthly Team Recognition Award: $50 bonus

Awarded to the team member voted for by their colleagues.



Why Join ForTheLandlords?



✅ Genuine career progression opportunities



✅ Supportive team environment



✅ Achievable bonus structure



✅ Ongoing training and development



✅ Leadership opportunities



✅ Stable long-term role



✅ Friendly and collaborative culture



✅ Work with a business that values its Virtual Assistants



Our team regularly tells us they enjoy working here because everyone is willing to help each other succeed, hard work is recognised and opportunities for progression are real.



Team Meetings & Culture



You'll be expected to attend:

Monday morning team meeting

Wednesday team meeting

Friday morning team meeting

Monthly performance reviews



All UK and overseas remote staff work are required to be present on a call through Microsoft Teams throughout the day to ensure everyone feels supported, connected and part of the team.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Travel Content (4–5 videos/month, ongoing)
description:
About us



We're a Rome-based tour company running Colosseum, Vatican, and food tour experiences, with a 120k+ social following built over the past year. Our team ideates, narrates, and films everything on the ground in Rome. We need an editor to turn that raw footage into finished, publish-ready short-form video.



You will not be asked to come up with concepts or write scripts. Our guides handle the storytelling. Your job is the cut.



This is a low-volume, long-term role — 4–5 videos per month, consistently, month after month. We're looking for someone who wants a steady side engagement they can rely on, not a full workload.



What you'll do



- Edit raw footage into vertical short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Cut for retention: strong hook in the first 3 seconds, tight pacing, no dead air

- Add captions/subtitles with clean timing and readable styling

- Sound design — clean up narration audio, add music and effects, match trending audio where relevant

- Basic color correction so Rome actually looks like Rome

- Deliver 4–5 finished videos per month in correct aspect ratios and formats

- Keep raw footage and project files organized in our shared drive



Requirements



- 2+ years editing short-form social video, with a portfolio of published work (not practice projects)

- Fluent in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro. After Effects or motion graphics is a plus, not required

- Strong grasp of hook structure, pacing, and caption design for vertical video

- Reliable internet capable of downloading multi-GB footage files

- Written English strong enough to follow briefs and flag questions without back-and-forth

- Responsive within 24 hours even in weeks when there's no active edit



Nice to have



- Travel, hospitality, or destination content experience

- Familiarity with Instagram and TikTok trends in the travel space

- Basic thumbnail or graphic design



Hiring process



- Application review

- Paid test edit using our real raw footage (you'll be paid for this regardless of outcome)

- Short interview

- Ongoing engagement, reviewed after the first three videos



How to apply



Send a message with:



- The word COLOSSEUM as the first word of your message (applications without it will be skipped)

- Links to 5 short-form videos you personally edited — tell us specifically what you did on each

- Which editing software you use daily

- Your per-video rate for a 30–60 second vertical edit

- One sentence: what makes a travel Reel stop someone from scrolling?

title: Remote Accounting & QuickBooks Assistant
description:
Finance & Accounting

Remote · Full-Time · U.S. Business Hours



This is a high-volume, multi-company bookkeeping role — not a single-set-of-books position. You will manage bookkeeping activities across several companies, reconcile approximately 40 bank and credit card accounts each month, process a high volume of invoices, post intercompany journal entries, support bi-weekly payroll, and meet recurring month-end deadlines independently. Hands-on QuickBooks experience is required. Canadian GST and QST knowledge is valuable, but experience with VAT or a similar sales tax system can be transferable. If your experience is limited to maintaining one set of books at a low or moderate volume, or you require close supervision to meet deadlines, this role is likely not a fit.



We are looking for an experienced Accounting & QuickBooks Assistant to support the financial operations of a growing healthcare and optical clinic group.



This role involves maintaining accurate financial records across multiple companies and entities, rather than managing a single set of books. You will work extensively in QuickBooks, process invoices, reconcile bank and credit card accounts, support payroll, reconcile insurance payments and claims, track accounts receivable, and handle intercompany accounting.



The role requires strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a significant transaction volume while keeping each company's records accurate and properly separated. You will also be responsible for identifying and resolving discrepancies rather than simply recording transactions.



About This Role

You will handle day-to-day bookkeeping activities across several company files, including entering and categorizing transactions, processing invoices and supporting documentation, and ensuring expenses are coded correctly.



A major part of the role is account reconciliation. You will reconcile approximately 40 bank and credit card accounts each month against their statements, investigate transactions that do not match, and make the necessary corrections.



You will also support bi-weekly payroll for doctors, prepare payroll summaries, reconcile insurance payments and claims across multiple clinic locations, and maintain accurate monthly insurance records.



At month end, you will assist with intercompany accounting, including posting journal entries and reconciling transactions between entities. You will also reconcile the practice management system against QuickBooks to identify and resolve differences.



The organization operates in Canada, so familiarity with GST and QST is helpful. However, direct Canadian tax experience is not required if you have practical experience working with VAT or another comparable sales tax system and understand the underlying concepts.



This position requires someone who can manage recurring deadlines independently, maintain accuracy despite high transaction volumes, and take ownership of bookkeeping responsibilities with minimal supervision.



What You’ll Do

Enter and categorize transactions across multiple QuickBooks company files

Process invoices and supporting documentation

Ensure accurate expense and account categorization

Review transactions for GST and QST compliance

Reconcile approximately 40 bank and credit card accounts each month

Compare account activity against monthly bank and credit card statements

Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies

Assist with bi-weekly doctor payroll

Prepare payroll summaries and supporting information

Reconcile insurance payments and claims across multiple clinic locations

Maintain accurate monthly insurance records

Track accounts receivable

Post intercompany journal entries at month end

Reconcile transactions between multiple entities

Reconcile the practice management system against QuickBooks

Investigate and resolve differences between systems and company files

Maintain accurate and organized financial records

Meet recurring payroll and month-end deadlines

Identify bookkeeping issues and resolve them independently

Maintain confidentiality of financial and business information

What We’re Looking For

Hands-on QuickBooks bookkeeping experience

Experience working with multiple company files or entities

Practical bookkeeping experience in a high-volume environment

Bank and credit card reconciliation experience

Invoice processing and expense categorization experience

Understanding of sales tax accounting

Knowledge of GST and QST is an advantage

Experience with VAT or a similar sales tax system is acceptable as transferable experience

Payroll support experience

Experience with intercompany journal entries

Accounts receivable tracking experience

Insurance payment or insurance reconciliation experience

Strong attention to detail

Strong numerical and analytical skills

Ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies

Ability to manage a high volume of transactions without sacrificing accuracy

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Ability to consistently meet recurring payroll and month-end deadlines

Strong written and verbal English communication skills



Important: This role is not limited to transaction entry. You will be expected to review your work, identify discrepancies, investigate problems, and resolve issues independently.



Nice to Have

Experience with Wink or another healthcare/practice management system

Experience in healthcare, medical, dental, or optical clinic accounting

title: Technical Support Specialist – Security Systems
description:
Customer Support

Remote · Full-Time · U.S. Business Hours



This is remote diagnosis, not hands-on repair. You will not be physically touching the equipment. Instead, you will diagnose problems based on information provided by customers or field technicians and guide them through the appropriate troubleshooting steps. You need to know how to ask the right questions, interpret the answers, identify the likely cause, and explain the solution clearly enough for a non-technical person to follow. Experience with a specific manufacturer is not required — Honeywell, Bosch, Hikvision, Dahua, and similar platforms are helpful but can be learned. What is required is real hands-on troubleshooting experience with security, alarm, or low-voltage systems. If your background is primarily installation or bench repair without remote technical support, this role is likely not a fit.



We are looking for a Technical Support Specialist – Security Systems to provide remote technical support for alarm systems, security cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and access control equipment.



You will troubleshoot issues remotely through phone,
, and remote access. Customers may have little or no technical knowledge, so you must be able to translate technical problems into simple, clear instructions. You will also work with field technicians when an issue requires an on-site visit.



The role requires someone who can think through a problem independently rather than simply follow a troubleshooting script. You will need to determine whether an issue is related to configuration, connectivity, programming, equipment, or another underlying cause and determine the appropriate next step.



About This Role



You will be the first point of technical support when customers experience problems with their security systems.



Because you will be working remotely, you will often need to diagnose an issue without physically seeing or touching the equipment. You may be speaking with a customer who is unfamiliar with technical terminology or with a field technician who is currently working at the site.



You will ask targeted questions, gather information about the symptoms, analyze what is being reported, and guide the person through the appropriate troubleshooting process.



Issues may include network or connectivity problems affecting IP cameras, alarm panel configuration or programming issues, DVR/NVR problems, camera connectivity, access control issues, or equipment that may require replacement or an on-site technician.



You will document troubleshooting steps and resolutions in the ticketing system, assist with system configuration and programming, and coordinate with field technicians when an issue cannot be resolved remotely.



Clear communication is critical. You must be able to explain technical concepts in plain, easy-to-understand English and remain patient when assisting customers who are not technically experienced.



What You’ll Do

Provide remote technical support for security and low-voltage systems

Diagnose system problems through phone,
, and remote access

Follow up with customers to confirm that issues have been resolved

Retention & Organic Growth: Track client satisfaction and proactively identify opportunities to expand scopes of work (e.g., adding content creation, digital PR, or local SEO services).



SEO Project Management & AI Workflows

Campaign Roadmapping: Collaborate with SEO Strategists to turn technical audits and keyword research into structured monthly action plans.

AI Workflow Optimization: Utilize AI prompt engineering and automated workflows (e.g., using ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, or custom internal AI agents) to rapidly generate SEO content briefs, map keyword intent, and draft client communications.

AI-Assisted Quality Control: Fact-check, refine, and humanize AI-generated outlines or content drafts before they go to production, ensuring they align exactly with the client’s brand voice and E-E-A-T guidelines.

Quality Control: Review content and technical recommendations before they go to the client to ensure they meet agency standards and align with the client’s brand voice.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 1–3 years of experience in a digital marketing or SEO agency in an account management, project management, or client-facing role.

AI Fluency: Demonstrated experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) and prompt engineering to streamline day-to-day project management, copywriting, or data analysis tasks.

SEO Literacy: A solid understanding of core SEO principles (on-page optimization, technical SEO, link building, and keyword intent). You don’t need to be a developer, but you must know how SEO drives business value.

Data & Analytics: Comfortable navigating Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and industry tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Screaming Frog to review data before client calls.

Project Management Skills: High proficiency with agency project management tools (e.g., Asana, ClickUp) to track high-volume tasks.

Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a knack for managing client expectations and staying calm under tight deadlines.

3. Build clean variation families for apparel (size × color) and keep them from breaking

4. Build out and optimize our Artisan Profile and storefront

5. Keyword research and listing SEO: titles, bullets, backend search terms

6. Run Sponsored Products campaigns — auto for discovery, manual for harvested keywords, negative keyword management

7. Scale the store: plan and execute SKU expansion, not just maintain what exists

8. Weekly report: sessions, conversion rate, ad spend, ACOS, units sold, and what you changed



REQUIREMENTS

1. Proven Amazon Handmade experience — you have personally worked inside a HANDMADE account

2. Experience with Amazon Custom and personalized/made-to-order products

3. Expert with variations — you can build a full size × color family and fix one when it breaks

4. Have personally run Sponsored Products campaigns and can defend your bid decisions

5. Understand that Custom products are seller-fulfilled and cannot go through FBA

6. Apparel category knowledge: size map, color map, fit type, department, material composition

7. Strong written English — you will be writing customer-facing copy

8. Reliable internet and a working backup connection



NICE TO HAVE

1. Experience taking a shop through the Handmade artisan application

2. Basic Photoshop or Canva for mockups, size charts, and customization previews



PROOF OF WORK — REQUIRED

Applications without proof will not be read. Send AT LEAST two:



1. 3 or more live Handmade ASINs you personally built — I will open them and check the variation setup and whether the Handmade badge is applied correctly

2. A link to an Artisan Profile you built or managed

3. Screenshot of Campaign Manager showing a campaign you ran — must show date range, spend, ACOS, and orders



Blur the account name if you are under NDA, but ASINs and metrics must be visible. Do not send course screenshots or someone else's results. I verify everything.



HOW TO APPLY

Put ARTISAN in your subject line or your application will not be read.



Answer briefly, in your own words (Not AI GENERATED):

1. Which Handmade account did you work on, and what products did it sell?

2. Walk me through setting up a customizable t-shirt listing with Amazon Custom. What customization options did you configure?

3. What is different about building a listing in Handmade versus regular Seller Central?

4. How would you scale a Handmade store from 20 SKUs to 200 without breaking the variation families?

5. How many SKUs did you manage, and how many variation children per parent? Then: name three things that break a variation family, and how you fix each one.

6. What t-shirt niches have you worked in? Give me the specific niches and tell me which ones actually sold.



Generic resumes with no answers are auto-rejected.

title: Technical Engineering Coordinator
description:
One seat. Technical judgment. Full accountability.



This is not a “hold the calendar and smile” support role.



We’re looking for a Technical Engineering Coordinator who can move comfortably between engineering calculations, technical correspondence, project coordination, and executive-level administrative support.



You should be able to look at a structural or mechanical calculation sheet, understand what you’re looking at, identify potential discrepancies, communicate clearly with a client, and keep the project moving — without everything being divided across three different people.



If you’re an engineer who is organized, commercially minded, technically sharp, and comfortable owning a moving workload, this could be a very strong fit.



What You’ll Do



* Own the inbox, don’t babysit it. Monitor and triage incoming
s based on urgency and complexity. Handle routine matters independently, route appropriately when needed, and respond directly to technical inquiries when you have the knowledge and judgment to do so.

* Review and validate engineering calculations. Check calculations for accuracy, consistency, and potential discrepancies before they become project or client issues.

* Keep engineering projects moving. Track timelines, deliverables, dependencies, follow-ups, and outstanding items across multiple active projects.

* Review and mark up technical documents. Use Bluebeam or equivalent redlining/markup software to review plan sets, submittals, drawings, and technical documentation.

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support. Handle scheduling, correspondence, coordination, documentation, follow-ups, and the many operational details that keep an engineering practice running smoothly.

* Communicate with clients professionally. Draft clear, concise, technically appropriate responses where required and ensure communication does not get lost in translation.

* Use technology intelligently. Leverage Microsoft Office and AI tools to improve drafting, research, documentation, organization, and workflow efficiency.

* Take ownership. Identify what needs to happen next and make it happen rather than waiting for someone to assign every step.



Non-Negotiable Requirements



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering**

* 5+ years of executive assistant, administrative, coordination, or comparable professional experience**, ideally supporting engineering or technical leadership

* Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage timelines, deliverables, priorities, and follow-ups

* Strong Microsoft Office proficiency, particularly Excel

* Familiarity with Bluebeam or comparable document markup/redlining software

* Strong spoken and written English

* Ability to understand and communicate technical information clearly

* Comfortable using AI tools for drafting, research, organization, and document-related tasks

* Strong technology skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

* Excellent judgment, organization, attention to detail, and follow-through



We’ll Evaluate You On



Relevant Work Experience



Your previous roles, scope of responsibilities, engineering/technical exposure, project coordination experience, and ability to operate at a high level.



Software & Technical Proficiency



Your working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel, Bluebeam or equivalent markup tools, project management platforms, communication tools, and AI-enabled productivity tools.



Remote Work Experience & Adaptability



Your ability to stay productive, organized, responsive, and accountable without someone physically supervising your work.



English Proficiency — Spoken & Written



You must be able to communicate confidently and professionally with US-based clients and engineering professionals.



Professionalism & Attitude



We value ownership, maturity, good judgment, respect, and a solution-oriented mindset. We’re looking for someone who brings solutions, not just problems.



Response Time & Clarity



In engineering, delays and vague communication can become expensive very quickly. You should be responsive, concise, and clear — especially when something requires immediate attention.



Internet & Work Setup



You must have a reliable internet connection, dependable computer/workstation, and professional remote-work environment suitable for full-time client-facing work.



Commitment to Role & Availability



This is a role that requires consistent attention and accountability. We’re looking for someone who can commit to the position and maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours.



Time Management & Dependability



You should be capable of managing competing priorities, meeting deadlines, following through on commitments, and keeping stakeholders informed without constant reminders.



Problem-Solving Skills



We want someone who can assess a situation, investigate, make reasonable decisions, and move things forward — not someone who stops at “there’s a problem.”



Willingness to Learn & Adapt



Engineering workflows, software, and client requirements evolve. You should be comfortable learning new tools and processes quickly and applying what you learn.



Hubstaff & Remote Accountability



This is a remote position, and Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work accountability.



You should be comfortable using Hubstaff appropriately and maintaining accurate work activity during scheduled hours. Remote work requires trust — and trust works both ways when expectations and accountability are clear.



Nice to Have



* Previous experience in an engineering firm, consultancy, construction company, or other technical environment

* Experience supporting engineering leadership or technical executives

* Exposure to construction documentation, plan review, submittals, or project workflows

* Formal project management certification

* Experience communicating directly with US-based clients

* Strong familiarity with Bluebeam

* A healthy sense of humor for those moments when the “urgent”
 turns out to be a font complaint



Why This Role Matters



You won’t be sitting on the sidelines waiting for instructions.



You’ll be part of the workflow that connects engineering, clients, documentation, administration, and project execution.



The right person will become someone the team can trust to say:



“I’ve reviewed it. Here’s the issue. Here’s what I recommend. And here’s what I’m doing next.”



If that sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please complete our applicant form:




/applicant-form/cc75295ffa2c
b061d541e2e&&ff29e11eb076d
e4d15a2a77



Please also submit:



Updated CV/Resume

Short introduction video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself, your experience, and why you would be a strong fit for this role.



Applications without a CV and introduction video may not be considered.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



Applicants who do not meet the Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering degree requirement will not be considered.

title: MEP Design Engineer - Plumbing (PHE)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Plumbing & Fire-Fighting Design Engineer to join our team and take ownership of plumbing and fire-fighting design projects from concept through detailed design.



This is not a general MEP drafting role. We are looking for a design engineer who can independently perform the engineering calculations behind the drawings, develop complete systems, coordinate with other disciplines, and ensure that designs meet applicable codes, project specifications, and engineering standards.



You will work on residential and commercial projects, including hotels, schools, restaurants, fitness clubs, and similar buildings.



What You'll Do

Develop plumbing and fire-fighting systems from concept through detailed design.

Design cold water, hot water, and hot water return systems.

Design sewer, drainage, and venting systems.

Design stormwater drainage and rainwater harvesting systems.

Design sewage ejector systems.



Design fire-fighting systems, including:

Fire sprinkler systems

Hydrant systems

Fire pump systems

Perform engineering calculations, including:

Water supply hydraulic calculations

Drainage hydraulic calculations

Sprinkler hydraulic calculations

Water demand calculations

Tank capacity sizing

Pipe sizing throughout the system

Prepare detailed plumbing and fire-fighting layouts, schematics, and 3D models.

Develop designs using AutoCAD 2020, Revit MEP 2020, and BIM 360.

Participate actively in BIM 360 coordination.

Identify, analyze, and resolve multidisciplinary clashes involving architectural, structural, electrical, and other MEP systems.

Prepare BOQs, material take-offs, and complete project documentation.

Review and update designs based on project requirements and coordination changes.

Ensure all designs comply with applicable building codes, fire codes, engineering standards, and project specifications.

Manage assigned design work independently while meeting project deadlines and quality requirements.



What We're Looking For

4+ years of professional experience in plumbing/PHE and fire-fighting design.

Strong hands-on experience designing plumbing and fire-fighting systems for residential and commercial buildings.



Proven experience with:

Plumbing/PHE system design

Fire sprinkler, hydrant, and fire pump system design

Hydraulic calculations for water supply, drainage, and sprinkler systems

Water demand calculations

Tank capacity sizing

Pipe sizing calculations

Cold water, hot water, and hot water return systems

Sewer, drainage, and venting systems

Rainwater harvesting and stormwater drainage

Sewage ejector systems

Proficiency in AutoCAD 2020.

Proficiency in Revit MEP 2020.

Working experience with BIM 360 and BIM coordination.

Experience preparing BOQs and material take-offs.

Strong understanding of multidisciplinary coordination and clash detection/resolution.

Ability to interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.

Strong understanding of applicable plumbing, fire-fighting, and engineering codes and standards.

Ability to work independently, take ownership of designs, and meet deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and engineering judgment.



Important

This position is intended for a full design engineer, not a CAD/Revit drafter.

You should be comfortable taking responsibility for the engineering analysis, calculations, system design, coordination, and final design output — not simply producing drawings based on instructions.



Nice to Have

Experience with SketchUp.

Experience with STAAD.Pro.

Experience working on hotels, schools, restaurants, fitness clubs, or other commercial projects.

Experience working with international/U.S.-based projects and standards.

title: Long-Term Video Editor — Documentary-Style YouTube Channel (Retention-Focused)
description:
Long-Term Video Editor — Documentary-Style YouTube Channel (Retention-Focused)



Rate: $30 AUD per finished 12-minute video Volume: 4 videos per week Type: Ongoing, long-term. Not a one-off project.



About the channel



Forgotten Beasts is a faceless documentary channel about extinct animals, lost species, and creatures people believe might still be out there. Audience is mostly US, UK and Australia, ages 34–55. Think mystery-thriller documentary, not listicle.



I write every script myself. You handle the edit: footage sourcing, cutting, sound design, text, pacing.



What I actually need from you



Views are not the problem. Retention is. I need an editor who understands that the edit is what keeps someone watching past minute three.



Here is the standard:



First 30 seconds. Target is 90% of viewers still watching at the 30-second mark. No logo, no channel intro, no slow build. Frame one must match the thumbnail exactly — if the thumbnail shows a thylacine, the first frame is a thylacine. Cuts every 2–3 seconds through the opening.



Change something on screen every 10–15 seconds. A digital zoom, a pan, a text pop, a hard cut, a music shift. If a clip has to sit longer than 3 seconds, add movement to it. Static frames kill retention.



Tension, then release. Never show the payoff shot while the voiceover is still explaining it. Build it, hold a beat, then drop the visual. If everything on screen is loud the whole time, nothing lands.



Sound leads picture. Place your SFX a few frames before the visual appears. Low rumbles for size, whooshes on transitions, paper crinkle for old documents and maps. Cut the music completely right before a big reveal.



Tease what's coming. When the script mentions an animal appearing later, flash a blurred or silhouetted frame of it for about 10 frames. Blink-and-you-miss-it. It makes people stay for the clear version.



Be ruthless with dead air. Remove breathing gaps, micro-pauses, and any second where nothing is happening. Use J-cuts so audio from the next section starts before the visual changes. Retention dies from a hundred small leaks, not one big one.



Archival treatment. When the script says an animal was last seen in 1936, the footage should look like 1936. Grain, black and white, film scratches, slight instability.



Fancy motion graphics do not matter here. Clean pacing does.



What I provide

Full script with timestamps, emotion notes and edit cues already marked

Voiceover audio

Thumbnail and title before you start, so you know what promise the edit has to deliver on

Stock accounts if needed

Pay, bonuses and revenue share

$30 per 12-minute video, paid weekly via Wise or PayPal

Retention bonus: +$[10] per video that holds above [50]% average view duration

Breakout bonus: +$[50] for any video that passes [50,000] views in its first 30 days

Revenue share: once you have delivered consistently for [3] months, you move onto [5]% of the channel's monthly ad revenue on top of your per-video rate



The rate goes up as the channel grows. I would rather train one editor properly and keep them for years than cycle through cheap freelancers. If this channel scales, you scale with it.



To apply



Do not send a generic portfolio link. Applications without the following get ignored.



Send 2 examples of documentary or faceless-style work you edited. Tell me which parts were your decisions.

Answer this: what is the first thing you would change in an edit if the retention graph dropped hard at the 45-second mark?

Confirm you can deliver 4 videos a week, every week.

Tell me your software and your turnaround time for a 12-minute video.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test: one 45-second segment from a real script. If it works, you start that week.

PAY AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT

This role will begin with a small paid trial project. The trial is not a guarantee of ongoing work, but there is potential for regular part-time work if we’re a good fit.

HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1) A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.

2) A link to your portfolio, including examples of Instagram carousels, static posts and short-form videos. Please clearly identify which pieces you personally created.

3) A brief explanation of your connection to Christianity or your experience creating content for Christian audiences.

4) Three types of Instagram content you believe could work well for Biblical Teachings. Briefly describe how each would look and why it would appeal to our audience.

6) Details of your experience with Canva, short-form video editing and AI creative tools.

7) Your availability, expected hourly rate and how many hours you could offer each week.

Applications that do not include the requested information will not be considered.

title: Cold Caller / Objection Handler
description:
COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER

Remote | Full-time, around 160 hours per month | You choose how you get paid



================================================================

READ THIS FIRST: HOW TO APPLY

================================================================



To be considered, you must submit a recorded video. Face on camera,

two minutes maximum.



In the video, do two things:



1. Introduce yourself.



2. Answer this: you have just called a business owner, and ten

   seconds in he says "I'm not interested." Say out loud, word for

   word, exactly what you would say next.



Applications without a video will not be reviewed. We are not

looking at resumes. We are looking at how you sound and how you

think on your feet.





================================================================

COMPENSATION: YOU PICK

================================================================



OPTION A: COMMISSION ONLY

$75 per qualified, attended sales call. No base.



OPTION B: BASE PLUS COMMISSION

$700 per month guaranteed, plus $30 per qualified, attended sales

call.



Same job either way. You choose the structure when you accept the

offer. Option A pays significantly more if you can produce.

Option B guarantees money while you ramp.



WHAT YOU CAN EARN



  3 qualified calls/week:   $975/mo (A)  or  $1,090/mo (B)

  5 qualified calls/week: $1,650/mo (A)  or  $1,360/mo (B)

  6 qualified calls/week: $1,950/mo (A)  or  $1,480/mo (B)

 10 qualified calls/week: $3,225/mo (A)  or  $1,990/mo (B)

 15 qualified calls/week: $4,875/mo (A)  or  $2,650/mo (B)



From about 4 qualified calls a week up, Option A wins and keeps

winning. Our current caller books about 20 appointments a week,

and roughly 6 of those attend. That is the number to beat.



START ON OPTION B, SWITCH TO OPTION A AFTER 60 DAYS.

Take the safety net while you ramp, then go get the ceiling.

Your call, no penalty.





================================================================

THE ROLE

================================================================



We provide the leads. You make the calls. You book qualified

meetings. You get paid when they show up.



Lead lists, dialer, scripts, and the offer are already built. Your

job is the phone, and specifically, your job is what happens after

someone says no.





================================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

================================================================



- Make outbound calls to our provided prospect lists

- Get past the first "no" instead of taking it at face value

- Handle real objections
 "not interested," "send me an

 
," "we already have someone"

- Qualify prospects against a clear, written standard

- Book appointments and confirm them so they actually attend

- Keep clean notes and hold high, consistent call volume

- Take coaching and keep improving





================================================================

WHAT "QUALIFIED" MEANS

================================================================



You get the written definition before your first call. No moving

goalposts, no judgment calls after the fact. If a prospect meets

the criteria and attends, you get paid.





================================================================

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

================================================================



A shark. Someone who can think on their feet while a stranger is

actively trying to get off the phone.



- A STRONG OBJECTION HANDLER ABOVE ALL ELSE. This is the job.

- Hears "not interested" as the start of the conversation, not

  the end

- Confident with strangers and comfortable being told no all day

- Quick on their feet, not dependent on a script

- Competitive and motivated by performance pay

- Coachable, reliable, consistent



Cold calling or sales experience is a plus, not a requirement. We

care about what you can do on the phone today.





================================================================

WHAT WE PROVIDE

================================================================



- Prospect lists and calling infrastructure

- Sales scripts and objection-handling frameworks

- Training and ongoing coaching

- Warm leads in rotation

- A clear, written qualification standard





================================================================

THE REST OF THE PROCESS

================================================================



After the video: a short interview, then a live calling and

roleplay evaluation where we play a difficult prospect and throw

real objections at you. That is the whole test.



If you are confident on the phone and want your income tied to

what you produce, we want to hear from you.





Evan

Managing Director, Ascension AI

title: CRM Data Migration & Automation Specialist
description:
???? Remote | Full Time



We are a UK hospitality business. Our customer data is scattered across four separate platforms and nobody can see the full picture of any single customer. We have bought GoHighLevel and we need one person, for four weeks, to consolidate everything into it properly and build the core automations on top.



This is a fixed 4-week contract, 40 hours per week, at $7 USD per hour. If the work is excellent there is a strong chance of extension into later phases.



This is a data job first and an automation job second. Roughly two of the four weeks are careful spreadsheet work. If deduplicating 29,000 messy rows into 21,000 clean ones sounds satisfying rather than tedious, you will enjoy this.



Background: what we are doing and why



We would rather you understood the point of the work than just followed instructions, so here is the honest picture.



The business. A long-established UK venue with several separately bookable spaces, plus a second smaller venue next door. It is busy at weekends and has a lot of unused capacity midweek. Around 21,000 customers have passed through it over more than a decade.



The problem we are solving. UK nightlife is shrinking. This business cannot grow by pulling in more walk-up customers on its busiest night, because that night is already close to full. Growth has to come from planned occasions instead — private room hire, group bookings, seasonal parties, corporate events. Those get booked weeks ahead, are paid for by organisers or company budgets, and happen on the nights the venue is half empty anyway.



To make that shift, the business needs to be able to reach the customers it already has. Right now it cannot. That is what you are fixing.



How the data got into this state. Nobody planned it. Platforms were adopted one at a time over a decade as they were needed — a booking system, then a ticketing platform, then a replacement ticketing platform, then an
 tool. None of them were ever connected to each other. Each holds a partial, overlapping view of the same people.



What is actually broken today:



The same customer exists three or four times over, so a loyal regular looks like several strangers

Booking counts are calculated per platform, so the loyalty tiers are wrong and the genuine best customers are invisible

Enquiries arrive in six different places, get replied to once, then are never chased. Nobody knows how many are lost, because nothing counts them.

Opt-out records exist in only one system — which is a legal risk, and the reason the suppression work matters so much



The four things this programme is meant to achieve:



Re-engage people who enquired but never booked

Re-engage customers who came once and never returned

Get the customer base signed up to a free loyalty scheme (whose real purpose is collecting proper marketing consent)

Make sure no booking enquiry is ever missed again



Where your four weeks fit. The full programme is about 18 stages and 165–225 hours. Your contract is the first and most important slice: the foundation and the data migration. Later stages are blocked by things nobody can speed up — API credentials from a supplier, business verification with Meta, and a mandatory 3–4 week
 domain warm-up. So you are not expected to finish the whole programme. You are expected to complete your part to a standard that lets the next stage start cleanly.



Who you will work with. A UK project owner (your daily contact), the venue's general manager and assistant manager (who you will train at handover), an external developer handling the API work, and a UK marketing agency who own the CRM account at the top level.



What you will actually be doing



The work falls into four areas. We will agree the running order at kickoff, once we have looked at the data exports together and seen what condition they are in.



Setting up the foundation



Set up and configure a GoHighLevel sub-account from scratch

Build 13 custom fields, around 40 tags and a 9-stage pipeline, exactly to a written specification

Audit an
 marketing platform we are retiring: its lists, automations, forms and API keys

Export data from four platforms and log everything



The data migration — this is the main event



Build a master suppression list of everyone who has opted out, and load it into the CRM before anything else

Normalise four very different exports into one consistent 14-column format

Deduplicate on
 and phone, applying precise merge rules supplied to you

Score and tag every record by frequency, recency, value and product using formulas

Import in tranches, reconciling the numbers after each one

Produce a one-page reconciliation report



Building the core automations



An enquiry acknowledgement that fires within 60 seconds

A follow-up chase sequence that stops the instant a customer replies on any channel

An automated review request flow

A signup form that captures marketing consent correctly

A webhook feed from a ticketing platform



Testing and handover



Work through a supplied test checklist, evidencing every item

Write a runbook someone non-technical can follow

Record a walkthrough and hand over cleanly



You will be given a detailed written build manual covering every step. You are not being asked to design the approach. You are being asked to execute it accurately and to tell us immediately when something does not add up.



What we need from you



Essential



Advanced spreadsheet skills. This is the single most important requirement. You must be genuinely comfortable deduplicating tens of thousands of rows, writing lookup and conditional formulas, cleaning inconsistent data, and reconciling totals back to a source.

Hands-on CRM administration. You have personally configured a CRM — custom fields, tags, pipelines, imports, automations. GoHighLevel is ideal. HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Zoho or Keap experience is acceptable if you are a fast learner.

Automation building. Multi-step workflows with conditions, waits and branching. Zapier or Make experience.

Strong written English. You will write audit notes, a reconciliation report and a runbook a non-technical person must be able to follow.

Precision over initiative. On this project, following the specification exactly matters more than clever improvisation.

Reliability. 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours daily overlapping UK business hours (roughly 4pm to 8pm Philippine time).



Nice to have, not required



Familiarity with UK GDPR or PECR marketing consent rules

 deliverability basics (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)

Experience migrating between
 marketing platforms

Light scripting for data cleaning (Python or Google Apps Script)

Hospitality, events or booking system experience



The terms

   

Rate    $7.00 USD per hour

Hours    40 per week, Monday to Friday

Term    4 weeks, fixed

Payment    TBD

Equipment    Your own computer and reliable internet



How to apply



Please do not send a generic application. We read the ones that follow these instructions and skip the rest. It takes about 15 minutes and we promise to reply either way.



Step 1: Start your message with the word RECONCILE



This tells us you read to the end. Applications without it are not opened.



Step 2: Give us these details



You will be asked to fill out a form where all the necessary documents and questions are.

title: Program Admission and Service Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Program Admission and Service Specialist is responsible for coordinating all aspects of participant admissions and ongoing service management for facility-based programs, including Day Habilitation, Afterschool, and Saturday services. This role ensures a smooth intake process, timely authorizations and reauthorizations, completion of required meetings, and accurate communication of program updates to families, teams, and stakeholders. The Program Admission and Service Specialist serves as a primary point of contact for prospective and enrolled participants and supports continuity of services through proactive coordination, scheduling, and documentation.



Key Responsibilities



Admissions & Enrollment

• Manage and coordinate the full admissions process from referral to program start

• Respond to inquiries from families, case managers, schools, and referral sources

• Conduct intake screenings and collect required documentation

• Verify eligibility criteria in accordance with program and funding requirements

• Schedule and facilitate intake meetings and tours as needed

• Maintain waitlists and track enrollment capacity across programs

• Prepare admission packets and ensure all required forms are completed



Authorizations & Reauthorizations

• Submit initial service authorization requests to funding sources

• Track authorization periods and ensure timely reauthorization submissions

• Monitor service units and utilization

• Communicate with payers, support coordinators, and treatment teams regarding approvals or discrepancies

• Maintain accurate documentation to support billing and compliance requirements



Participant Support & Service Coordination

• Serve as a point of contact for participants and caregivers regarding services

• Coordinate quarterly, semi-annual, and annual meetings as required

• Assist with service plan updates and distribution to appropriate stakeholders

• Support transition between programs or service levels as needed

• Facilitate communication between families, program staff, clinicians, and providers



Program Updates & Documentation

• Maintain participant records in accordance with regulatory standards

• Enter and update data in electronic health records or case management systems

• Prepare reports related to admissions, authorizations, census, and utilization

• Support compliance activities and audits as needed

• Communicate program updates, schedule changes, and announcements to families and tea
mbers



Qualifications

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Social Work, Psychology, Education, or related field preferred

• Experience with developmental disabilities, behavioral health, or day program services strongly preferred

• Prior experience in admissions, intake, case management, service coordination, or authorizations required

• Familiarity with Medicaid, MCOs, and waiver programs preferred

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Excellent communication and customer-service skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic records systems



Core Competencies

• Customer service and family-centered approach

• Cultural competence and sensitivity

• Professional written and verbal communication

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance

• Problem-solving and follow-through

• Team collaboration and independent work capability



Working Conditions

• Remote 9am-6pm, Mon- Fri, US New York Time

• May require occasional evening or weekend hours for meetings or events
